## Review

**8 out of 10, Strong.** Presentation quality, judged with the SlideDeck Co review heuristic (https://slidedeck.co/review-methodology/). The ask, the evidence and the merit of the idea are not rated.

The deck uses one disciplined system across the 72 pages I saw: a blue title band that states the takeaway with its key figure, a clean chart or screenshot body, and a source footer on nearly every slide. Charts such as slides 8 and 10 are readable, with direct data labels, a clear legend, and one accent color for growth. The route is easy to follow, with a contents slide (3), section dividers (6, 11), and short pivot statements between topics. Weaknesses are the heavy density of many chart and screenshot slides, tiny source notes and screenshot text, and a few bare-header or text-only pages.

**Worth keeping:** Keep the takeaway-with-number title band, the consistent chart styling with direct labels and sources (slides 8 and 10), and the section divider rhythm.

**Most useful repair:** Fix the slides with an empty header band over a lone italic statement (12, 17, 20, 31, 36, 37, 38, 42, 58, 65) and the unstructured text on slide 4.

**What would change the score:** I would cut or enlarge the small-print screenshots and dual panels (21, 28, 45, 46, 62) so key callouts survive projection, and shorten the titles that run to two dense lines.

_Confidence medium. 72 of 356 pages inspected on contact sheets, 4 at readable size. Reviewed Reviewed 2026-11-08. Model-assisted review (claude-sonnet-5-5)._

## Summary

Mary Meeker's Internet Trends 2017 was presented at the Code Conference on May 31, 2017, and published by Kleiner Perkins. It opens with a title slide and a conference-branded cover, then a contents page listing eleven sections: global internet trends, online advertising and commerce, interactive games, media, the cloud, the China and India internet, healthcare, public and private internet companies, macro thoughts and closing thoughts. The early slides cover global user growth, smartphone shipments and installed base, and US time spent on digital media. Each section opens with a full-bleed divider slide followed by chart-led slides whose headlines state the takeaway in a short phrase with the key figure. Slides worth studying include the 'Global Internet Users = 3.4B @ 46% Penetration' chart slide, which pairs a bar chart with a growth line and a source footer, and the time-spent chart that shows mobile overtaking desktop. The deck runs to 356 pages, so this review covers only the portion of text shown and the first twelve slides.

## Questions about this deck

**How many slides does the Mary Meeker, Kleiner Perkins Internet Trends 2017 deck have?**

The deck runs to 356 pages, but the shown text covers only the first twelve slides. Slide 3 lists the closing section, Closing Thoughts, at pages 352-353.

**What does the Mary Meeker, Kleiner Perkins Internet Trends 2017 deck say about global internet users?**

Slide 6 states Global Internet Users = 3.4B, with +10% vs. 10% Y/Y and +8% vs. 8% Y/Y (ex. India). Slide 7 charts global internet users from 2009 to 2016 under the headline Global Internet Users = 3.4B @ 46% Penetration.

**What does the Kleiner Perkins Internet Trends 2017 deck by Mary Meeker say about global smartphone shipments?**

Slide 8 is headed Global Smartphone Unit Shipments = Continue to Slow, with +3% Y/Y vs. +10% (2015) and +28% (2014). Slide 6 summarizes global smartphone shipments as Slowing +3% vs. +10% Y/Y.

**How is the Mary Meeker, Kleiner Perkins Internet Trends 2017 deck structured?**

Slide 3 lists eleven sections, from 1) Global Internet Trends at pages 4-9 through 11) Closing Thoughts at pages 352-353. The sections run in order: Global Internet Trends, Online Advertising (+ Commerce), Interactive Games, Media, The Cloud, China Internet, India Internet, Healthcare, Global Public / Private Internet Companies, Some Macro Thoughts, and Closing Thoughts.

### Slide 8

**Review notes**

- Worth studying: A stacked bar chart by operating system with a growth line on a secondary axis, headlined with the key comparison.
- Review: Charts such as slides 8 and 10 are readable, with direct data labels, a clear legend, and one accent color for growth.
- Worth keeping: Keep the takeaway-with-number title band, the consistent chart styling with direct labels and sources (slides 8 and 10), and the section divider rhythm.

**Text**

Global Smartphone Unit Shipments = Continue to Slow... / @ +3% Y/Y vs. +10% (2015) / +28% (2014) / Smartphone Unit Shipments by Operating System (MM), Global, 2009 – 2016 / 1,500 / 100% / 1,200 / 80% / 900 / 60% / Y/Y Growth (%) / Global Smartphone Unit Shipments (MM) / 600 / 40% / 300 / 20% / 0 / 0% / 2009 / 2010 / 2011 / 2012 / 2013 / 2014 / 2015 / 2016 / Android / iOS / Other / Y/Y Growth / KLEINER PERKINS / Source: Morgan Stanley Research (5/17) / KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 7

**Layout**

Single chart slide with a full-width dark teal title band across the top (two-line title left-aligned with about 2% left margin), a thin teal rule under it, the chart title centred below the band, and a combined chart occupying the middle of the slide with a horizontal legend under the x-axis. The Kleiner Perkins logo sits bottom-left at the margin with the source line beside it, and the footer text 'KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 7' is right-aligned at the bottom right, ending about 4% from the right edge.

**Visuals**

Chart: combined stacked column and line chart. Chart title: 'Smartphone Unit Shipments by Operating System (MM), Global, 2009 – 2016' (bold, black, centred above the plot). Left y-axis: 'Global Smartphone Unit Shipments (MM)', range 0 to 1,500, gridlines at 300, 600, 900, 1,200 and 1,500, light grey horizontal gridlines. Right y-axis: 'Y/Y Growth (%)', range 0% to 100%, labels at 0%, 20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, 100%. X-axis: years 2009 to 2016 as categories, bold black labels. Stacked columns, bottom to top: Android (teal #00A6AD), iOS (red-orange #EA543B), Other (dark navy #004A6F). Estimated column totals (no values printed on the slide, so these are about readings): 2009 about 170 MM (Android about 7, iOS about 28, Other about 135); 2010 about 300 MM (Android about 70, iOS about 50, Other about 185); 2011 about 490 MM (Android about 240, iOS about 95, Other about 155); 2012 about 725 MM (Android about 505, iOS about 135, Other about 90); 2013 about 1,020 MM (Android about 805, iOS about 155, Other about 60); 2014 about 1,300 MM (Android about 1,060, iOS about 195, Other about 45); 2015 about 1,440 MM (Android about 1,165, iOS about 235, Other about 40); 2016 about 1,475 MM (Android about 1,245, iOS about 215, Other about 15). Line series 'Y/Y Growth' in pure red (#FF0000), about 2.5pt thick, plotted against the right axis with markers at each year but no visible marker shapes; printed label values on the slide are only in the title: +3% for 2016, +10% for 2015, +28% for 2014; estimated points: 2009 about 15%, 2010 about 76%, 2011 about 62%, 2012 about 48%, 2013 about 40%, 2014 28%, 2015 10%, 2016 3%. Legend below the plot, horizontal, centred: teal swatch 'Android', red-orange swatch 'iOS', navy swatch 'Other', red line swatch 'Y/Y Growth'. No highlighted points. Logo: Kleiner Perkins wordmark, two stacked bold uppercase lines 'KLEINER' over 'PERKINS' in green (about #3DB86E), bottom left.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF, with a dark teal #00517A header band across the top 12.5% of the slide. Clean corporate chart slide. Background white #FFFFFF. Title band fill dark teal-blue #00517A across the top 12.5% of the slide height, with a thin cyan rule #00A6AD beneath it. Title text white #FFFFFF in Arial regular (sans-serif), about 4.4% of slide height per line, two lines. Chart title and axis labels in bold black #000000 Arial, about 2.2% of slide height for ticks and axis titles, 3.0% for the chart title. Source line in regular Arial, about 1.3% height, black. Footer in regular Arial, about 1.5% height, grey #A6AAA9, uppercase with a vertical bar separator. Series colours: Android #00A6AD, iOS #EA543B, Other #004A6F, Y/Y Growth line #FF0000. Square-cornered bars, no shadows, no gradients, light grey gridlines.

### Slide 10

**Review notes**

- Worth studying: A stacked column chart of hours per day by device, with labelled segments that make the shift to mobile readable at a glance.
- Review: Charts such as slides 8 and 10 are readable, with direct data labels, a clear legend, and one accent color for growth.
- Worth keeping: Keep the takeaway-with-number title band, the consistent chart styling with direct labels and sources (slides 8 and 10), and the section divider rhythm.

**Layout**

Full-width dark blue header band across the top holding a two-line left-aligned white title, with a thin cyan rule beneath it. Below sits a centred bold chart title, then a single clustered column chart occupying the middle, with the callouts placed in the upper right of the plot and the ~$16B box at right. The Kleiner Perkins logo sits bottom left beside a four-line source note, and the footer text sits bottom right, with the page label ending near the right margin.

**Visuals**

One clustered column chart titled '% of Time Spent in Media vs. % of Advertising Spending, USA, 2016'. Y axis: '% of Total Media Consumption Time or Advertising Spending', linear, 0% to 50%, ticks every 10%, light grey horizontal gridlines at each tick. X categories: Print, Radio, TV, Internet, Mobile. Series 1 Time Spent (yellow #FCD03F): Print 4%, Radio 9%, TV 38%, Internet 20%, Mobile 28%. Series 2 Ad Spend (cyan #02B5CC): Print 12%, Radio 9%, TV 38%, Internet 20%, Mobile 21%. Each bar carries its printed value as a data label: dark grey #353B37 bold on yellow bars and white bold on cyan bars. Legend at top centre: yellow square labelled Time Spent, cyan square labelled Ad Spend. Highlights: a red dashed ellipse around the top-right callout reading Total Internet Ad = $73B and Of Which Mobile Ad = $37B; a light green dashed box above the Mobile Ad Spend bar spanning 21% to 28%; a green box at right reading ~$16B Opportunity in USA with a black arrow pointing to the Mobile Ad Spend bar. Ten block arrows mark year-over-year shifts: Print Time Spent none, Print Ad Spend down arrow; Radio Time Spent down arrow, Radio Ad Spend down arrow; TV Time Spent up arrow, TV Ad Spend down arrow; Internet Time Spent down arrow, Internet Ad Spend down arrow; Mobile Time Spent up arrow, Mobile Ad Spend up arrow. Print has a pair of stacked bars (equals sign) drawn beside its Time Spent bar indicating no change. Each arrow is a light blue bevelled block arrow with a soft shadow.

**Design**

Background white #FFFFFF. Header band dark teal-navy #00517A with a thin cyan rule #02B5CC beneath it. Title text white #FFFFFF in regular Arial-style sans-serif, two lines, roughly 4.1 percent of slide height, with the cap height about 0.7 of that. Chart title bold black #000000 Arial-style sans-serif, about 3.3 percent of slide height. Body and axis text bold Arial-style sans-serif in dark grey #353B37, about 2.2 percent of slide height. Callout text bold black #000000, about 2.2 to 3.7 percent. Footer source text regular Arial-style sans-serif black, about 1.3 percent. Footer right label regular grey #A6AAA9, about 1.5 percent. Accent colours: yellow #FCD03F, cyan #02B5CC, red dashed outline #E0262B, light green fill #D2F2E4 with lime-green border. Shapes have square corners apart from the rounded light-green callout box, with no gradients except the soft gradient on the block arrows.

**Text**

Ad Blocking = Growth Continues…Especially in Developing Markets… / Users Increasingly Opt Out of Stuff They Don’t Want / Adblocking Users on Web / (Mobile + Desktop), Global, 4/09 – 12/16 / Global Adblocking Users (MM) / 400 / 300 / 200 / 100 / 0 / 2009 2010 2011 2012 2013 2014 2015 2016 / Desktop Adblocking Software Users / Mobile Adblocking Browser Users / Adblocking Penetration / (Mobile + Desktop), Selected / Countries, 12/16 / Country / Desktop / Mobile / China / 1% / 13% / India / 1% / 28% / USA / 18% / 1% / Brazil / 6% / 1% / Japan / 3% / -- / Russia / 6% / 3% / Germany / 28% / 1% / Indonesia / 8% / 58% / UK / 16% / 1% / France / 11% / 1% / Canada / 24% / -- / Source: PageFair 2015, 2017 reports. These two data sets have not been de-duplicated. The number of desktop adblockers after 1/16 are estimates based on the / observed trend in desktop adblocking and provided by PageFair. Note that mobile adblocking refers to web / browser-based adblocking and not in-app adblocking. / Desktop adblocking estimates are for global monthly active users of desktop adblocking software between 4/09 – 12/16, as calculated in the PageFair’s 2015 and 2017 / reports. Mobile adblocking estimates are for global monthly active users of mobile browsers that block ads by default between 9/14 – 12/16, including the number of / Digicel subscribers in the Caribbean (added 10/15), as calculated in the PageFair & Priori Data 2016 and PageFair 2017 Adblocking Report. / KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 18

**Layout**

Two equal columns below a full-width header band, separated by a thin vertical grey divider at about 55% of slide width: left column holds a line chart, right column holds a 3-column table. The title sits left-aligned in white inside the top navy band, with two lines. Left margin about 2%, right margin about 2%. Footer row at the bottom has the Kleiner Perkins logo at far left, a five-line source note beside it, and the right-aligned running footer 'KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 18' at bottom right. There is no separate slide-number box beyond the footer text.

**Visuals**

Chart (left): line chart titled 'Adblocking Users on Web (Mobile + Desktop), Global, 4/09 – 12/16', with 'Users' in bold italic. Y-axis titled 'Global Adblocking Users (MM)', rotated vertically, range 0 to 400, labelled gridlines at 0, 100, 200, 300, 400 in light grey. X-axis 2009 to 2016 with year labels at the start of each year, bold black. Series 1, 'Desktop Adblocking Software Users', solid red line: about 20 MM in 2009, about 25 MM late 2009, about 45 MM in 2011, about 40 MM in 2012, rising steeply from 2012 through 2013 (about 90 MM mid-2013), about 140 MM in 2014, a marked point at about 200 MM at the 2015 crossing, then about 215 MM in 2016 and about 236 MM at the end of 2016. Series 2, 'Mobile Adblocking Browser Users', solid green line: starts about 145 MM in late 2014 and rises steeply to about 275 MM in mid-2016 and about 380 MM at the end of 2016 (values after the first and last tick are about). No data labels are printed; values above are estimates. Legend below the x-axis, left-aligned, with a short red line swatch and a short green line swatch next to the two series names. No highlighted points. Table (right): 3 columns (Country, Desktop, Mobile) and 11 rows including header. Header row fill #00689D with white bold text. Body rows alternate white and #EBF7FF, separated by thin black horizontal rules. Rows: China 1% 13%; India 1% 28%; USA 18% 1%; Brazil 6% 1%; Japan 3% --; Russia 6% 3%; Germany 28% 1%; Indonesia 8% 58%; UK 16% 1%; France 11% 1%; Canada 24% --. Logo (bottom left): the 'KLEINER PERKINS' wordmark in green, two stacked lines, bold condensed sans, about 164 by 96 pixels.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. Clean white content slide with a dark teal-navy title band across the top. Title text is white, regular-weight sans-serif (Arial-like), about 4.07% of slide height, left aligned. Chart and table headings are black bold sans-serif (Arial Bold) at about 2.96% of slide height. Table and chart labels are bold black sans-serif (Arial Bold) at about 2.22%. Footer text is regular Arial at about 1.11%; running footer is light grey Arial at about 1.49%. Accents: navy band #00517A, thin teal rule under the band (about #1BB5C8), table header #00689D, table alternating rows #EBF7FF, chart red #FF0000 and green #2BA56B for the logo and mobile series (approximately #3CAF7A for the line). Vertical divider light grey #D0D0D0, about 0.1% wide. Shapes have square corners, no shadows, no gradients.

**Layout**

Two-zone layout on a white field under a full-width dark teal title band: a wide chart area on the left (about 0 to 62 percent of the width) and a product mock-up column on the right (about 66 to 95 percent), separated by a thin vertical grey rule at about x 62.7 percent running from y 14.7 to 91 percent. The two-line title is left-aligned at the top left (x 2.1 percent, y 1.7 percent) inside the band. Chart headings are centred over each zone. The Kleiner Perkins logo sits bottom left at x 1.8 percent, y 92.2 percent, with the source and note block beside it; the footer text 'KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 22' sits bottom right at about x 75.8 percent, y 95.4 percent. Left margin is about 2 percent; no slide number is printed other than the footer page number.

**Visuals**

Chart: clustered vertical bar chart titled 'Pinterest / Browsing Turning into Buying, 4/17', split into two question panels by a dashed cyan vertical divider at about x 33.5 percent. Y axis: '% of Respondents', 0% to 50% in 5% steps, gridlines light grey. X categories: 'Browse' (left panel, question 'Which of these services is a great place to browse for things you might want to buy?') and 'Buy' (right panel, question 'Which of these services is a great place to buy things online?'). Series: 4/15 in green (#31AF78) and 4/17 in dark blue (#00689D). Labelled values: Browse 4/15 = 33%, Browse 4/17 = 44%, Buy 4/15 = 12%, Buy 4/17 = 24%. Legend centred below the chart: green square '4/15', blue square '4/17'. No points highlighted. Bar tops: Browse 4/15 at y 51.5 percent, Browse 4/17 at y 42.5 percent, Buy 4/15 at about y 68.7 percent, Buy 4/17 at about y 58.9 percent; baseline (0%) at y 78.5 percent. Bar widths are about 5 percent of slide width each, with the Browse pair near x 16.7 to 28.3 percent and the Buy pair near x 39.5 to 51.1 percent. Photo-style mock-up on the right: a product-discovery screenshot, 501 by 800 pixels, boxed with no crop and no rounding, at x 66.0 percent, y 26.7 percent, w 28.9 percent, h 61.6 percent. Its upper part is a photograph of a man in dark sunglasses, black leather biker jacket, black top and dark slim jeans with tan lace-up waterproof boots, walking left to right across grey concrete pavement in front of a pale grey wall of glass blocks; lighting is flat overcast daylight; colours are grey, black and tan with a saturated blue dot overlaid at the feet (about x 85.9 to 88.8 percent, y 55.2 to 59.0 percent, circular, solid blue). Full-body figure centred slightly right, cropped at the top edge of the photo area. Below the photo on a white card: a close (X) icon in grey, the text 'Shop the look', and a product tile with a tan Timberland-style boot on white (about x 67.1 to 76.3 percent, y 66.2 to 78.2 percent), price in blue, product name and brand in small grey text. Logo: Kleiner Perkins wordmark in green (#31AF78), two stacked bold sans-serif lines, bottom left.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF, with a full-width dark teal #00517A band across the top 12.5 percent of the slide. Clean corporate consulting style. Background white (#FFFFFF). Title band dark teal-blue #00517A full width at top (height 12.5 percent) with a thin brighter cyan (#00A9C0 approximately) rule along its bottom edge. Title text white (#FFFFFF), regular-weight Arial-like sans-serif, about 4.44 percent of slide height per line, two lines. Question text: italic Arial, black, about 2.22 percent. Axis labels, data labels and category labels: bold Arial, black, about 2.22 percent. Legend labels bold Arial black, about 2.23 percent. Series colours: 4/15 green #31AF78; 4/17 blue #00689D. Gridlines light grey (#D9D9D9), about 0.1 percent of slide height thick. Dashed divider cyan #00A9C0, dashed, about 0.3 percent width. Vertical separator light grey #D0D0D0. Footer page text grey #A6AAA9, about 1.49 percent. Source/notes text black, regular Arial, about 1.29 percent. Sharp corners, no shadows, no gradients.

KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 23

**Layout**

Full-width solid navy header band across the top about 12.5% of the slide height carries the two-line white title, left-aligned at about 2% from the left edge. Below it the slide is split into two columns by a thin vertical grey divider at about 63% of the width: a bar chart with its heading and questions on the left (roughly x 6% to 59%) and a Facebook Messenger phone screenshot with heading on the right (roughly x 67% to 94%). The source and note lines sit bottom-left beside the Kleiner Perkins logo, and the running footer with page number sits bottom-right; no slide number is printed beyond 'PAGE 23' in the footer.

**Visuals**

Chart: vertical 100% stacked column chart titled 'Facebook Users', subtitle '26% that Click Ads Make Purchase, USA, 3/17'. Y axis titled '% of Respondents', linear 0% to 100% in 10% steps with light grey horizontal gridlines at each step. X axis categories: 'Clicked on an Ad', 'Didn’t Click on Ad', 'Not Sure'. Two series stacked bottom to top: 'Made a Purchase' (dark blue #00689D) and 'Did Not Make a Purchase' (green #31AF78). Labelled values: Clicked on an Ad = Made a Purchase 26% (bottom, white label), Did Not Make a Purchase 74% (top, white label); Didn’t Click on Ad = 7% (bottom, white label), 93% (top, white label); Not Sure = 10% (bottom, white label), 90% (top, white label). Legend centred below the x axis: blue square 'Made a Purchase', green square 'Did Not Make a Purchase'. No highlighted points. Bars are about 8% of slide width each, evenly spaced. Photo: a smartphone screenshot of a Facebook Messenger conversation with the business 'Original Coast Cl...' (Original Coast Clothing), framed by a thin dark grey phone outline, shown boxed not full-bleed. Blue status bar with signal, wifi, battery icons and time 12:30; blue app header with back arrow, 'Original Coast Cl...' name, 'MANAGE' label and an info circle icon. Two grey speech bubbles from the business with rounded corners and small brand avatar (orange and black logo) at left. Below is a product card with a rounded-corner photo of a man in a white button-up shirt and navy tie, cropped at the neck and head, against a dark slate-grey background, lit softly from the front; the card has the product name, details, URL, price $89.99 and a blue outlined BUY NOW button with a circular outline. Bottom of the screenshot shows a message input bar with a blue hamburger icon and 'Type a message...' placeholder. Dominant colours of the screenshot: blue #1B6FE0 header, white and light grey chat area, slate #2F3B47 photo background. Logos: Kleiner Perkins logo in green (bottom-left, stacked wordmark 'KLEINER / PERKINS'); small Original Coast brand avatar appears twice in the chat (left of the bubbles and beside the price).

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. Clean corporate report style. Header band solid navy-teal #00517A with a thin bright teal rule #1AA7B5 beneath it. Title in regular sans-serif (Arial-like) white #FFFFFF, two lines, about 4.4% of slide height per line (cap height about 3.1%). Chart and section headings in bold Arial-like sans-serif black #000000, about 3.0% of slide height; subtitles and body in regular Arial-like black, about 2.6%; questions in italic Arial-like black about 2.4%; chart axis and data labels in bold Arial-like about 2.0%; footer and source lines in regular Arial-like about 1.3% to 1.5%, footer grey #A6AAA9. Accent colours: dark blue #00689D, green #31AF78, teal #1AA7B5. Divider and gridlines light grey #D9D9D9. Shapes are square-cornered with no shadows or gradients; the Messenger card and bubbles have rounded corners.

**Layout**

Two-column layout below a full-width dark blue title band. The title sits left-aligned in the band with two lines starting at about 4.7% from the left margin. The left column (about 0% to 33%) holds a centred heading, subtitle and a boxed phone screenshot; a thin vertical grey divider at about x 33% separates it from the right column (about 34% to 98%), which holds a centred heading, subtitle and a combined bar and line chart with its legend below. The Kleiner Perkins logo sits bottom-left at about x 1.8%, with the source and note text to its right at about x 10.5%. The footer 'KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 27' sits bottom-right at about x 75.8%, y 95.4%.

**Visuals**

Chart (right column): combination chart with vertical blue columns and a red line. Chart title 'Vungle Dynamic Creative Ads', subtitle 'Improving Conversion Rates, 5/17'. Left y-axis titled 'Dynamic Creative Variations (K)', range 0 to 600 in steps of 100, unit thousands. Right y-axis titled 'Conversion Rate (%)', range 0.00% to 0.60% in steps of 0.10%. X-axis categories rotated vertical: 1/16, 2/16, 3/16, 4/16, 5/16, 6/16, 7/16, 8/16, 9/16, 10/16, 11/16, 12/16, 1/17, 2/17, 3/17, 4/17 (months, no unit printed). Series 1, Dynamic Creative Variations (blue columns, #00689D): values are not printed, so estimates: 1/16 about 5K, 2/16 about 12K, 3/16 about 25K, 4/16 about 31K, 5/16 about 39K, 6/16 about 48K, 7/16 about 53K, 8/16 about 86K, 9/16 about 101K, 10/16 about 168K, 11/16 about 219K, 12/16 about 306K, 1/17 about 347K, 2/17 about 395K, 3/17 about 452K, 4/17 about 486K. Series 2, Conversion Rate (red line, about #E30613, about 3pt): values not printed, so estimates: 1/16 about 0.28%, 2/16 about 0.27%, 3/16 about 0.28%, 4/16 about 0.30%, 5/16 about 0.32%, 6/16 about 0.36%, 7/16 about 0.37%, 8/16 about 0.36%, 9/16 about 0.35%, 10/16 about 0.41%, 11/16 about 0.46%, 12/16 about 0.45%, 1/17 about 0.45%, 2/17 about 0.43%, 3/17 about 0.46%, 4/17 about 0.47%. Legend centred below the plot: blue rectangle swatch then 'Dynamic Creative Variations', red line swatch then 'Conversion Rate', both bold black. Gridlines: light grey horizontal lines at each left-axis tick, no border. Highlighted points: none. Photo (left column): a boxed phone-app marketing montage on a dark navy and black background. Top panel shows a black-and-white photo of a crowded concert with stage lights and silhouetted hands, with overlay text 'On-demand music videos' and a white X close button at top right; a phone mockup in the centre shows a video screen with a concert image and a Lucha Fighters card. Below it are three tab labels 'Screens', 'Reviews', 'About' in white on dark grey. Middle row shows three small app screenshots (Artist page with Lucha Fighters, Events list, and a Kaboom Lounge music player with a tree-artwork album image) plus a partial fourth screen with a Home menu. Bottom panel shows an app icon (black turntable record on a blue-violet gradient), title 'Sound Machine', developer 'Soundjamz, LLC', a four-and-a-half star rating in orange, and a green button labelled 'Download'. A small white 'Vungle' wordmark appears at the bottom centre of the screenshot. The image is a full rectangle, not cropped, with a thin dark border. Logo: Kleiner Perkins wordmark in green (#3CB043) stacked as 'KLEINER' over 'PERKINS', bold sans-serif, bottom-left.

**Layout**

Two equal columns separated by a thin vertical grey divider at about 47.5% of slide width, below a full-width dark blue title band. The title is left-aligned at about 2% from the left edge, in two lines inside the band. Each column has a bold centred heading with a regular centred subtitle beneath it; the left column holds a patent line diagram of a phone and merchant criteria, the right column holds two stacked photographs. The source line sits bottom left beside the Kleiner Perkins logo, and the footer text with page number sits bottom right, with about 2% margins.

**Visuals**

Four visuals and one logo. (1) Left: a black-and-white patent line drawing, boxed by no frame, occupying about 8% to 42% horizontally and 26.7% to 91% vertically. It shows three dashed rectangles: outer dashed box 540 'MERCHANT A OBJECT CRITERIA' containing a rounded-square icon of a black coffee cup on a saucer labelled 'Coffee Brand A'; a middle dashed box 'COMMON OBJECT CRITERIA: OBJECT TYPE: COFFEE' containing a line drawing of a coffee cup on a saucer with a pastry, pointed to by reference 580; and a right dashed box 550 'MERCHANT B OBJECT CRITERIA' containing a rounded-square icon of a black steaming mug labelled 'Coffee Brand B'. Reference 545 has a curved arrow pointing to the lower edge of the outer box. A vertical double-headed arrow runs from the middle box down to a phone outline (rounded rectangle, reference 1200 at top left and 1210 at top right). Inside the phone's screen is a dashed box with the steaming mug icon and the label 'Coffee Brand B', referenced by 560, and the words 'PHOTO CONTENT' are labelled by 570 with an arrow. (2) Right top: a greyscale photograph of a long indoor aisle with dark shelving and a grey floor receding to a vanishing point at centre; overlaid are many small orange and pink dots (feature points) scattered over the walls and shelves. Lighting is flat and diffuse, dominant colours are grey and charcoal with orange accents; the image is a square crop, boxed with no border. (3) Right bottom: a point-cloud floor plan on a pure black background showing magenta, blue, green, yellow and white dotted walls forming aisle outlines; a green curved path line runs left, and a cyan-to-white fan of rays radiates from a small red dot at the centre-right, with yellow dots clustered at its origin; square crop, boxed with no border. (4) Logo: Kleiner Perkins wordmark in bold green capitals stacked on two lines.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. Clean corporate deck. The title band is dark teal-blue #00517A spanning full width across the top 12.5% of the slide, with a thin cyan rule #1BB3C9 along its bottom edge. Title text is white #FFFFFF in regular Arial-like sans-serif, roughly 4.4% of slide height, with 'Back-Ends' in italic. Column headings are bold Arial-like sans-serif in black #000000 at about 3.3% of slide height; subtitles are regular Arial-like sans-serif in black at about 2.6%. Source line is black Arial-like at about 1.3%. Footer text is grey #A6AAA9 Arial-like at about 1.5%. The divider is a light grey #D9D9D9 line about 0.3% wide. Logo is green #3DB87A. Background is white. No shadows, gradients or corner radii on the slide furniture; the patent diagram uses thin black dashed lines and black solid lines.

Series 1 'Google' is a solid red curved line rising from about 77% at 2013 to about 92% at 2015, about 93.5% at 2016 and labelled 95% at 2017 (end point marked with the label '95%' in black to the right). Series 2 'Threshold for Human Accuracy' is a constant dashed cyan line at 95%, labelled '95%' in cyan at its left end. Legend at lower right: red solid line sample followed by 'Google', then cyan dashed line sample followed by 'Threshold for Human Accuracy'. The 2017 end point where the red line meets the dashed threshold is the highlighted point; no other points are marked. Horizontal light grey gridlines at each 10% step.

### Slide 61

**Text**

UNTUCKit = Shirts… / Online-Offline Synergies in Marketing + Merchandising / Digital-Physical Feedback Loop / Deliberate Branding + Clear Messaging @ Core / Offline Engagement / Direct Touchpoints in Physical World / UNTUCKit / Online Sessions / Up >2.5x Y/Y / 8 / 7 / 6 / Sessions (MM) / 5 / 4 / 3 / 2 / 1 / 0 / 2015 / 2016 / In-Store Interactions / Intimacy + Active Dialogue / Online Storefront / Digital Merchandising Insights / KLEINER PERKINS / Source: UNTUCKit / Note: Online session defined as website visit. / KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 60

**Layout**

Two-panel slide: a left diagram panel (x 0 to about 70%) and a right chart panel (about 72% to 100%) separated by a thin light-grey vertical divider at about x 60.7%, running from about y 15.5% to y 95%. A full-width dark-teal title band across the top (0 to 12.5% height) holds a two-line left-aligned title; the title starts at x 2.2%. The left panel is a circular feedback loop: a top-centre heading, then the photos and logo at upper-centre, with two photos at the bottom-left and bottom-right of the loop. The right panel has a centred chart heading above a bar chart. Source and note sit bottom-left beside the Kleiner Perkins logo, and the footer KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 60 sits bottom-right at about y 95.4%. Left margin about 2%, right margin about 2%.

**Visuals**

Diagram: a circular loop of three curved dark-navy (#004E76) arrows with filled arrowheads, about 3 px stroke. Arrow 1 runs from the In-Store Interactions photo (left-bottom) up to the Offline Engagement photos (top-centre), with its head at about x 20%, y 32%. Arrow 2 runs from the Offline Engagement photos down-right to the Online Storefront photo, with its head at about x 62%, y 58%. Arrow 3 runs from the Online Storefront text (bottom-right) curving down-left and back to the In-Store Interactions text, with its head at about x 12%, y 80%. Photos: (a) Offline Engagement, left: a magazine spread lying on a wooden table, showing a man in a striped shirt with a watch on a wrist, cool teal and blue tones, and a corner of a watch advertisement at top; the UNTUCKit logo and untuckit.com URL are visible; the image is boxed with a hard rectangular edge. (b) Offline Engagement, right: a photo of a man in a navy vest over a light blue shirt and tie, standing before a wooden shelf or fence display, with a sign reading UNTUCKit, SHIRTS DESIGNED TO BE WORN UNTUCKED, NOW IN CHICAGO, 900 N Michigan Ave (2nd Floor), and untuckit.com; boxed, rectangular, warm brown and navy tones. (c) In-Store Interactions: a retail store interior with a navy-painted wall carrying white text, a glass display case with folded shirts, shelves of shirts and folded clothing on racks, shot straight on with a wide frame, cropped at the right edge, blue-grey and wood tones, soft even light. (d) Online Storefront: a website screenshot showing the UNTUCKit header bar at top, a product photo of a man in a dark charcoal long-sleeve half-zip shirt and dark trousers standing against a light grey backdrop, thumbnail strip of four product images, product name ALBARINO - SLATE BLUE, price $69.00, a size selector, a red-pink ADD TO CART button, and a description block; the screenshot is rectangular with a thin border. (e) The UNTUCKit logo: the word UNTUCKit in dark navy bold sans-serif with a red-maroon triangular wedge after the k, on a white field. (f) Kleiner Perkins logo at bottom-left: KLEINER over PERKINS in bold green sans-serif capitals. Chart: vertical bar chart titled Online Sessions with subtitle Up >2.5x Y/Y. Y-axis titled Sessions (MM), labelled 0 to 8 in steps of 1, light-grey horizontal gridlines at each integer. X-axis categories 2015 and 2016. Series: sessions, one series in #00689D. The 2015 bar is about 2.5 MM (about estimate, between 2 and 3, roughly 2.5). The 2016 bar is about 6.8 MM (about estimate, just below 7). No data labels, no legend, no highlighted points. Bars sit on a baseline at 0 with the 0 line slightly darker than gridlines.

**Design**

Background: plain white. Title band: dark teal-blue #00517A, full width, with a thin brighter cyan-teal rule (about #00A3B4, about 0.5% of slide height) along its bottom edge. Title text: white #FFFFFF, regular sans-serif (Arial), about 4.4% of slide height per line, two lines, line 1 'UNTUCKit = Shirts…' and line 2 the subtitle. Gridlines: light grey about #D9D9D9, about 0.1% of slide height. Divider: light grey #D9D9D9, about 0.3% width. Footer text: regular Arial, grey #A6AAA9, about 1.5%. Source and note: regular Arial, black, about 1.3%. Kleiner Perkins logo: green #3DB473 approx. Two-column layout on a white field under a full-width dark teal title band, with the title left-aligned at the top margin of about 2 percent. A thin vertical light-grey divider at about 53 percent of slide width separates the left column (product-focus panel with three stacked boxes and a fashion image grid) from the right column (bar chart), each column having a centred bold heading and a regular subtitle beneath it. The Kleiner Perkins logo sits bottom-left with the source and note lines beside it, and the footer text 'KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 62' sits bottom-right at about 95 percent height, right-aligned to about 98 percent of width.

**Visuals**

Element 1: a three-stacked set of rounded-rectangle boxes in the left column, each with a thin cyan outline and bold black centred text. Element 2: a red outlined rounded rectangle framing the first column of the fashion grid together with the trendyol logo. Element 3: a grid of eight fashion product photographs in two rows of four on a light grey panel, each photo labelled with a euro price in the lower right corner. The top-left photo in row one shows a woman in a white blazer over a yellow top against a grey backdrop, price €28. Row one column two shows a woman in a white open blazer over a black crop top, price €89. Row one column three shows a woman in a white blazer over a grey top and jeans, price €69. Row one column four shows a woman in a white blazer over a striped top and jeans, price €89. Row two column one shows a woman in an orange-red ruffled top and skirt, price €22. Row two column two shows a woman in a sleeveless red mini dress, price €69. Row two column three shows a woman in a red dress with lace trim at the neck, price €59. Row two column four shows a woman in a red halter dress, price €59. The photos are studio shots on white or light grey backgrounds, full-length, boxed with no rounding. Element 4: the trendyol.com wordmark in black with an orange '.com' tag. Element 5: a clustered column chart with four bars, in blue #00689D, on horizontal gridlines at 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10 and 12 in light grey. The vertical axis is titled 'Average Units per Active Shopper' with a range of 0 to 12 units and gridlines every 2 units. The horizontal axis shows categories 2014, 2015, 2016 and 2017 YTD. No data labels are printed; the bars read about 6.1 for 2014, about 7.1 for 2015, about 9.3 for 2016 and about 10.3 for 2017 YTD. There is no legend and no highlighted points. Element 6: the Kleiner Perkins logo in bold green letters stacked as 'KLEINER' over 'PERKINS' at bottom left.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. White background with a full-width dark teal header band (#00517A) carrying white sans-serif title text, and a thin brighter cyan rule (#00A9CE) under the band. Title text is white regular Arial-style sans-serif at about 4.3 percent of slide height; section headings are bold Arial black (#000000) at about 3.0 percent; subtitles are regular Arial black at about 2.6 percent; box labels are bold Arial black at about 2.6 percent; chart axis labels are bold Arial black at about 2.2 percent; the footer is regular Arial grey (#A6AAA9) at about 1.5 percent; source and note lines are regular Arial black at about 1.3 percent. Accents are the cyan (#00A9CE) box outlines and rule, the red (#D7191C) highlight outline, and the chart blue (#00689D). Boxes use a thin 1 pt cyan stroke with small corner radius and no fill or shadow. Gridlines are thin light grey (#D9D9D9). The vertical divider is a light grey (#D9D9D9) line about 3 pt wide.

**Layout**

Full-width dark blue title band across the top with two-line white title left-aligned at the left margin, separated by a thin teal rule beneath. Below, a vertical grey divider splits the slide: left half is a centred flow diagram of survey, bento box and two branches; right half is a stacked bar chart with a centred heading. Source line sits bottom-left beside the Kleiner Perkins logo, and the footer text with page number sits bottom-right.

**Visuals**

Flow diagram on left: a survey mockup image (a 'What's your typical weekday dress code?' question with four option buttons: Business Formal (highlighted slate blue #5B6B82 with white text), Business Casual, Casual, Fashion-forward (light grey #F2F2F2 with dark grey text)) with a dark navy arrow (#0B5A80) pointing down to a photograph of an open cardboard bento box containing a folded white shirt, a framed white card with 'MM' monogram, a tan leather card, a dark tie-like item and a small cord, viewed from above with warm brown kraft cardboard tones and soft shadow on white. Two arrows fan out from the bento box: one down-left to 'Online Shopping' with a screenshot of a product page for 'The Eliza Dress—Ripple' (Navy, $240; size buttons XS, S, M, L, XL; 'Select a Size' button; description text) showing a woman with dark curly hair wearing a black A-line dress against white, and one down-right to 'In-Store Stylist Appointments' with a circular photo of a boutique closet with green, cream and black garments on hangers and wooden shelves, warm neutral lighting, cropped to a circle. Right: vertical stacked bar chart titled 'High Growth + Retention'; y-axis 'Revenue ($MM)' from $0 to $35 in $5 steps with light grey gridlines; x-axis categories 2015 and 2016. Series: Returning Customers (dark blue #00689D) about $4.8MM in 2015 and about $19.7MM in 2016; New Customers (green #31AF78) about $3.0MM in 2015 (stack top about $7.8MM) and about $10.6MM in 2016 (stack top about $30.3MM). Legend below the chart: blue square Returning Customers, green square New Customers.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. White background. Title band dark blue #00517A across top 12.5% of height with a thin teal rule (#1FB5C9) beneath. Title and subtitle text white, Arial regular, about 4.4% of slide height. Headings in black Arial Bold about 3.0% of height; body text black Arial regular about 2.6%. Labels and axis text Arial Bold about 2.2%. Accents: dark navy arrows #00517A, chart blue #00689D, green #31AF78. Vertical divider thin light grey line. Footer text grey #A6AAA9 Arial about 1.5%. Logo in green #31AF78. Shapes square-cornered, no shadows.

### Slide 77

**Text**

…eCommerce Growth = +15% Y/Y… / Accelerating, Again, USA… / Online Retail Sales vs. Y/Y Growth, USA 2010-2016 / $450 / 20% / 18% / $400 / 16% / $350 / 14% / $300 / 12% / $250 / USA Online Retail Sales ($B) / % Y/Y Growth / 10% / $200 / 8% / $150 / 6% / $100 / 4% / $50 / 2% / $0 / 0% / 2010 / 2011 / 2012 / 2013 / 2014 / 2015 / 2016 / Source: St. Louis Federal Reserve FRED Database / KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 76

**Layout**

Full-width header band across the top of the slide (about 12.5% of height) holding a two-line left-aligned title; below it a single centred chart title and one chart occupying the middle, with a left-hand y-axis, right-hand y-axis, and year labels along the bottom. The Kleiner Perkins logo sits bottom-left at the margin, with the source line beside it, and the footer text sits bottom-right; there is no visible slide number element apart from 'PAGE 76' in the footer.

**Visuals**

Combined bar and line chart. Chart title: 'Online Retail Sales vs. Y/Y Growth, USA 2010-2016'. Left y-axis: 'USA Online Retail Sales ($B)', range $0 to $450, gridlines at $50 steps. Right y-axis: '% Y/Y Growth', range 0% to 20%, ticks every 2%. X-axis: years 2010 to 2016, categorical. Series 1, bars (#00689D, solid, no outline), estimated values because no values are printed: 2010 about $170B, 2011 about $199B, 2012 about $230B, 2013 about $260B, 2014 about $297B, 2015 about $341B, 2016 about $393B. Series 2, red line (about #FF0000, about 3pt weight, markers none) plotted on the right axis, estimated values: 2010 about 16.8%, 2011 about 17.5%, 2012 about 15.2%, 2013 about 13.4%, 2014 about 14.4%, 2015 about 15.0%, 2016 about 15.3%. Horizontal light grey gridlines (about #D9D9D9, thin) at each left-axis tick. No legend. No highlighted points. Logo: Kleiner Perkins wordmark in green (about #3CB371) bold condensed sans, stacked as two lines 'KLEINER' over 'PERKINS'.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. White background. Header band in dark teal-blue #00517A with a thin cyan rule (about #1BB3C9) along its bottom edge. Title text in white Arial regular, about 4.4% of slide height per line, left aligned. Chart title in black Arial Bold about 3.3% of height, centred. Axis tick labels and axis titles in black Arial Bold about 2.2% of height. Source line in black Arial regular about 1.3% of height. Footer in grey #A6AAA9 Arial regular about 1.5% of height, right-aligned. Bars and accent in #00689D. No shadows, gradients or corner radii.

KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 82
Source: Images: National Museum of American History (Brown Box), Wikipedia Creative Commons (Pac-Man, Atari 2600, SG-1000, SNES, N64, PS1, Xbox, PS2), Flickr
user Sham Hardy (World of Warcraft), Flickr user coneybeare (Words with Friends), ESL (ESL Logo), Twitch (Twitch Logo), Major League Gaming (MLG Logo),
Wikimedia Creative Commons (Pong), Flickr user BagoGames (eSports Stadium)
Note: In 1967 TV Game Unit #7, also known as the “Brown Box” was launched as a prototype and is considered the father of video game consoles per the National
Museum of American History.
*Zuckerberg’s Law describes the exponential growth of online social networks as per Saul Hansell in NY Times, 11/6/08.

**Layout**

Five-stage horizontal timeline across the upper-middle of a white slide: five equal rounded cards (1 Player, 2 Players, 2+ Players, Millions Online, Millions with Spectators) sit left to right with cyan arrow segments above them labelled Moore’s Law (Processing) and Zuckerberg’s Law* (Sharing). Under the cards, captions 'Solo – Living Room…' (left) and '…Many – Arena (Thousands)… Online (Millions)' (right) frame the two ends, and a bottom row holds a Pong screenshot at left, a cyan '45 Years' arrow in the centre and an arena photograph at right. The navy header bar carries a two-line title flush left at about 2% margin, the KP logo sits bottom-left, the source notes run beside it and the footer 'KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 82' sits bottom-right; there is no visible slide number other than the footer text.

**Visuals**

Timeline of five rounded-rectangle cards linked by cyan arrow segments. Card 1 '1 Player = Arcade' shows a Brown Box prototype (brown-wood casing with two grey controllers on cords) above a Pac-Man upright arcade cabinet. Card 2 '2 Players = Consoles' stacks an Atari 2600 (black woodgrain top-loader with joystick), a Sega SG-1000 (white-and-blue console with joystick) and a Nintendo NES (grey console with controller). Card 3 '2+ Players = Consoles + LAN' shows a Nintendo 64 (black console with grey controller) and a PlayStation 1 (grey console with grey controller). Card 4 'Millions of Players = Online Network' shows an Xbox (black console with controller), a PlayStation 2 (black tower with controller), a World of Warcraft box art (purple-blue character portrait with 'Battle Chest' text) and a Words with Friends phone screenshot (tiled letter grid, green-blue header). Card 5 'Millions of Players + Spectators = eSports' shows the MLG logo (white stylised eagle emblem on black rectangle), the ESL logo (blue-and-white circular emblem with 'ESL' wordmark) and the Twitch logo (purple wordmark with speech-bubble icon). Bottom-left: Pong screenshot, a black rectangle with two grey paddles, a dashed centre line and a small white ball, with blocky score digits at the top. Bottom-centre: a flat cyan right-pointing block arrow labelled '45 Years'. Bottom-right: wide photograph of a large indoor esports arena seen from the upper stands, crowd silhouetted, large screens at top, lit by red and blue stage lights; dominant colours red, blue and black; boxed, not cropped. Chart: none. Table: none.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. White background with a full-width navy header band in #00517A carrying white Arial regular title text; a thin cyan #02B5CC rule sits under the band. Body titles and labels are black (#000000) Arial bold (Helvetica-like sans-serif), the card headings in bold at about 3% of slide height; the header title is regular weight at about 4.4% of slide height. Accents are cyan #02B5CC for arrows and card outlines, and footer text is light grey #A6AAA9. Card outlines are 2-point cyan #02B5CC with corner radius about 4% of slide height and no fill or shadow; arrow shapes are flat with no gradients. Source notes are black Arial at about 1.1% of slide height.

**Layout**

Full-width dark blue title band across the top (about 12.5% of the slide height) with the left-aligned two-line white title inset about 2% from the left edge. Below it, a two-column timeline: a Gen X group on the left (1970 to 1990) and a Millennials group on the right (1990 to 2010), each with a centred bold heading above a cyan curly bracket, then a column of images per decade separated by vertical dashed cyan lines, with a 2010 to 2020 column at far right. A horizontal cyan arrow runs under the images with the year labels 1970, 1980, 1990, 2000, 2010 beneath it, left-aligned to their dashed dividers. The footer carries the Kleiner Perkins logo at bottom left, a small grey source block beside it, and the right-aligned grey footer 'KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 83' at bottom right. No slide number is separate from the footer text.

**Visuals**

Timeline diagram of 16 images and graphic marks. (1) Pong arcade cabinet, yellow bezel with black 'PONG' label on top, wood-grain brown sides, front view, upright, centred in the 1970 column, boxed on white. (2) Asteroids arcade cabinet, black cabinet with a colourful vector-style marquee, angled three-quarter view, in the 1970 column below Pong. (3) Space Invaders arcade cabinet, dark blue and yellow artwork with 'SPACE INVADERS' marquee, angled three-quarter view, bottom of 1970 column. (4) Pac-Man logo, orange rectangle with yellow and blue 'PAC-MAN' lettering, in the 1980 column top. (5) Super Mario Bros. Nintendo Entertainment System box art, black background, Mario jumping with fireball, blue brick blocks, yellow 'SUPER MARIO BROS.' lettering, Nintendo and Action Series logos, portrait, boxed. (6) John Madden Football box art, yellow 'JOHN MADDEN FOOTBALL' title, John Madden smiling and holding a football through a torn wall, dark background, C64 label, portrait, boxed. (7) EA Sports International Soccer box art (FIFA), white cover with EA SPORTS logo, two players in red and white kits on a green pitch, Sega Mega Drive label, portrait, in the 1990 column. (8) Pokémon Red and Blue Game Boy cartridges side by side, red version with Charizard and blue version with Blastoise, Game Boy labels, wide rectangle. (9) Warcraft: Orcs and Humans box art, orange-red background, orc and human faces, Blizzard logo at bottom, portrait. (10) Clash of Clans logo, gold 3D lettering with red shield and crossed arrows. (11) Minecraft logo over a grass and dirt block texture, green grass top, brown and tan blocks, square-ish image with white 'MINECRAFT' lettering. (12) League of Legends logo, gold metallic lettering on dark bronze, in the 2000 column. (14) Overwatch logo, grey and orange circular emblem with 'OVERWATCH' wordmark in dark grey, centred. (15) Pokémon Go logo, yellow and blue 'Pokémon' wordmark with a blue 'GO' and Poké Ball. (16) Cyan arrow shape along the timeline, plus dashed vertical cyan lines and two cyan curly brackets. Kleiner Perkins logo: green bold uppercase wordmark 'KLEINER PERKINS' stacked on two lines at bottom left.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. Clean white slide with a solid dark teal-blue header band #00517A and a thin cyan #02B5CC strip along its lower edge. Title text is white regular Arial-style sans-serif (Helvetica-like), about 4.4% of slide height per line, with the two lines set tight. Group headings 'Gen X' and 'Millennials' are black Arial Bold about 3.3% of slide height. Year labels are black Arial Bold about 3.0%. Footer text is grey #A6AAA9 Arial regular about 1.5%. Source text is black Arial regular about 1.3%. Accents are cyan #02B5CC for brackets, dashed dividers, and the timeline arrow. Lines are dashed cyan with uniform stroke, brackets are cyan curly braces with about 0.3% stroke. No corner radii, shadows or gradients on shapes; images are flat with no frames.

**Visuals**

Chart: combined stacked column and line chart, titled 'Gamer Demographics vs. Average Age, USA, 2003-2016'. Left y-axis titled '% of Gamers', 0% to 100% in 10% steps, gridlines light grey. Right y-axis titled 'Average Age', 0 to 40 in 5 steps. X-axis categories 2003 to 2016, one column per year, no axis title. Three stacked series per column, bottom to top: Under 18 (dark blue #00689D), 18-50 (cyan #02B5CC), 50+ (green #31AF78); each column totals 100%. Estimated segment tops (about, read from the chart, no printed values): Under 18 about 35, 36, 31, 28, 25, 25, 25, 18, 32, 32, 29, 26, 27, 29 percent for 2003 to 2016. 18-50 cumulative top about 82.5, 80.5, 75, 76, 74, 74, 74, 71, 63, 64, 61, 73, 74, 74 percent. 50+ fills to 100 percent. Logo: KLEINER PERKINS wordmark in two stacked lines, bold condensed sans, green, bottom-left.

**Layout**

A full-width dark blue title band runs across the top with a two-line white title left-aligned at about 2% margin. Below, the left column (about 2% to 58% of width) holds a centred bold chart heading above a horizontal bar chart whose category labels are right-aligned at about 20% and whose bars start at about 22%; a thin light grey vertical divider at about 60% separates a right column (about 66% to 92%) holding two stacked centred captions, each above a boxed image. The footer has the Kleiner Perkins logo at bottom left, a source and note block beside it, and the page marker 'KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 86' right-aligned at bottom right; there is no separate slide number.

**Visuals**

Horizontal bar chart titled '% of Female Players by Game Genre, Global, 1/17'. Categories top to bottom with printed values: Match 3 69%; Family / Farm Sim 69%; Casual Puzzle 42%; MMOs (Fantasy) 36%; Action Adventure 18%; MMOs (Sci-Fi) 16%; First-Person Shooter 7%; Racing 6%; Sports 2%. Value axis has no printed numeric labels; the unit is percent of female players, and the horizontal scale runs from 0% at the left axis line (about 22% of slide width) to roughly 70% at the bar end; four light grey vertical gridlines sit at about 30.6%, 39.2%, 47.8% and 56.4% of slide width. Bars are solid blue #00689D, about 2.3% of slide height tall, with equal spacing of about 6.8%. No legend and no highlighted points. Top right: a boxed screenshot captioned 'Match 3 / Pioneered by Diamond Mine / Bejeweled, 2000' showing the Diamond Mine game: a left blue panel with the DIAMOND MINE logo, a SCORE window, NEW GAME button, Skill Level 1 2 3 selector, a purple orb and an UPGRADE button, beside a grid of about 8 by 7 jewel tiles (green, yellow, orange, blue, purple, red, white) on a dark olive patterned board; BONUS is printed in green at the bottom right corner. Frontal flat screenshot, full rectangle, not cropped, bright saturated colours. Bottom right: a boxed isometric illustration captioned 'Family / Farm Sim / Pioneered by Sims, 2000' showing a cutaway suburban house on a green lawn with white picket fences: kitchen at lower left with orange floor, living room with teal sofa and armchairs and a patterned rug, bathroom at upper right with blue tiles, a bed in the upper room, purple-lavender and teal walls, two small Sim figures standing in the centre, and trees around the lawn. Daylight, bright even lighting; dominant colours green, lavender, teal and orange; full rectangle, not cropped, no overlay. Bottom left: the Kleiner Perkins logo, see elements.

**Design**

Background white #FFFFFF. Title band #00517A (dark teal blue) with a thin cyan rule #17A9C0 along its bottom edge. Title text white #FFFFFF in a regular-weight Arial/Helvetica style sans-serif, about 4.4% of slide height, single-line spacing. Chart and right-column headings in bold Arial/Helvetica black #000000 at about 3.0% of slide height; category and value labels in bold Arial black #000000 at about 2.2%; right-column subtitles in regular Arial black #000000 at about 2.6%. Accent colours: bars #00689D; logo green #3BB273 (approximate). Footer text regular Arial, source and note in black #000000 at about 1.3%, page marker in grey #A6AAA9 at about 1.5%. Shapes are square-cornered with no shadows or gradients. Gridlines are thin light grey #D9D9D9; the vertical divider is light grey #D9D9D9, about 0.2% of slide width. Photos have square corners with no border.

**Layout**

Two equal columns separated by a thin vertical grey divider at about the horizontal centre, running from just below the header to near the footer. Each column has a centred bold heading with a regular subtitle beneath, then its visual; the left column holds the Pokémon logo and a pixel-art diploma, the right column holds four stacked Skyrim screenshots. The source line sits bottom left beside the Kleiner Perkins logo, and the page label sits bottom right in grey.

**Visuals**

Left column: (1) the Pokémon logo, yellow 3D letters with blue outlines and TM marks, over the blue-outlined white-and-blue 'Gotta catch 'em all!' banner, on a white ground, unboxed. (2) A pixel-art Game Boy style diploma: lavender-pink panel with a purple checkered border and an inner white keyline, black monospaced pixel text reading Diploma / Player ASH / Congrats! This diploma certifies that you have completed your POKéDEX. / GAME FREAK, with peach dot ornaments beside the word Diploma, and a small pixel sprite of a trainer in a white cap and orange-pink outfit overlapping the lower right of the text. Right column: four full-width stacked Skyrim HUD screenshots, each a dark, muted, cinematic game frame with the title in large spaced capitals and a Level Progress bar: ARCHERY INCREASED TO 19 (level progress bar about 25% filled, value 8, dark green-grey forest background); SNEAK INCREASED TO 27 (bar about 75% filled, value 13, teal-green night background); ONE-HANDED INCREASED TO 23 (faded title, bar about 60% filled, value 1, grey stone background); DESTRUCTION INCREASED TO 43 (bar about 20% filled, value 62, warm orange fire glow at lower left on a brown stone background). Each screenshot is a rectangle with no border or rounding, butted against the next, forming one continuous stack. No charts, tables or photographs of people.

**Layout**

Two equal columns sit below a full-width dark teal header band that holds the two-line title, left-aligned at about 2 percent from the left edge. The left column (Twitch screenshot with four callout boxes) and the right column (bar and line combo chart) are separated by a thin vertical grey divider at about 47.5 percent of slide width. Each column has a bold centred heading at the top; the source line sits bottom-left beside the green KLEINER PERKINS logo, and the footer text sits bottom-right with the page number.

**Visuals**

Left: a photograph-style screenshot (about 41 percent of width, 30 percent of height, at x 3.5 y 40.3) of a Twitch channel page for streamer cherrysamora playing League of Legends. It shows the top navigation bar (name CherrySamora, tabs Videos 11, Clips, Collections, Events, Followers 2,504, purple Follow and Subscribe buttons), a large central gameplay feed with a minimap and HUD, a webcam inset of the streamer at lower left, a stream title line reading We are Pandered guys!! Cake, cake cake cake cake cake, a League of Legends tag and viewer count 501,544, and a right-hand chat column with messages from VopG, DeshTheWraith and others. The image is boxed, not cropped, with a grey frame edge; it is dominated by dark green and grey tones with purple and cyan UI accents. Four callout boxes with cyan #1BB5D5 arrows point into the screenshot: Live Streamed Gameplay points down to the gameplay feed; Subscribe to Streamer points down to the Subscribe button; Live Streamed Player Reactions points up to the webcam inset; Live Chat Interaction with Player points up to the chat column. Right: a combo chart titled Twitch Hours Streamed vs. Unique Monthly Streamers. Blue bars (Hours Streamed, B) for 2012 to 2016 with values 1.2, 2.4, 3.2, 4.0 and 4.9, labelled above or inside the bar tops (2012 and 2013 labels sit above the bar in black; 2014, 2015 and 2016 labels sit inside the bar top in white). Left y-axis Hours Streamed (B) runs 0 to 6 in steps of 1. Right y-axis Unique Monthly Streamers (MM) runs 0.0 to 2.5 in steps of 0.5. Red line series (Unique Monthly Streamers, MM) with no printed values; estimates: about 0.9 in 2013, about 1.5 in 2014, about 1.7 in 2015, about 2.2 in 2016. Light grey horizontal gridlines at each left-axis unit. Legend below the chart: blue swatch Hours Streamed, red line Unique Monthly Streamers. No highlighted points. Logo: KLEINER PERKINS wordmark in green at bottom left.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. White slide background. Header band in dark teal-blue #00517A spanning full width from top to about 12.5 percent of height, with a thin brighter cyan rule #1AA6C9 along its bottom edge. Title text white #FFFFFF in Arial regular (sans-serif), about 4.4 percent of slide height, two lines. Chart and column headings in Arial Bold black #000000 at about 3 percent of slide height; subtitle 10MM DAU, 2/17 in Arial regular black at about 2.6 percent. Callout labels in Arial Bold black at about 2.2 percent of slide height, in white rounded rectangles with cyan #1BB5D5 outlines of about 1.5 pt and corner radius about 6 px. Cyan #1BB5D5 arrows about 3 px thick with triangular heads. Bars filled #00689D, data labels Arial Bold about 2.2 percent with white or black text. Red #FF0000 line about 3 px thick. Vertical divider light grey #D9D9D9 about 0.5 pt. Source line Arial regular black about 1.3 percent of height. Footer Arial regular grey #A6AAA9 about 1.5 percent of height. Logo green #3BB273. No shadows or gradients.

KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 110

**Layout**

Two-column comparison grid with a full-width dark blue title band across the top. Left column is headed 'Early Gaming' and right column 'Mainstream Internet (Now)', each in an outlined rounded box centred over its column, joined by a double-headed teal arrow between them. Three rows labelled by year (1999, 2009, 2013) run down the left column with logos, and the right column holds the matching logos and DAU figures; a thin vertical grey divider sits at the horizontal centre and two faint slanted grey rules separate the rows. Title is left-aligned in the band with a left margin of about 2.1%. Source note sits bottom-left beside the Kleiner Perkins logo, and the footer 'KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 110' is bottom-right; there is no separate slide number field beyond that footer text.

**Visuals**

Logos and images, none are charts or tables. Left row 1 (1999): Pingwest-supplied image of the black-and-white QQ penguin mascot (standing, white belly, drawn outline) beside the black hand-drawn 'OICQ' wordmark with Chinese characters 中文网络寻呼机 beneath it. Left row 2 (2009): the Tiny Speck logo, a dark purple-navy splat/burst mark followed by 'Tiny Speck' in a dark purple-navy serif-like wordmark. Left row 3 (2013): a grey-toned photographic background (pale grey marble-like texture with dark smudges) with a centred crossed hammer and chisel icon in dark brown-black and the words 'HAMMER & CHISEL' in dark serif capitals beneath; the image is a rectangular box with hard edges, no rounding. Right row 1 (2016-17): the green WeChat app icon (rounded square, white speech bubbles, 'WeChat' label) and the Tencent QQ penguin (black body, white belly, red scarf, yellow feet, one eye winking). Right row 2: the Slack logo, a multicolour hash mark (teal, yellow, red, magenta, green) above the black lowercase 'slack' wordmark. Right row 3: the Discord logo on a flat periwinkle-blue square, white speech-bubble with blue controller face and white 'DISCORD' wordmark across the bottom, boxed without rounding. Arrow: solid teal double-headed block arrow pointing left and right, about 11.8% wide and 3.8% tall. Divider lines: light grey (#D9D9D9-ish) vertical line at x 50% from y 22% to 91%, and two light grey horizontal rules, the first from x 4% to 96% at about y 43% and the second at about y 65%, both slightly tilted. Kleiner Perkins logo: bold condensed green wordmark 'KLEINER PERKINS' stacked on two lines.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF covering the whole slide, with a #00517A header band across the top 12.5%. Clean corporate style. Full white background with a dark teal-blue header band (#00517A) across the top about 12.5% of slide height, with a thin bright cyan rule (#02B5CC) along its bottom edge. **Layout**

Two outlined pill-style header boxes sit side by side at the top of each column, joined by a double-headed teal arrow between them; a thin vertical grey divider runs down the centre from below the arrow to near the footer. Each column has a bold centred heading and a regular subheading above a landscape screenshot; the lower half of the slide below the images is empty. Source line sits bottom-left beside the Kleiner Perkins logo; the footer text and page number sit bottom-right.

**Visuals**

Two landscape photographs and one logo. Left: a screenshot from the Madden Football video game (Electronic Arts) showing a rendered American football formation on a green field in a stadium, with a scoreboard overlay reading NYG 0, DAL 0, 1ST; players in white and grey Dallas-style jerseys with blue numbers (76, 73, 53, 67, 79, 89, 60, 22, 48, 91) in the foreground and blue-jerseyed players in the background; crowd and stadium banners behind; bright saturated green turf; full-frame rectangle, not cropped. Right: a live broadcast still of a Giants NFL game from a cable TV camera showing a football play on a grass field with white yard lines; players in white Dallas jerseys (21, 22, 70, 65, 82) and blue Giants jerseys; crowd and stands behind, NBC logo at upper right and 'New York Football Giants' end-zone signage; muted olive-green and grey tones, slightly soft focus; full-frame rectangle, not cropped. Logo: Kleiner Perkins wordmark in bold green capital letters stacked on two lines at bottom-left (approximately #3DBE7A green). Also a teal double-headed arrow shape (#02B5CC) between the two header boxes, and a thin light-grey vertical divider line.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF across the full slide, with the dark teal #00517A title band across the top. White background. Title band is a solid dark teal rectangle #00517A across the top 12.5% of the slide with a thin cyan #02B5CC rule along its bottom edge. Header box labels and column headings are bold black Arial (about 3.3% and 3.0% of slide height); subheadings are regular black Arial at about 2.6%. Header pill boxes have white fill, thin cyan #02B5CC outline with square-ish corners (slight radius). Double arrow is solid #02B5CC. Divider is a thin light grey line (about #D9D9D9). Source line is black Arial about 1.3%. Footer text is light grey #A6AAA9 Arial about 1.5%, right-aligned. No shadows or gradients.

**Text**

**Layout**

A full-width navy header band across the top (about 12.5% of slide height) holds the two-line title, left-aligned at about 2% from the left edge. Below it, two columns are split by a thin vertical divider at the slide centre: left column is headed by the outlined box 'Early Gaming (1999)', right column by 'Mainstream Internet (Now)', joined by a double-headed cyan arrow between the boxes. Each column stacks a bold heading, a subheading, a logo row, and one photograph, centred in its column. A source line sits bottom-left beside the Kleiner Perkins logo, and the footer 'KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 112' is right-aligned at the bottom right. No slide number field is separate from the footer text.

**Visuals**

1) Left column, below heading: NVIDIA wordmark logo, green eye-shaped emblem followed by black uppercase 'NVIDIA' with registered mark, horizontal, on white. 2) Left column bottom: photograph of a circuit board, the NVIDIA GeForce 256-era graphics card (AGP edge connector at bottom, VGA output and blue/yellow connectors at left, a silver NVIDIA GeForce heat-spreader chip at centre-right, DDR memory chips around it). Green PCB, gold connector pins, full-colour macro-style close view, boxed as a rectangle with sharp corners, not cropped, lit evenly. 3) Right column logos: Amazon Web Services logo (orange cube mark with black 'amazon' and 'web services' text), IBM Watson logo (multicoloured globe icon with green 'IBM' and dark navy 'Watson'), Google DeepMind logo (blue swirl mark with grey 'Google' and 'DeepMind' text). 4) Right column bottom: photograph of a data centre aisle, rows of server racks with blue and white lights receding to a vanishing point in the centre, dark grey ceiling and floor, blue dominant colour, sharp rectangle, not cropped, boxed. 5) Double-headed cyan arrow between the two headline boxes. 6) Thin light grey vertical divider line at slide centre from below the headings to near the footer. 7) Kleiner Perkins logo bottom-left: bold green uppercase 'KLEINER / PERKINS' stacked wordmark.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF, with the navy #00517A header band across the top. Clean corporate style. Background white #FFFFFF. Header band navy-teal #00517A with a thin cyan #02B5CC rule along its bottom edge. Title text white #FFFFFF, regular weight, Arial/Helvetica-style sans-serif, about 4.4% of slide height. Headline box labels bold black #000000 Arial-Bold, about 3.3% of height, inside thin cyan #02B5CC outlined rectangles with square corners and no fill. Column headings bold black #000000 about 3.0% of height. Subheadings regular black #000000 about 2.6% of height. Source line black #000000 about 1.3% of height. Footer grey #A6AAA9 about 1.5% of height. Accent colour cyan #02B5CC for arrow and box outlines. Divider light grey #D9D9D9, about 0.1% width. No shadows or gradients.

KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 136

**Layout**

Three-chart layout on a white slide: a full-width dark blue title band across the top with a thin teal rule under it. Below, a large left column holds one bar chart (Unity), and the right column is split horizontally by a thin grey rule into an upper bar chart (Roblox) and a lower line chart (Steam), with a thin grey vertical divider between the columns. Each chart title is centred over its chart. The source lines sit bottom-left beside the Kleiner Perkins logo, and the footer text sits bottom-right; no slide number beyond the footer's 'PAGE 136'.

**Visuals**

Three charts. (1) Bar chart, title 'Unity = Registered Developers', vertical axis titled 'Registered Developers (MM)' ranging 0 to 7 in steps of 1, horizontal categories 10/09, 10/10, 5/11, 11/11, 4/12, 7/13, 8/14, 3/16, 7/16, 9/16. Values: 10/09 about 0.01, 10/10 about 0.25, 5/11 about 0.5, 11/11 about 0.75, 4/12 about 1.0, 7/13 about 2.0, 8/14 about 2.9, 3/16 about 4.5, 7/16 about 5.5, 9/16 about 6.0; the axis values are not printed on the bars, so these are estimates. Single series, bars #00689D, no legend, no highlighted points, gridlines light grey horizontal at each integer. Category labels are rotated about 45 degrees. (2) Bar chart, title 'Roblox = Monthly Active Users', vertical axis titled 'MAU (MM)' ranging 0 to 60 in steps of 10, categories May-16, Jun-16, Dec-16, Mar-17. Values: May-16 about 12, Jun-16 about 15, Dec-16 about 30, Mar-17 about 48; bars #00689D, no legend, no labels on bars. (3) Line chart, title 'Steam = Peak Concurrent Users*', vertical axis titled 'Peak Concurrent Users (MM)' ranging 0 to 15 in steps of 5, horizontal axis labelled 9/08, 9/09, 9/10, 9/11, 9/12, 9/13, 9/14, 9/15, 9/16 with monthly points between. Single red (#FF0000) line about 3 px thick, values about 1.3 at 9/08, about 2 in 9/09, about 4 at 9/11, about 6 at 9/12, about 7.5 at 9/13, about 9 at 9/15, about 11.5 at 9/16, peak about 13.5 near the end then about 13; values are estimates since none are printed; no markers, no legend. Logo: KLEINER PERKINS wordmark in green stacked capitals.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. Clean corporate report style on white. Title band fill #00517A with white (#FFFFFF) title text in regular Arial-style sans-serif, about 4.4 percent of slide height per line. Chart titles and axis labels in bold Arial, black #000000, about 3.0 percent of slide height for chart titles and 2.2 for tick labels. Bars #00689D, line #FF0000, gridlines light grey about #D9D9D9, 0.75 pt. Source text in regular Arial about 1.3 percent, black. Footer text in regular Arial about 1.5 percent, grey #A6AAA9. Teal rule under band about #1BB5CC. Shapes have square corners, no shadows, no gradients.

Eight rounded-rectangle cards with thin cyan outlines, each holding a bold year label, an image or logo, and a bold black caption. (2) 1980 Atari World Championships arcade poster: the boxed ATARI logo at top on a cream badge, Space Invaders style alien ships and characters in red, purple and gold, a red-orange banner reading '$50,000.00' with 'CASH 4 PRIZES' beneath, dominant red and dark tones. (6) 2009 League of Legends logo: gold metallic letters on a dark green-black ground, boxed with soft edges. (7) 2012 OGN logo: large dark grey and teal letters 'OGN' with a small globe icon at upper right and 'OGN GLOBAL' below, on a light grey gradient panel. (8) 2016 League of Legends World Championship: gold 'LEAGUE of LEGENDS' wordmark and 'WORLD CHAMPIONSHIP' line on a dark navy #1B2433 panel with the Worlds emblem at top, boxed. ### Slide 143

**Text**

eSports League of Legends Championship Viewers @ 43MM… / +19% Y/Y / League of Legends World Championship Global Viewership / Largest eSports Viewer Base / Total Unique Viewers vs. Peak Concurrent Viewers / 50 / 45 / 43 / 40 / 36 / 35 / 32 / 30 / 27 / 25 / Viewers (MM) / 20 / 14 / 15 / 15 / 11 / 9 / 10 / 8 / 5 / 2 / 1 / 0 / 0 / 2011 / 2012 / 2013 / 2014 / 2015 / 2016 / Total Unique Viewers / Peak Concurrent Viewers / Source: Engadget, Polygon, The Verge, eSports Marketing, LoLeSports / KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 142

**Layout**

Full-width dark blue header band across the top about 12.5% of slide height with the two-line title left-aligned in white at about 2% margin, a thin teal rule under it, then a centred three-line chart heading block (bold title, regular subtitle, bold chart title) above a single full-width bar and line chart with a y-axis on the left and a horizontal legend beneath the x-axis. Bottom-left has the Kleiner Perkins logo with a small source line beside it; bottom-right has a grey footer reading KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 142; no slide number other than the footer text.

**Visuals**

Chart: combined column and line chart. Chart title 'Total Unique Viewers vs. Peak Concurrent Viewers' (bold, above plot). Above it a heading 'League of Legends World Championship Global Viewership' with subtitle 'Largest eSports Viewer Base'. Y-axis titled 'Viewers (MM)', range 0 to 50, major gridlines every 5, light grey #D9D9D9 horizontal lines, tick labels bold black. X-axis categories 2011, 2012, 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016 (no axis title). Series 1, Total Unique Viewers, dark blue #00689D columns with printed values above each column: 2011 = 2, 2012 = 8, 2013 = 32, 2014 = 27, 2015 = 36, 2016 = 43 (millions). Series 2, Peak Concurrent Viewers, red #FF0000 line about 3 pt wide with markers absent, printed values placed on the line in white or black bold: 2011 = 0 (label 0 printed below/at left of point), 2012 = 1, 2013 = 9, 2014 = 11, 2015 = 14, 2016 = 15. Legend centred below the x-axis: blue square swatch followed by 'Total Unique Viewers', then red line swatch followed by 'Peak Concurrent Viewers'. No highlighted points. Kleiner Perkins logo: bold green wordmark 'KLEINER PERKINS' stacked on two lines at bottom-left, green about #3CB371. No photographs, icons or other graphics.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. White background #FFFFFF. Top header band filled #00517A (dark teal blue) with a thin cyan rule #00A9B8 directly beneath it at about 12.5% height. Title text white #FFFFFF in Arial regular, about 4.3% of slide height. Chart headings black #000000 in Arial Bold (main heading about 3.3% of height, chart title about 3.0%), subtitle regular black about 2.6%. Column fill #00689D; line #FF0000; gridlines #D9D9D9; axis tick labels bold black about 2.2% of height; data labels bold, white on the columns and black above them. Footer and source text small, footer grey #A6AAA9 about 1.5%, source black about 1.3%. Shapes are square-cornered with no shadows or gradients.

**Layout**

Two rows of rounded cards sit below a full-width dark teal title band, with the title left-aligned at the top-left margin. Four cards form the top row and three form the bottom row, separated by a horizontal teal arrow bar carrying the centred bold label 'Expanding Connections with Sports / Media Platforms'. The source line sits bottom-left beside the Kleiner Perkins logo, and the footer 'KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 145' sits bottom-right.

**Visuals**

Seven cards each contain one or more images. (1) Photograph of a packed indoor arena at night, crowd silhouetted in blue and red light, with a large white FC Schalke 04 'S04' roundel centred in front; boxed, unrounded, no border. (2) Dark photograph of players in silhouette on a black background, with three team emblems in a row: a white and gold circular emblem at left, the Philadelphia 76ers blue and red circular logo with '76ers' and a basketball at centre, and a gold shield with a lion at right; boxed. (3) Logo panel: Riot Games logo (red stylised 'Riot' lettering, spaced black 'GAMES' below) above League of Legends logo (gold-brown lettering with leaves); beside it, a navy banner reading BAMTECHNOLOGIES above the mlbam logo (blue batter silhouette and blue lowercase 'mlbam'). (4) Photograph of a Miami Heat basketball court floor, yellow-orange hardwood with red key outline and red flame logo, split diagonally, with the grey and white Misfits rabbit mascot in red mask and red MISFITS wordmark at right. (5) Photograph of a black, white and orange soccer ball on dark green grass against a dark background; 'FIFA 17' white logo at right with small Fnatic and AS Roma crest logos below it; cropped boxed image. (6) Logo panel inside a thin black-outlined rectangle: NBA logo (blue, red and white basketball player silhouette) at left, red 2K logo at top right, and black spaced 'eLEAGUE' below. (7) Facebook wordmark in white lowercase on a #3B5998 blue rectangle above the ESL logo (black circle with blue diagonal stripes and bold black 'ESL'). Kleiner Perkins logo: stacked green 'KLEINER' over 'PERKINS' wordmark at bottom-left. A thin teal rule runs beneath the title band.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. Clean corporate slide on white with a dark teal title band (#00517A) and a bright cyan accent (#02B5CC). Title text is white, regular-weight Arial-style sans-serif at about 4.4% of slide height, left aligned. Card titles and centre label are bold black Arial-style sans-serif, card titles about 2.6% of slide height and the centre label about 3.0%. Source line is about 1.3% and footer about 1.5%, both light sans-serif, footer in grey #A6AAA9. Card outlines are thin cyan #02B5CC strokes with generously rounded corners and no fill or shadow. The arrow bar is a flat cyan #02B5CC band with a triangular arrowhead at right, no shadow.
