**Layout**

Full-width header band across the top about 12.5% of the slide height holds the two-line white title left-aligned at about 2% margin. Below it a single centred bold chart title sits above a horizontal bar chart whose category labels are right-aligned in a column left of a thin vertical axis line, with bars extending rightwards and value labels just past each bar end. The footer has the Kleiner Perkins logo at bottom-left, a three-line source and note block beside it, and the right-aligned grey running footer 'KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 154' at bottom-right.

**Visuals**

Horizontal bar chart, no chart border or gridlines. Chart title: 'Reasons for Cutting Pay-TV Service, Q4:16' in bold black. No x-axis or y-axis numeric scale; values are printed as data labels. Category labels top to bottom with data labels: Too Expensive 80%; Use an Internet Streaming Service 48%; Use Antenna to Get Basic Channels 27%; Like to Binge Entire Seasons via Streaming 19%; Dropped Cable Upon Moving / Relocating 13%; Bulk of Viewing is Streaming Service Original Content 11%. Single series, all bars the same blue #00689D, no highlighted points, no legend. Bars are approximately proportional to values, with bar lengths about 40.0% (80%), 24.1% (48%), 13.6% (27%), 9.2% (19%), 6.4% (13%) and 5.6% (11%) of slide width. Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. White background with a dark teal-blue header band #00517A across the top 12.5% of the slide with a thin bright cyan rule along its bottom edge (approx #1BB3C6). **Layout**

Full-width dark blue title band across the top of the slide with the title left-aligned and vertically centred in the band, a thin teal rule under the band, then a centred two-line chart heading above a single combo line chart that fills the central area. Left and right value axes are titled vertically. A horizontal legend sits centred below the x-axis labels. The Kleiner Perkins logo sits bottom-left at the margin, with the source lines beside it; the footer text 'KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 158' sits bottom-right, right-aligned. Margins are about 2 percent on the left and right.

**Visuals**

Chart: combination line chart, two series. Chart title (bold): 'Spotify Subscribers (MM), 2008 – 2016*, Global'; subtitle: 'Q4:16 Monthly ARPU = €5.80 ($6.10)'. Left y-axis: 'Spotify Paid Subscribers (MM)', range 0 to 60 MM, ticks every 10. Right y-axis: 'Spotify as % of Global Music Revenue', range 0% to 30%, ticks every 5%. X-axis categories: 2008, 2009, 2010, 2011, 2012, 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016*. Series 1, solid green line (Spotify Paid Subscribers (MM)), no printed data labels; estimated values: about 0 (2008), about 0 (2009), about 0.7 (2010), about 2.5 (2011), about 5.5 (2012), about 9 (2013), about 16 (2014), about 28 (2015), 50 (2016*, the line ends at the 50 gridline). Series 2, dashed blue line (Share of Global Music Revenue (%)), no printed data labels; estimated values: about 0% (2008), about 0% (2009), about 0.5% (2010), about 1.3% (2011), about 3% (2012), about 5.6% (2013), about 8.2% (2014), about 13.3% (2015), about 19% (2016*). Legend: centred below the x-axis, solid green line sample followed by 'Spotify Paid Subscribers (MM)', then dashed blue line sample followed by 'Share of Global Music Revenue (%)'. No highlighted points. Gridlines light grey horizontal at each left-axis tick. Logo: KLEINER PERKINS wordmark, bold condensed sans-serif capitals, in green, two lines stacked, bottom-left.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. White background #FFFFFF. Title band fill #00517A (dark blue) spanning full width at the top 12.5 percent of the slide, with a teal rule #17B2C9 along its lower edge. Title text white #FFFFFF in regular-weight Arial (sans-serif), about 4.07 percent of slide height, large relative to body. Chart heading in Arial Bold, #0D0D0D, about 3.33 percent of slide height. Subtitle in regular Arial, #000000, about 2.78 percent. Axis tick labels and axis titles in Arial Bold, #0D0D0D or #000000, about 2.22 percent. Legend in Arial Bold #000000, about 1.84 percent. Footer and source lines in Arial regular, about 1.29 to 1.49 percent; footer text in grey #A6AAA9. Series colours: green #2EAE72 solid line about 3 px wide; blue #0B5E96 dashed line about 3 px wide with long dashes. Gridlines #D9D9D9 hairline. No shadows, gradients or rounded corners.

Note: Netflix subscription DVD service launched 9/1998. Data before Q3 2001 represents all subscribers because paid subscribers not broken
out. Netflix split streaming subs from DVD subs in Q3 2011; graph shows only streaming subs thereafter. ARPU shown ex-DVD.

**Layout**

Full-width dark blue header band across the top 12.5% of the slide carrying a two-line left-aligned title with a thin cyan rule under it. Below, a centred bold chart heading and a centred subtitle sit above a single full-width line chart with a left y-axis (subscribers, 0 to 100), a right y-axis (quarterly revenue, $0 to $3,000), and a rotated year axis at the bottom running 1999 to 2017. A centred legend sits under the x-axis. Bottom-left has the Kleiner Perkins logo beside a small source and note block; bottom-right has the right-aligned footer 'KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 161'. Left and right margins are about 2 percent of width; no slide number other than the footer page label.

**Visuals**

Line chart titled 'Netflix Subscribers (MM) & Quarterly Revenue ($MM), 2/99 – 3/17, Global' with subtitle 'Q1:17 Streaming ARPU per Month = $9.14'. X-axis: calendar years 1999 to 2017, labels rotated about 45 degrees, one label per year, spanning 2/99 to 3/17. Left y-axis: 'Netflix Paid Subscribers (MM)', range 0 to 100 in steps of 20, gridlines at each step. Right y-axis: 'Netflix Quarterly Revenue ($MM)', range $0 to $3,000 in steps of $600 (labelled $0, $600, $1,200, $1,800, $2,400, $3,000), gridlines aligned to left axis. Series 1: 'Netflix Paid Subscribers (MM)', light green line, about 0 in 1999 rising slowly to about 6 by 2007, about 20 by late 2011, about 38 by early 2014, about 80 by early 2016 and about 95 at 3/17 (95MM is also stated in the title). A visible dip near 1/12 to about 21 before recovering. Series 2: 'Netflix Quarterly Revenue ($MM)', dark blue line, about $0 in 1999 rising to about $300 by 2007, about $700 by late 2011, about $800 near 2012, about $1,150 by 2014, about $2,000 by 2016 and about $2,600 at 3/17 (no value printed; estimates). The two series cross near 2013. Three annotation markers: black dashed vertical lines at 9/99 (x of 1999 start), 1/07 (about 2007.1) and 9/11 (about 2011.7), each extending from the top of the 80-gridline region down to the x-axis, with bold date labels and regular descriptive labels above them. Legend below the x-axis: green line sample with 'Netflix Paid Subscribers (MM)' and dark blue line sample with 'Netflix Quarterly Revenue ($MM)'. No highlighted points. Kleiner Perkins logo: stacked bold green wordmark 'KLEINER' over 'PERKINS' at bottom left.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. Clean corporate chart slide. Header band #00517A (dark teal blue) with a thin cyan rule about #1AA7C8 along its lower edge. Background white #FFFFFF. Header title white #FFFFFF, Arial regular (sans-serif), about 3.9 percent of slide height, two lines with ellipses. Chart heading in Arial Bold, near-black #0D0D0D, about 3.3 percent of height; subtitle Arial regular, #0D0D0D, about 2.8 percent. Axis tick labels and legend in Arial Bold, black #000000 and #0D0D0D, about 2.2 percent of height. Annotation labels Arial regular black, date labels Arial Bold black, about 2.2 percent. Gridlines light grey #D9D9D9, thin (about 1 px). Dashed annotation lines black, about 2 px, dash about 8 px. Green series #3DB27A, about 3 px stroke. Blue series #1B6CA8, about 3 px stroke. Source and note text Arial regular black about 1.3 percent. Footer grey #A6AAA9 Arial regular about 1.5 percent. Logo green #2BA86A. No shadows, no gradients, no rounded corners.

**Layout**

Full-width dark blue header band across the top about 12.5% of the slide height holds a two-line left-aligned white title starting at about 2.1% from the left edge, with a thin teal rule along the band's bottom edge. Below, a centred two-line chart heading sits above a line chart plotted in the middle of the slide with a left y-axis (Netflix paid subscribers), a right y-axis (share of USA home entertainment revenue), year labels on the bottom axis and a centred legend beneath. The footer holds a Kleiner Perkins logo at bottom left, three lines of left-aligned source and note text beside it, and a right-aligned grey footer label 'KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 162'; there is no slide number outside that footer label.

**Visuals**

One line chart. Type: line chart with two series on dual y-axes. Chart title: 'Netflix Subscribers, 2009 – 2017*, Global'; subtitle: 'Q1:17 Streaming ARPU per Month = $9.14'. Left y-axis: 'Netflix Paid Subscribers (MM)', range 0 to 100 in steps of 20, no units beyond MM. Right y-axis: 'Share of USA Home Entertainment Revenue (%)', range 0% to 50% in steps of 10%. X-axis: years 2007 to 2017*, one tick per year, the 2017 tick marked with an asterisk. Series 1: solid green line (Netflix Paid Subscribers (MM)) with no printed data labels; values are estimates read against the left axis: 2007 about 7.4, 2008 about 9.1, 2009 about 11.8, 2010 about 18.2, 2011 about 21.6, 2012 about 30.4, 2013 about 41.1, 2014 about 54.1, 2015 about 70.8, 2016 about 89.1, 2017* about 95.1. Series 2: dashed dark blue line (Share of USA Home Entertainment Revenue (%)) with no printed data labels; it begins at 2012 and values are estimates read against the right axis: 2012 about 12%, 2013 about 15%, 2014 about 19%, 2015 about 22.5%, 2016 about 28%, 2017* about 31%. Legend: centred beneath the x-axis, a green solid line sample followed by 'Netflix Paid Subcribers (MM)' (spelled this way on the slide), then a blue dashed line sample followed by 'Share of USA Home Entertainment Revenue (%)'. Annotations: two vertical black dashed lines (about 2pt stroke, dash pattern) rising from the x-axis to just below the 100 gridline; the first at the 2007 position just after the axis start, labelled '1/07 Streaming Launch' in bold date and regular label; the second at about the 2011.7 position between 2011 and 2012, labelled '9/11 DVD / Streaming Split'. Highlighted points: none. Gridlines: light grey horizontal lines at 20, 40, 60, 80 and 100 on the left axis, drawn across the plot area. Logo: Kleiner Perkins wordmark, bold condensed green letters stacked as 'KLEINER' over 'PERKINS', colour about #2BAA6E. No photographs, icons or tables.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF covering the entire slide, with a dark blue #00517A header band across the top 12.5%. White background. ### Slide 175

**Text**

…# TV Channels Watched <10% of Channels Received… | Pay TV ARPU 10-15x > Netflix… | Average TV Channels Received vs. | Watched per Household, USA, 2008-2016 | Annual ARPU, Selected Platforms, 2016 | 250 | 200 | 150 | 100 | 50 | 0 | Total TV Channels Received in USA | 25% | 20% | 15% | 10% | 5% | 0% | % Watched | 2008 | 2009 | 2010 | 2011 | 2012 | 2013 | 2014 | 2015 | 2016 | DirecTV | $1,439 | Charter | $1,131 | Dish | $1,064 | Comcast | $997 | Netflix | $103 | Pay TV | Digital Platforms | TV Channels Received | % Channels Watched | Source: Nielsen, Matthew Ball & Tal Shachar, REDEF Original 3/9/16, DirecTV, AT&T, Charter, Dish Network, Comcast | Note: TV channel data as of mid-year. DirecTV ARPU calculated by dividing the 2016 Video Entertainment revenue by the average number of Linear Video Connections during 2016. Charter ARPU calculated by dividing 2016 Video revenue by average Video Residential Primary Service Units during 2016. Dish Network ARPU calculated by multiplying the 2016 Pay-TV Average Monthly Revenue per Subscriber by 12. Comcast ARPU calculated by dividing the 2016 Residential Video revenue by the average Video Customers in 2016. Netflix ARPU is based off the Global Streaming revenue and average subscribers in 2016. All estimates are global. | KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 174

**Layout**

Full-width header band across the top with the two-line title left-aligned in white at the left margin, a thin cyan rule beneath it, and two charts in side-by-side columns below: a dual-axis column and line chart on the left (about 45% of width) and a horizontal bar chart on the right (about 35% of width) with its legend in the lower right. Chart titles are centred bold above each chart; the footer sits at the bottom with the Kleiner Perkins logo at lower left, a source and note block beside it, and the 'KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 174' footer at lower right.

**Visuals**

Chart 1 (left): combined column and line chart. Title: 'Average TV Channels Received vs. Watched per Household, USA, 2008-2016'. Left y-axis 'Total TV Channels Received in USA', range 0 to 250, gridlines every 50, no unit label. Right y-axis '% Watched', range 0% to 25%, ticks every 5%. X-axis categories 2008 to 2016, labels rotated about 45 degrees. Series 1, blue columns, 'TV Channels Received', values about: 2008 129, 2009 137, 2010 151, 2011 168, 2012 179, 2013 189, 2014 197, 2015 208, 2016 206 (estimates, no values printed). Series 2, red line with markers absent, '% Channels Watched', values about: 2008 13.5%, 2009 13.0%, 2010 11.8%, 2011 10.5%, 2012 10.0%, 2013 9.2%, 2014 10.6%, 2015 9.6%, 2016 9.6% (estimates, no values printed). Legend below the chart: blue bar swatch 'TV Channels Received' and red line swatch '% Channels Watched'. No highlighted points. Chart 2 (right): horizontal bar chart. Title 'Annual ARPU, Selected Platforms, 2016'. Categories top to bottom with printed values: DirecTV $1,439; Charter $1,131; Dish $1,064; Comcast $997; Netflix $103. Pay TV bars blue, Netflix bar teal (Digital Platforms). Value labels printed at the bar ends in bold black. No axis numbers; thin grey vertical baseline at the category origin. Legend lower right: blue square 'Pay TV', teal square 'Digital Platforms'. Logo: Kleiner Perkins wordmark in green, two lines 'KLEINER' over 'PERKINS', bottom left.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. Clean white content area with a dark teal header band; accents in cyan and blue. Title text is white regular sans-serif (Arial) about 4.1% of slide height. Chart titles and all chart labels are bold Arial in black, about 2.2 to 3.0% of slide height. Footer and notes in regular Arial, about 1.1% of height; the footer tag in light grey. Bars are flat blue #00689D with no outlines or shadows; the line is a thick red #E8141B stroke. Header band is flat #00517A with a thin cyan #1AB5C9 rule beneath. No gradients, shadows, or corner radii.

**Layout**

Full-width navy header band across the top with a two-line left-aligned title in white, a thin teal rule under it, and two side-by-side bar charts divided by a thin vertical grey rule at about x 49.5%. The left chart occupies the left half and the right chart the right half, each with a bold centred heading and italic subtitle, with the category axis and legend below each chart. The Kleiner Perkins logo sits bottom-left with a two-line source and note beside it, and the footer text 'KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 182' sits bottom-right; no slide number beyond that footer text. Margins are about 2% on the left and right.

**Visuals**

Two grouped vertical bar charts. Left chart: title 'Public Cloud Adoption, 2016 vs. 2017', subtitle '% of Respondents Running Applications'; categories AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, IBM; series 2016 (dark blue #00689D) and 2017 (green #31AF78); no axis titles or axis numbers printed; value labels: AWS 2016 57%, AWS 2017 57%; Azure 2016 20%, Azure 2017 34%; Google Cloud 2016 10%, Google Cloud 2017 15%; IBM 2016 7%, IBM 2017 8%. Bar heights are proportional to value on a common baseline with no printed scale; the 57% bars are the tallest, reaching about 66% of the plot height. Legend below the chart: square markers, 2016 (blue) and 2017 (green). No highlighted points. Right chart: title 'Public Cloud Adoption, 2017', subtitle '% of Respondents Running, Experimenting, or Planning to Use Applications'; categories AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, IBM; three series: Running Apps (dark blue #00689D), Experimenting (green #31AF78), Planning to Use (cyan #02B5CC). Labelled values: AWS Running Apps 57%, Experimenting 17%, Planning to Use 10%; Azure Running Apps 34%, Experimenting 21%, Planning to Use 12%; Google Cloud Running Apps 15%, Experimenting 17%, Planning to Use 13%; IBM Running Apps 8%, Experimenting 9%, Planning to Use 8%. Legend below in bold: Running Apps, Experimenting, Planning to Use with square markers. No axis scale or highlighted points. Logo: Kleiner Perkins wordmark in green, two stacked lines, bottom-left.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF.

The KP logo sits bottom-left with the source line beside it, and the footer text is right-aligned bottom-right with no slide number field beyond the printed 'PAGE 185'.

**Visuals**

Four product visuals and one logo. (1) Rubrik: a silver laptop with a dark navy dashboard UI; left sidebar with menu items (DASHBOARD, SLA DOMAINS, VM PROTECTION, LIVE MOUNTS, SYSTEM, REPORTS); cards labelled Overview (34K VMs Protected, 509 VMs Unprotected), SLA Domains (Gold, Platinum), Activity list with timestamps, System card with a teal ring gauge reading 25 TB, and small line sparkline charts. Flat studio lighting, white background, full laptop shown, not cropped. (2) Stripe: a black tablet at left showing a Cotton Bureau page, a central floating white Stripe checkout popup with a pink Dribbble ball logo, 'Dribbble' and 'Pro Account 1 Year' text, fields Email, Card number, MM / YY, CVC, a Remember me checkbox and a blue button reading 'Pay $20.00'; at right a blue-framed phone showing a Humble Bundle page with a 'Pay $50.00' button. The popup overlaps both devices. (3) Looker: a silver laptop showing a Looker dashboard titled Shipping Logistics & Operations. Left bar chart 'Order Shipment Status' with green, red and yellow stacked bars, y axis 0 to 60, legend Complete (green), Processing (red), Shipped (yellow). Below it a map titled 'Open Orders - Where do we need to ship?' of the USA with green and yellow lines. Right table 'Open Orders >3 Days Old - Immediate Action Required' with columns Order ID, Name, Email, Created Date. A floating ACTIONS menu lists Email this customer, Update Salesforce record, Chat about this in Slack, Send invoice via Netsuite, Update Zendesk ticket. (4) CloudHealth: a dashboard screenshot with title 'Simple Cross-Cloud Dashboard (AWS/Azure/GCP/Data center)', two KPI tables on teal cells (AWS Cost: $145,657.52 Current, $222,141.79 Last Month, $246,707.50 Projected for Month, 601 (54) EC2 RIs; Azure Cost: $1,487.21 Current, $1,657.48 Last Month, $2,542.08 Projected for Month, ($4,345.64) Burndown Balance), and two stacked bar charts: 'AWS Cost History by Function' with y axis $ 0 to 400K and x axis May 2016 to May 2017 in months, and 'Azure Cost History by Function' with y axis Total Cost ($) 0K to 6K and x axis May 2016 to May 2017 in months, a navy and teal palette with orange and red segments and a negative bar near Mar 2017 in the AWS chart. (5) Logo: KP (Kleiner Perkins) wordmark in green, bottom-left.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. White background with a deep teal-navy header band #00517A and a thin cyan rule under it. Title text white #FFFFFF in Arial regular, about 4.4% of slide height per line. Headings Arial Bold #000000 about 2.6% of slide height. Body text Arial regular #000000 about 2.2%. Source line Arial regular #000000 about 1.3%. Footer Arial regular #A6AAA9 about 1.5%. Accent colours: header #00517A, KP logo green about #3DB47E, rules light grey about #B3B3B3. **Layout**

Full-width dark blue title band across the top with two left-aligned title lines starting at about 2% from the left edge. Below it, a centred bold subtitle sits above a horizontal teal timeline with two year labels, and a five-row comparison grid runs down the slide: logo in the left column, 2010-2012 ratio in a centre column, 2017 ratio in a right column, with light grey horizontal rules between rows. Source and note lines sit bottom-left beside the Kleiner Perkins logo, and the page footer sits bottom-right; no slide number is a separate element beyond the footer text.

**Visuals**

Five company logos in the left column: Atlassian (wordmark with a blue stylised X mark, in blue tones), Dropbox (blue open-box diamond mark with the word Dropbox in blue), IBM (blue striped letters IBM), Intercom (blue rounded square with white bars and smile mark, next to blue INTERCOM wordmark), LinkedIn (black Linked wordmark followed by a blue square 'in' tile). A teal timeline arrow runs from a filled teal dot at the 2010-2012 label to a teal arrowhead under the 2017 label. A small green Kleiner Perkins logo sits bottom-left. No chart axes or series; data is presented as text ratios: Atlassian 1 designer : 25 developers (2010-2012) and 1 designer : 9 developers (2017); Dropbox N/A and 1 designer : 6 developers; IBM 1 designer : 72 developers and 1 designer : 8 developers, with On Mobile – 1 designer : 3 developers; Intercom N/A and 1 designer : 5 developers; LinkedIn 1 designer: 11 developers and 1 designer : 8 developers.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. Clean corporate look on a white field. Title band is dark teal-blue #00517A with a thin lighter cyan rule beneath it (about #00A9C5). Title text is white regular sans-serif (Arial/Helvetica style), about 4.4% of slide height. Subtitle and year labels are black bold Arial/Helvetica, about 3.0% of slide height. Body ratio text is black regular Arial/Helvetica about 2.2% of slide height. Timeline and accents are teal #17B2C9. Row rules are light grey #D9D9D9, about 0.15% thick. Footer text is small black Arial for source and note lines and grey #A6AAA9 Arial for the page footer. Kleiner Perkins logo is green #3BB273. No shadows, gradients or rounded corners on the content shapes.

**Layout**

Full-width dark blue header band across the top 12.5% of the slide with a thin teal rule beneath it. The two-line centered statement sits in the middle of the white body area, roughly between 41% and 58% of the height. Kleiner Perkins logo sits bottom-left at about 1.8% margin; the footer line sits bottom-right, right-aligned to about 2% margin. No title placeholder; the header band is empty.

Kleiner Perkins wordmark logo, bottom-left, set in two stacked lines 'KLEINER' over 'PERKINS' in a bold condensed sans-serif in green (about #3BB77A), roughly 164 by 96 pixels. Otherwise there are no charts, photographs or diagrams; the only other non-text visual is the flat header band and thin teal rule. The arrow in the middle line is a single right-pointing arrow glyph (Wingdings) between 'More Applications' and 'More Vulnerabilities'.

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. Clean corporate flat design. Header band is solid #00517A (deep teal blue) across the full width with a thin bright teal stripe (about #00A9B5) along its bottom edge. Background is plain white. Main statement is set in Arial Bold Italic, black #000000, sentence case, left/center aligned as centered text. Line 1 'Security =' is slightly larger (about 6.3% of slide height) than line 2 (about 5.9%). Footer is Arial regular, light grey #A6AAA9, all caps, about 1.5% of slide height. No shadows, gradients, corner radii or rounded shapes.

X-axis categories 2008 to 2016, one per year. Series 1 is a blue bar series labelled China Mobile Internet Users; the bars are about 118 (2008), 233 (2009), 302 (2010), 355 (2011), 420 (2012), 500 (2013), 556 (2014), 619 (2015) and 694 (2016) MM; no bar values are printed, so these are estimates marked about. Highlighted point: a red outlined ellipse encircles the right-axis label 10% at the right edge, enclosing the 2016 growth end of the line. Also visible: Kleiner Perkins green wordmark logo (bottom left) and Hillhouse Capital logo (red square with white HILLHOUSE text and a white vertical bar, beside black Hillhouse Capital wordmark, bottom right).

**Layout**

A full-width dark teal header band fills the top 12.5 percent of the slide, carrying a two-line white title left-aligned at about 2 percent from the left edge, with a thin cyan rule along its bottom edge. Below it a centred bold two-line chart title sits above a single chart that spans the middle of the slide, with left axis title and ticks, right axis title and ticks, and a legend column at the far right inside a red rounded outline. A bottom band holds the source line at left, the Kleiner Perkins logo at bottom left, the Hillhouse Capital logo at bottom right, and the footer text with page number at bottom right; there is no separate slide-number box.

**Visuals**

Chart: stacked column chart with a line overlay, titled 'Average Daily Media Consumption Minutes by Medium, China, 2012 - 2016'. Left vertical axis titled 'Daily Media Consumption (Minutes)', range 0 to 350 in steps of 50, unit minutes. Right vertical axis titled 'Internet as % of Media Consumption', range 0% to 70% in steps of 10%, unit percent. Horizontal category axis labelled 2012, 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016 with no axis title. Light grey horizontal gridlines at each left-axis step. Stacked series from bottom to top: Mobile Internet (#00689D), Desktop Internet (#02B5CC), Newspaper (#33B780), Magazine (#E27C12), TV (#FEBF3A), Radio (#7030A0). Values are not printed on the slide; estimates: 2012 Mobile about 32, Desktop about 54 (top about 86), Newspaper about 19 (top about 105), Magazine about 3 (top about 108), TV about 154 (top about 262), Radio about 10 (top about 272). 2013 Mobile about 46, Desktop about 70 (top about 116), Newspaper about 15 (top about 131), Magazine about 4 (top about 135), TV about 144 (top about 279), Radio about 8 (top about 287). 2014 Mobile about 64, Desktop about 78 (top about 142), Newspaper about 15 (top about 157), Magazine about 3 (top about 160), TV about 139 (top about 299), Radio about 9 (top about 308). 2015 Mobile about 105, Desktop about 59 (top about 164), Newspaper about 13 (top about 177), Magazine about 3 (top about 180), TV about 135 (top about 315), Radio about 8 (top about 323). 2016 Mobile about 141, Desktop about 46 (top about 187), Newspaper about 10 (top about 197), Magazine about 2 (top about 199), TV about 133 (top about 332), Radio about 8 (top about 340). Mobile Internet and Desktop Internet segments of every column are outlined with a thin red border. Overlay line series 'Internet as % of Total Media' in pure red #FF0000, about 3 px thick, plotted on the right axis with estimated values: 2012 about 32%, 2013 about 40%, 2014 about 46%, 2015 about 50%, 2016 about 55% (the title states 55% for the latest year); no markers. Legend in a column at right listed top to bottom: Radio, TV, Magazine, Newspaper, Desktop Internet, Mobile Internet, Internet as % of Total Media, with square swatches matching series colours and a red outline box around the last three entries. Logos: Kleiner Perkins wordmark in green and Hillhouse Capital logo, both described under elements.

**Design**

Background white #FFFFFF. Header band fill #00517A (dark teal blue) with a thin cyan #02B5CC rule beneath it. Title text white #FFFFFF in Arial regular, about 4.4 percent of slide height, sans-serif. Chart title and axis titles, tick labels and legend text black #000000 in Arial Bold; chart title about 3.3 percent of slide height, body and tick text about 2.2 percent. Source line black Arial regular about 1.3 percent. Footer text grey #A6AAA9 Arial regular about 1.5 percent. Accents: series colours #00689D, #02B5CC, #33B780, #E27C12, #FEBF3A, #7030A0, line and legend outline red #FF0000. Gridlines light grey #C0C0C0 about 0.1 percent thick. Shapes flat with no shadows or gradients; legend outline rounded with a large corner radius of about 3 percent of slide width and a red stroke about 0.3 percent thick.

**Layout**

Full-width dark teal title band across the top (about 12.5% of slide height) with two left-aligned white title lines starting at about 2.8% from the left edge; a thin cyan rule sits under the band. Below, the chart title is centred over a large stacked area chart occupying the left and centre (about 12% to 73% of width), with a vertical y-axis at left and date labels rotated along the bottom; three rounded-rectangle legend groups run down the right side (about 82% to 97% of width), with curly brace labels Tencent, Alibaba and Baidu between the chart and legend. The footer row at about 92% to 97% of height holds the Kleiner Perkins logo at bottom left, source and note text in the centre-left, the Hillhouse Capital logo at centre-right and the right-aligned footer text 'KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 204'. No slide number element is separate; the page number is printed in the footer. Margins are about 2.5% left and right.

**Visuals**

Stacked area chart titled 'China Mobile Internet Daily Hours By App, 11/14 – 4/17' (bold black). Y-axis: 'Average Daily Hours (MM)', linear from 0 to 3,500 with gridlines every 500 (labels 0, 500, 1,000, 1,500, 2,000, 2,500, 3,000, 3,500). X-axis: 30 monthly categories from 11/14 to 4/17, labels rotated vertically. Series stacked bottom to top, with approximate values read from the chart (about, as no values are printed): All Other grey #A6A6A6 about 420 at 11/14 rising to about 680 at 4/17; NetEase blue-grey, thin, about 10 to 30; Toutiao dark crimson #961840, about 20 to 150 by 4/17; Baidu Other rose-red, thin; Mobile Baidu orange, thin; iQiyi navy #004E76, about 30 to 60; Alibaba Other light green, thin; Youku dark blue; Taobao / Tmall cyan; Weibo crimson; UC Browser amber #FEBF3A, about 50 to 100; Tencent Other lilac #D2ACCA, about 100 to 170; Tencent Music mint green; Tencent News periwinkle; Tencent Video light cyan; Tencent Games pink-red; QQ pale yellow #FFE5B0, about 350 to 600 by 4/17; WeChat green #31AF78, from about 350 at 11/14 to about 1,170 at 4/17. Total top line about 1,530 at 11/14, about 2,460 at 11/15, about 2,100 at 2/16, about 3,090 at 4/17, with a peak of about 3,170 at 2/17. Legend: three rounded-rectangle outlines containing colour swatches and labels in bold black; Tencent group outlined blue #0070C0 (WeChat, QQ, Tencent Games, Tencent Video, Tencent News, Tencent Music, Tencent Other); Alibaba group outlined amber #FEBF3A (UC Browser, Weibo, Taobao / Tmall, Youku, Alibaba Other); Baidu group outlined green #00B050 (iQiyi, Mobile Baidu, Baidu Other, Toutiao, NetEase, All Other listed below it outside the box). Curly brackets on the right: blue bracket spanning WeChat to Tencent Other with label 'Tencent' in #0070C0 rotated vertical; amber bracket with label 'Alibaba' in #FEBF3A rotated vertical; green bracket with label 'Baidu' in #00B050 rotated vertical. No highlighted points. Logos: Kleiner Perkins wordmark in green #31AF78-like bold sans at bottom left; Hillhouse logo is a red square #E00000-like with white 'HILLHOUSE' text and a white vertical bar, with black 'Hillhouse Capital' wordmark beside it.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF covering the whole slide. White background. Header band dark teal #00517A with a thin cyan #00B0C8 rule beneath. Title text white, regular-weight Arial (sans-serif), about 4.1% of slide height, two lines. Chart title bold black Arial about 3.3% of height. Axis and legend labels bold black Arial about 2.2% of height. Source and note text regular Arial about 1.3% of height in black. Footer text light grey #A6AAA9 Arial about 1.5% of height. Legend boxes have rounded corners, about 1.5% of width radius, thick stroke about 0.3% of height in their group colour, no shadow. Brackets are thin strokes in group colours. No gradients or shadows.

**Layout**

**Visuals**

Two stacked area charts side by side. Left chart: China, Online Entertainment User-Pay Revenue By Vertical, 2011-2016. Y axis 'Annual Revenue ($B)' from $0 to $40 in $10 steps with light grey horizontal gridlines at each step. X axis years 2011 to 2016 at category positions. Series from bottom to top: Online Game (#00689D), Online Video (#02B5CC), Online Literature (#EA543B), Livestreaming (#FCD03F), Digital Music (#279062). No values are printed; about values read from the chart: total about $7.2B in 2011, about $9.7B in 2012, about $14B in 2013, about $19.5B in 2014, about $24.7B in 2015, about $31B in 2016. Online Game about $7B (2011), $9B (2012), $12.5B (2013), $17.5B (2014), $21B (2015), $24B (2016). Stack rises steeply, with Livestreaming visibly widening from 2014 to 2016 and reaching about $4B in 2016. Legend below the chart in two columns: Online Game, Online Video, Online Literature, Livestreaming, Digital Music, each with a small coloured square. Right chart: USA, Online Entertainment User-Pay Revenue By Vertical, 2011-2016, same $0 to $40 axis and gridlines. Series from bottom to top: Online / Console Game (#00689D), Online Video (#02B5CC), eBook (#EA543B), Digital Music (#279062). **Layout**

Three-column layout under a full-width dark teal title band: left column (Diverse Live Content Type), centre column (Interactive / Social / Gamified, with a gift block below), right column (Local / Social, with a phone screenshot). Two thin light-grey vertical rules at about 33% and 71% of slide width separate the columns. Title is left-aligned in the band at top-left with about 2% margin; column headings are centred over their columns. Source line sits bottom-left beside the Kleiner Perkins logo; Hillhouse Capital logo sits bottom-right above a right-aligned footer reading KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 209 (the page number is part of the footer).

**Visuals**

Four-column-free photographic set with screenshots: (1) Left column, 2x2 grid of four small portrait-format images: top-left a band photo of four men in dark leather jackets against a black background, overlaid with white label 光年乐队, 广东 and a magenta badge ★24 and the number 479; top-right a costumed performer in a pointed hat and white/pink dress on a blue-grey sky background with label 哈喽, 黑龙江 and badge ★17 and number 329; bottom-left a man in a white hoodie with headphones and microphone in a bright room with a green plant, label 蓝門蓝黛, 河北, badge ★19, number 15; bottom-right a game-stream web page screenshot with a grid of hero portraits, a VS badge in the centre and a Chinese site header. All images are boxed rectangles with square corners and no border. (2) Centre column: a portrait phone screenshot of a woman with long brown hair in a red top, live chat overlay in the lower half and a gift icon at bottom-right, boxed; beside it a portrait screenshot of a woman in a blue dress singing on a stage with a gift grid of icons below it (小天使, 钻石, 电吉他, 钢琴 in the top row). Below these is a wide dark-red gift bar with four items on a dark red background: crown labelled 水晶之冠 520陌陌币; green-yellow 666 labelled 99陌陌币; purple rocket labelled 爱心火箭 18888陌陌币; clapping hands labelled 掌声 1陌陌币. (3) Right column: tall portrait phone app screenshot titled 哈你直播 with status bar 20:28, tabs 推荐, 附近 (selected) and 新人, a 3-column grid of face thumbnails with captions, bottom navigation bar with icons 附近, 直播, 消息, 通讯录, 个人, and a blue floating pill reading 1位关注主播 正在直播. A red hand-drawn ellipse outline encircles the 附近 tab. (4) Logos: Kleiner Perkins wordmark in green at bottom-left; Hillhouse Capital logo at bottom-right, a red square with white HILLHOUSE text and a white vertical bar, with Hillhouse Capital in black text beside it.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF with the dark teal header band #00517A across the top 12.5% of the slide. Clean corporate white slide with a dark teal title band. Title text white Arial regular, approx 4.4% of slide height. Column headings black Arial Bold, approx 3.0% of slide height. Body text black Arial regular, approx 2.6% of slide height, centred. Footer text light grey #A6AAA9 Arial regular, about 1.5% of height, right-aligned. Source line black Arial regular about 1.3%. Accent colours: header band #00517A, thin teal rule below the band approx #00A3B4, Kleiner Perkins green approx #3DBB7A, Hillhouse red approx #D0202E. Vertical dividers light grey #D9D9D9, about 0.1% of width. No corner radii, shadows or gradients on the slide furniture; the red ellipse is an unfilled outline, approx #C8102E, about 0.3% stroke.

**Text**

Source: Transport Commission of Shenzhen Municipality study on bike sharing, based on operating data from
four participating companies and survey data between 10/16 and 3/17, n=16,546

**Layout**

Two equal-width doughnut charts sit side by side in the content area, separated by a thin vertical light grey divider at about x 48.8% running from y 17.6% to y 91%. A bold centred subtitle spans the top of the content area at y 17.9%, with a bold chart heading above each chart at y 24.5%. The title is left-aligned in a full-width dark teal header band across the top (x 2.1%, y 1.8%), with a thin cyan rule beneath it. A source line sits bottom-left beside the Kleiner Perkins logo, and the Hillhouse Capital logo and the grey footer 'KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 215' sit bottom-right; margins are about 2% left and right.

**Visuals**

Two doughnut charts, no legend, no axes. Left chart title: On-Demand Bike Trips per Week. Segments clockwise from 12 o'clock, labelled inside: <1x 9% (#31AF78 green, white label), 1-2x 25% (#00689D blue, white label), 3-5x 32% (#02B5CC cyan, white label), 6-10x 18% (#EA543B red, white label), 10+ 16% (#FCD03F yellow, black label). Right chart title: Purpose of On-Demand Bike Trips. Segments clockwise from 12 o'clock: Commute 50% (#2A9B6A green, white label inside), Leisure / Exercise 29% (#005B8B dark blue, white label inside), Shopping 12% (#02A0B4 teal, black label outside left with no leader), Business 3% (#7030A0 purple, black label outside upper left with thin black leader line), School 1% (#EA543B red, black label above with thin black leader line), Other 5% (#FCD03F yellow, black label above). Inner hole is about 50% of the outer diameter in both charts. No highlighted points. Two logos: Kleiner Perkins wordmark in green (#2A9B6A-like) bottom left, and Hillhouse Capital logo bottom right consisting of a red (#D0021B-like) square with white HILLHOUSE text and a white vertical bar, followed by black Hillhouse Capital wordmark.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. Clean corporate report look. Title is white sans-serif (Arial regular) on dark teal band #00517A with a thin cyan rule #02B5CC beneath. Subtitle and chart headings are Arial Bold in black #000000. Body and label text is Arial Bold black or white. Source text is Arial regular black #000000. Footer is Arial regular grey #A6AAA9. Title text is about 4.45% of slide height, subtitle 3.33%, chart headings 2.96%, labels 2.22%, source 1.29%, footer 1.49%. Shapes are flat with no shadows, gradients or rounded corners.

### Slide 222

**Text**

AliPay + WeChat Pay on Mobiles = / Digitizing Micro Payments On + Offline / ~$0.15 for On-Demand / Bike / $0.01+ for Article / / Author Tipping / Alipay / WeChat Pay / ~$0.15 for On-Demand / Mobile Recharge / $0.50+ for Street Food / $0.01+ for Livestreaming / Tipping / Source: Hillhouse estimates / KLEINER PERKINS / Hillhouse Capital / HILLHOUSE / KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 221

**Layout**

Three equal columns separated by two thin vertical grey rules, with a full-width dark blue title band across the top. Each column has a bold centred heading above a picture (top row) and a bold centred heading above a picture (bottom row); the middle column's top cell holds the Alipay and WeChat Pay logos. Title is left-aligned in the band with a left margin of about 2.1%. Source line sits bottom-left beside the Kleiner Perkins logo, the Hillhouse Capital logo sits bottom-right, and the footer text with page number 'PAGE 221' sits bottom-right below the title band area's right margin.

**Visuals**

Photograph 1 (top left): close-up of a yellow bicycle with black saddle and a yellow-and-black frame, a QR code sticker reading NO. 3393469 on the frame, and a hand holding a white smartphone showing a blue-toned app screen with a payment interface; green foliage in background; daylight, boxed rectangle, not cropped. Logo group (top centre): Alipay logo, blue rounded square with white stylised 支 character, followed by dark grey 'Alipay' wordmark and TM mark; below it the WeChat Pay logo, green speech bubble with white check mark, followed by dark grey 'WeChat Pay' wordmark. Photograph 2 (top right): screenshot of a white phone showing a Chinese-language article page with grey text and a magnifier circle enlarging an orange character 赏 (reward/tip) over the phone, with a small orange tip button beneath; light grey background, boxed, not cropped. Photograph 3 (bottom left): two photos side by side; left shows a teal-blue freestanding power bank rental kiosk with a screen and Chinese signage; right shows a white phone on a white charging stand with a green Xiaodian logo panel and text reading scan code to charge 1 yuan per hour; warm interior lighting, boxed. Photograph 4 (bottom centre): candid scene in a dim street-food stall with a smiling elderly vendor in a red apron handing a bag to a man in a dark jacket who holds up a phone to scan a QR code on a blue sign; food bowls and vegetables in foreground; warm dark tones, boxed, not cropped. Screenshots 5 and 6 (bottom right): two phone screenshots of livestreaming apps; the left shows a live video of a woman on stage with a grid of gift icons (e.g. small icons of a pedestal, diamond, guitar, piano) on a dark blue background; the right shows a woman with a microphone in a denim jacket with a grid of gift icons, one highlighted by a red box. Hillhouse Capital logo: red square with white HILLHOUSE text and a white vertical bar, beside black 'Hillhouse Capital' wordmark. Kleiner Perkins logo: green bold uppercase 'KLEINER PERKINS' stacked wordmark.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. Clean corporate report style. Title band is a solid dark teal-blue bar with a thin lighter cyan rule along its bottom edge. Title text white regular sans-serif (Arial-like) at about 4.4% of slide height in two lines. Column headings bold black sans-serif (Arial Bold) at about 3.0% of slide height, centred. Source line small black regular sans-serif at about 1.3%. Footer grey regular sans-serif at about 1.5%. Vertical divider rules are light grey, roughly 0.2% of slide width. No shadows, no gradients, no rounded corners on the rules; photographs are sharp-cornered rectangles.

### Slide 226

**Text**

China eCommerce = Strong Growth / +24% Y/Y @ $681B GMV…71% Mobile / China B2C eCommerce Gross Merchandise Value ($B), / Desktop vs. Mobile, 2012 - 2016 / $800 / 400% / $600 / 300% / B2C eCommerce GMV ($B) / $400 / 200% / $200 / 100% / $0 / 0% / 2012 / 2013 / 2014 / 2015 / 2016 / Desktop / Mobile / Mobile Y/Y Growth / % Mobile Y/Y Growth / KLEINER PERKINS / Source: iResearch / Note: Assuming constant FX 1USD = 6.9RMB / HILLHOUSE / Hillhouse Capital / KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 225

**Layout**

Full-bleed slide with a dark blue title band spanning the full width across the top (about 12.5% of height), with the two-line title left-aligned at about 2% from the left edge and vertically centred in the band. Below it a single centred chart title sits above a full-width chart occupying the middle of the slide; the legend sits centred under the x-axis, and a footer row at the bottom holds the Kleiner Perkins logo and source note at left, and the Hillhouse logo at centre-right with the footer text 'KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 225' at right; there is no slide number outside that footer text, and margins are about 2% left and right.

**Visuals**

Chart: stacked column chart combined with a line on a secondary axis, titled 'China B2C eCommerce Gross Merchandise Value ($B), Desktop vs. Mobile, 2012 - 2016'. Left y-axis titled 'B2C eCommerce GMV ($B)' ranges $0 to $800 with gridlines at $200, $400, $600 and $800; right y-axis titled '% Mobile Y/Y Growth' ranges 0% to 400% with ticks at 0%, 100%, 200%, 300% and 400%; x-axis categories 2012, 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016. ### Slide 227

**Text**

China B2C eCommerce @ 15% of Retail Sales… / Penetration Ramping Faster Than Peers / B2C eCommerce as % of Retail Sales by Country, / 2002 - 2016 / 20% / 15% / Penetration / 10% / eCommerce / % / 5% / 0% / 2002 2003 2004 2005 2006 2007 2008 2009 2010 2011 2012 2013 2014 2015 2016 / Korea / UK / China / USA / Germany / Japan / France / Brazil / KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 226 / Source: Euromonitor

**Layout**

Full-width header band across the top (about 12.5% of slide height) with the title left-aligned at about 1.6% from the left edge, set as two lines. Below it, a centred chart title sits above a line chart that spans most of the width, with the y-axis labels at the left, years along the bottom, and a legend row beneath the x-axis. The footer has the Kleiner Perkins logo at bottom left, a source line beside it, and the Hillhouse Capital logo with the footer text 'KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 226' at bottom right. There is no separate slide-number element beyond that footer text.

**Visuals**

One line chart titled 'B2C eCommerce as % of Retail Sales by Country, 2002 - 2016' (bold black, centred). Y-axis: '% eCommerce Penetration', 0% to 20%, gridlines every 5%, light grey #C8C8C8. X-axis: years 2002 to 2016, one category per year. Eight series, each drawn as a line with no markers. Values are not printed on the slide, so all values are estimates marked 'about'. Korea (dark blue #0B5A8A): about 3.6% in 2002, about 4.5% in 2003, about 5.1% in 2004, about 6.3% in 2005, about 7.8% in 2006, about 8.8% in 2007, about 9.6% in 2008, about 9.9% in 2009, about 10.9% in 2010, about 11.0% in 2011, about 11.7% in 2012, about 12.7% in 2013, about 14.5% in 2014, about 16.5% in 2015, about 18.3% in 2016. UK (green #3CB07A): about 1.6% in 2002 rising to about 15.0% in 2016, passing about 9.4% in 2012 and about 12.1% in 2014. China (thick red #E8000D, the highlighted series, about 2.5 pt stroke): about 0.1% in 2002, about 0.3% in 2005, about 0.5% in 2007, about 1.8% in 2009, about 2.8% in 2010, about 4.3% in 2011, about 5.8% in 2012, about 7.9% in 2013, about 10.5% in 2014, about 12.7% in 2015, about 14.8% in 2016. USA (burnt orange-brown #C0650F): about 1.9% in 2002 rising to about 10.8% in 2016. Germany (gold #E8A93A): about 1.0% in 2002, about 5.5% in 2012, about 6.8% in 2013, about 8.5% in 2016. Japan (pale green #8CC9A5): about 1.1% in 2002, about 4.1% in 2011, about 7.2% in 2016. France (grey-blue #8E9CC0): about 0.7% in 2002, about 4.9% in 2012, about 7.5% in 2016. Brazil (cyan #17B5CC): about 1.0% in 2002, about 2.2% in 2010, about 2.7% in 2014, about 4.3% in 2015, about 4.7% in 2016. Legend: horizontal row beneath the x-axis, each entry a short coloured line followed by bold black label in the order Korea, UK, China, USA, Germany, Japan, France, Brazil. Highlighted point: China's 2016 endpoint is emphasised by the thick red line and sits level with the UK endpoint near 15%. Logos: Kleiner Perkins wordmark and Hillhouse Capital logo (see elements).

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF covering the whole slide. White background (#FFFFFF) with a dark teal title band (#00517A) and a bright cyan accent rule under it. Title text is white (#FFFFFF), set in a regular-weight sans-serif resembling Arial, about 4.1% of slide height for the title lines. Chart title and axis labels are bold black (#000000) Arial-style sans-serif at about 2.2 to 3.3% of slide height. Body and legend labels are bold black Arial-style sans-serif at about 2.2%. Footer text is light grey (#A6AAA9) Arial-style regular at about 1.5%. Source line is black Arial regular at about 1.3%. Lines are flat with no shadows, gradients or rounded corners.

### Slide 229

**Text**

JD.com = World Class Fulfillment + Delivery…91% / 58% Orders* / Delivered Within 2 Days / 1 Day, Up from 68% / 47% Four Years Ago / JD.com % of First-Party Orders Delivered by Speed, 2013 – 2017 YTD / 100% / 80% / 60% / % of First Party Orders Delivered / 40% / 20% / 0% / 2013 / 2014 / 2015 / 2016 / 2017 YTD / Within Two Days / Within 24 Hours** / KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 228 / Source: JD.com / *Orders exclude third party sellers. **Defined as JD’s 211 program – any orders received by 11am will be delivered on the same day, and any orders received by 11pm will be delivered by 3pm on the following day. Bulk of orders are delivered within 3-18 hours. Customers also can request that orders placed by 3pm be delivered in the evening on the same day in selected cities. There is no extra charge for delivery under the 211 program for orders that satisfy the minimum size requirement. The program does not cover delivery to addresses through third-party couriers or products shipped directly from third-party sellers. Bulky items such as refrigerators are also eligible for same-day or next-day delivery in selected areas. Customers can also request expedited delivery within two hours by paying an extra charge in select cities. JD’s 211 service covered 1,410 counties and districts across China as of 2016. 2017 YTD data as of Q1.

**Layout**

Full-width dark teal header band across the top with two-line left-aligned title in white, then a centred chart title in bold black, then a single chart filling the middle with left and right value axes and a bottom legend. Footer row holds the Kleiner Perkins logo at bottom left, a left-aligned three-line source and note block beside it, and a right-aligned grey running footer with page number; no slide number beyond the printed 'PAGE 234'. Left margin about 2 percent of slide width, content inside roughly 2 to 98 percent width.

**Visuals**

One combined bar and line chart. Chart title: 'India Internet Users (MM) & Penetration (%), Monthly Active*, Mid-Year (June) 2009 – 2016E'. Left y-axis: 'Internet Users (MM)', range 0 to 400, gridlines every 50, labels 0, 50, 100, 150, 200, 250, 300, 350, 400. Right y-axis: 'Online Penetration (%)', range 0% to 30%, labels 0%, 5%, 10%, 15%, 20%, 25%, 30%. X-axis categories: 2009, 2010, 2011, 2012, 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016E. Series 1, 'Number of Internet Users', blue columns (#00689D) with white bold values inside the top of each bar: 2009 = 54, 2010 = 66, 2011 = 84, 2012 = 111, 2013 = 149, 2014 = 198, 2015 = 277, 2016E = 355. Series 2, 'Online Penetration', red line (about #FF0000, about 3 pt) with black bold values above each point: 2009 = 4%, 2010 = 5%, 2011 = 7%, 2012 = 9%, 2013 = 12%, 2014 = 15%, 2015 = 22%, 2016E = 27%. Legend centred below the x-axis: blue rectangle swatch then 'Number of Internet Users', red line swatch then 'Online Penetration'. No points are highlighted beyond the final 2016E values. Kleiner Perkins logo at bottom left: green (about #3DB86A) bold sans-serif wordmark 'KLEINER / PERKINS' stacked on two lines.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. Clean corporate data slide. Header band #00517A with a thin lighter cyan rule beneath it (about #1BB3C9, about 0.7 percent of slide height). Title white Arial regular, about 4.1 percent of slide height per line, sentence case, left aligned. Chart title and axis titles black Arial Bold, about 3.0 percent for the chart title and 2.5 percent for axis titles. Tick and data labels black Arial Bold about 2.2 percent; value labels inside bars white Arial Bold about 2.2 percent. Bars #00689D, line red, gridlines hairline light grey (about #D9D9D9, about 0.1 percent stroke). Source and note text black Arial regular about 1.3 percent. Running footer grey #A6AAA9 Arial regular about 1.5 percent. Flat design with no shadows, gradients or rounded corners.

**Layout**

Full-width header band across the top about 12.5% of the slide height with the two-line white title left-aligned at about 2.1% from the left edge. Below it two equal chart panels sit side by side in columns separated by a thin vertical grey divider at about 50.4% of the width; each panel has a bold centred two-line chart title above the chart and a legend row below. The Kleiner Perkins logo sits bottom-left with source and note lines to its right, and the footer line with page label sits bottom-right; no slide number beyond the footer label.

**Visuals**

Two line charts side by side. Left chart: line chart titled 'Total Time Spent* on Android Phones, 2014-2016', y-axis titled 'Hours (B)' with gridlines labelled 0, 25, 50, 75, 100, 125, 150 (equal 25-unit steps, range 0 to 150); x-axis categories 2014, 2015, 2016. Series with about values: India red about 66 (2014), 100 (2015), 145 (2016); Brazil dark blue about 37.5, 72, 110; USA cyan about 46, 65, 89; Indonesia green about 22.5, 38, 52; Mexico orange about 19, 34, 48. Legend below in order India, Brazil, USA, Indonesia, Mexico, each with a short coloured line sample. No highlighted points. Right chart: line chart titled 'Total Google Play Downloads, 2014-2016', y-axis titled 'Downloads (B)' with printed labels 0, 2, 3, 5, 6, 8 at equal spacing (values are not proportional to the spacing; estimates below read against those labels); x-axis 2014, 2015, 2016. Series with about values: India red about 2.6, 3.8, 6.2; USA cyan about 5.7, 6.0, 6.1; Brazil dark blue about 3.3, 5.2, 5.5; Indonesia green about 2.0, 2.5, 3.1; Russia purple about 2.6, 2.8, 3.1. The India 2016 point is highlighted by a thin red circle outline. Legend below in order India, USA, Brazil, Indonesia, Russia. Gridlines are light grey horizontal lines in both charts.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. White background with a dark teal header band #00517A and a thin bright cyan rule #00B5C8 along its bottom edge. Title text white #FFFFFF in Arial regular sans-serif, about 4.1% of slide height, two lines. Chart titles and axis labels are bold black #000000 Arial-Bold sans-serif at about 3.0% (titles) and 2.2% (tick labels and legend) of slide height. Footer and source text black #000000 at about 1.3% in Arial regular; the page label is grey #A6AAA9 Arial at about 1.5%. Series colours: India #FF0000, Brazil #0A6AA0, USA #00B5D4, Indonesia #3AAA7A, Mexico #E8821E, Russia #7030A0. Gridlines light grey #D9D9D9, 1 pt. Divider line light grey #D0D0D0 about 0.3% width. Lines are about 3 pt thick with round joins; no shadows, gradients or rounded corners.

**Layout**

Full-width dark blue header band across the top 12.5% of the slide holds a left-aligned two-line white title starting at about 3.2% from the left edge, with a thin teal rule beneath it. Below the header, a centred bold chart title sits above a full-width combo chart whose plot area spans about 13% to 86% horizontally; the Kleiner Perkins logo sits bottom-left at about 1.8% left, with the source line to its right, and the footer text with page reference sits bottom-right near the right margin at about 95% height.

**Visuals**

Combo chart titled 'India Smartphone Unit Shipments, Q1:10 – Q1:17'. Left y-axis 'Unit Shipments (MM)' ranging 0 to 35 in steps of 5, with light grey horizontal gridlines. Right y-axis '% Y/Y Growth' ranging 0% to 250% in steps of 50%. X-axis categories Q1:10 through Q1:17 (29 quarters), labels rotated vertical in bold black. Series 1, 'Smartphone Shipments', is a blue (#00689D) column series with printed values: Q1:10 1; Q2:10 1; Q3:10 2; Q4:10 2; Q1:11 2; Q2:11 2; Q3:11 3; Q4:11 3; Q1:12 4; Q2:12 4; Q3:12 4; Q4:12 5; Q1:13 6; Q2:13 10; Q3:13 13; Q4:13 15; Q1:14 17; Q2:14 18; Q3:14 23; Q4:14 22; Q1:15 22; Q2:15 27; Q3:15 29; Q4:15 26; Q1:16 23; Q2:16 28; Q3:16 32; Q4:16 26; Q1:17 27. Legend at bottom centre: blue rectangular swatch with 'Smartphone Shipments' and red line swatch with 'Y/Y Growth (%)'. Not cropped, no photographs or icons.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF, with a dark blue #00517A header band across the top 12.5%. White #FFFFFF background; header band in deep teal-blue #00517A with a thin lighter cyan rule (#1AB3C6) beneath. ### Slide 241

**Text**

…India Wireless Data Cost* = Declining to More Affordable Levels… / @ 1.3% of Annual Average GDP per Capita (3/17) vs. 3% (3/15) / Annualized Cost of 1GB / Month vs. % of GDP per Capita, / Q1:14 – Q1:17 / $60 / 4.0% / $53 / $53 / $52 / $51 / $51 / $48 / $47 / $45 / $44 / $42 / $38 / $33 / $23 / 3.0% / 2% GDP / Capita / Threshold for / Widespread / Affordability, per / Alliance for Affordable / Internet / $45 / $30 / $15 / 1.0% / 2.0% / Cost of Data as % of GDP per Capita (%) / Annualized Cost of 1GB / Month Plan ($) / $0 / 0.0% / Q1:14 / Q2:14 / Q3:14 / Q4:14 / Q1:15 / Q2:15 / Q3:15 / Q4:15 / Q1:16 / Q2:16 / Q3:16 / Q4:16 / Q1:17 / Annual Price of 1GB of Data per Month / As a % of GDP/Capita / KLEINER / PERKINS / Source: JP Morgan, Bharti Airtel, Idea Cellular, IMF, Alliance for Affordable Internet. / *Industry average calculated using average cost of 1 GB of data from Bharti Airtel and Idea Cellular and exclude the impact of Reliance Jio. / Chart is illustrative and assumes an average consumption of 1GB / month. Alliance for Affordable Internet data suggests that 2% of monthly / income for 1GB of data is within affordable range. / KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 240

**Layout**

Full-width header band across the top 12.5% of the slide with the title left-aligned at about 2.1% from the left edge and two lines of text. Below it a single centred chart occupies roughly x 9% to 78% and y 16% to 88%, with a bold centred chart title above it and a legend below it; a rounded callout box sits at the right, around x 82% to 96%, vertically centred at about y 45% to 64%. The footer holds the KLEINER PERKINS logo at bottom-left (x 1.8%), a four-line source and footnote block starting at x 10.5%, and the right-aligned running footer 'KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 240' at bottom-right. There is no slide number element apart from the page number inside that footer line.

**Visuals**

Chart: combined bar and line chart, titled 'Annualized Cost of 1GB / Month vs. % of GDP per Capita, Q1:14 – Q1:17'. Left y-axis 'Annualized Cost of 1GB / Month Plan ($)' ranges $0 to $60 with gridlines at $15, $30, $45 and $60, with unit dollars. Right y-axis 'Cost of Data as % of GDP per Capita (%)' ranges 0.0% to 4.0% with ticks at 1.0%, 2.0%, 3.0% and 4.0%. X-axis categories are Q1:14, Q2:14, Q3:14, Q4:14, Q1:15, Q2:15, Q3:15, Q4:15, Q1:16, Q2:16, Q3:16, Q4:16, Q1:17, with labels rotated about 45 degrees. Series 1, blue columns 'Annual Price of 1GB of Data per Month', labelled values: Q1:14 $53, Q2:14 $53, Q3:14 $51, Q4:14 $52, Q1:15 $51, Q2:15 $48, Q3:15 $47, Q4:15 $45, Q1:16 $44, Q2:16 $42, Q3:16 $38, Q4:16 $33, Q1:17 $23. Series 2, red line 'As a % of GDP/Capita', no printed values; estimates: Q1:14 about 3.3%, Q2:14 about 3.3%, Q3:14 about 3.2%, Q4:14 about 3.25%, Q1:15 about 3.1%, Q2:15 about 3.0%, Q3:15 about 2.9%, Q4:15 about 2.75%, Q1:16 about 2.55%, Q2:16 about 2.45%, Q3:16 about 2.25%, Q4:16 about 1.9%, Q1:17 about 1.3%. A red dashed horizontal reference line sits at the 2.0% right-axis level, which equals $30 on the left axis. Legend below the x-axis: a blue square swatch followed by 'Annual Price of 1GB of Data per Month', and a red line swatch followed by 'As a % of GDP/Capita'. Highlighted points: none beyond the dashed threshold line; the line crosses it between Q3:16 and Q4:16. Callout: rounded box with thin cyan outline reading '2% GDP / Capita' (bold) and 'Threshold for Widespread Affordability, per Alliance for Affordable Internet'. Logo: KLEINER PERKINS wordmark, two stacked lines in green, bottom-left, with no other imagery on the slide.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF covering the full slide, with the dark teal #00517A header band across the top. Clean corporate chart slide with a dark teal header band and a white body. Header band fill #00517A with a thin lighter cyan rule (about #1BA9BE) along its bottom edge. Title text white #FFFFFF in Arial regular, sans-serif, roughly 4.1% of slide height, with the phrase 'Wireless Data' in italics. Chart title and axis labels in Arial bold, black #000000, about 2.2% to 3.3% of slide height. Body and footnote text in Arial regular, black #000000, about 1.3% to 1.8% of slide height. Column fill #00689D. Line and threshold colour pure red about #FF0000, line about 0.6% of slide height thick, dashed threshold. Gridlines light grey about #D9D9D9, thin. Callout outline cyan about #1BB3C6, 1px, rounded corners, white fill, no shadow. Footer running text grey #A6AAA9. Logo green about #2DB36B. No gradients or shadows.

### Slide 244

**Text**

India Wireless Carriers = Incumbents + New Entrants…
Fighting Aggressively for Share Over Past 4 Quarters…
2015 – 1H:16
Top 3 India wireless carriers Bharti Airtel / Vodafone / Idea collectively maintain ~60% share
of broadband subscribers + ~$2.80 – $3.00 monthly ARPU (Voice + Data + Value-Added
Services).
Q2:16
Wireless incumbents begin to cut data rates in anticipation of Reliance Jio launch in 9/16.
Data costs per GB decline from $3.50 to ~$3.15 (-10%) Q/Q. Voice costs decline 4% Q/Q.
9/16
Reliance Jio – after investing $25B over 7 years – rolls out 4G Pan-India Jio network +
$0 Monthly ARPU (post 3/17 when ARPU rose to $4.70)
Q4:16 – Q1:17
Wireless incumbents begin to lose data subscribers. In response, they cut data prices further
over next 2 quarters. As of 3/17, average cost of 1GB of data @ ~$2 among incumbents,
-48% Y/Y...ARPU -20%. Including Jio, average cost of 1GB of data @ $0.33 (3/17).
3/17
Reliance Jio free-data period ends with ~67% paid migration (72MM convert to paid Jio Prime
subscribers out of 108MM sign-ups)
Source: JP Morgan, Public Filings, TRAI, Reliance Jio.
Jio sign-ups are total number of Jio SIMs registered, while paying subscribers are a subset of sign-ups who have later converted to Jio Prime
paid subscription. Data for incumbents based on average of Idea and Bharti Airtel.

Line chart titled ‘Data Prices per GB, Industry*, CQ1:14 – CQ1:17’. Y-axis titled ‘Cost of 1GB Data ($)’, linear, range $0.0 to $5.0 in $0.5 steps, with light grey horizontal gridlines at each step. **Layout**

Full-width header band across the top about 12.5% of slide height holds the two-line white title, left-aligned at a margin of about 2% with the title starting at about 2.1% from left. Below it, a centred two-line bold chart title sits above a single full-width vertical column chart with the y-axis at left and the nine quarter columns spread across the plot, a centred horizontal legend row sits just under the x-axis labels, and the footer carries the Kleiner Perkins logo at bottom left, the source and footnote lines beside it, and the right-aligned running footer 'KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 245' at bottom right. No slide number element other than the printed page 245 in the footer.

**Visuals**

Stacked column chart, vertical bars, nine quarters Q1:15 to Q1:17 left to right. Chart title: India Broadband (>512 Kbps) Subscribers* by Service Provider, CQ1:15 – CQ1:17. Y axis titled Broadband Subscribers (MM), linear from 0 to 300 in steps of 50, light grey horizontal gridlines. X axis labelled by quarter, no axis title. Series stacked bottom to top: Jio (#7030A0 purple), Bharti Airtel (#00689D blue), Vodafone (#31AF78 green), Idea (#02B5CC cyan), BSNL (#EA543B red), Other (#FEBF3A yellow). Printed values per quarter in order Jio/Bharti Airtel/Vodafone/Idea/BSNL/Other with the printed total above the bar: Q1:15 none/22/19/19/15/24 total 99; Q2:15 none/25/22/18/17/27 total 109; Q3:15 none/28/24/20/19/30 total 121; Q4:15 none/31/26/21/20/38 total 137; Q1:16 none/38/28/23/20/40 total 150; Q2:16 none/41/32/27/21/42 total 162; Q3:16 none/46/36/31/22/58 total 192; Q4:16 72/44/35/27/20/38 total 236; Q1:17 108/49/38/25/22/35 total 277. Segment labels are bold, white on the blue, green, cyan and purple segments and black on the red BSNL and yellow Other segments; totals are bold black above each column. Legend: horizontal row below the axis with a square swatch before each name: Jio (purple), Bharti Airtel (blue), Vodafone (green), Idea (cyan), BSNL (red), Other (yellow). Highlighted: a black dashed vertical arrow with an open arrowhead at its lower end, placed between Q3:16 and Q4:16 and pointing down toward the axis, annotated '9/16 = Jio Release to General Public'. Only Q4:16 and Q1:17 carry a purple Jio segment. Columns are solid with no outlines and about 60% of category width. Logo: Kleiner Perkins green wordmark, two stacked lines KLEINER over PERKINS in bold condensed sans, about 164 by 96 pixels, not cropped.

**Visuals**

Chart: 100% stacked column chart titled 'India Mobile Browser Usage Market Share, Q1:13 – Q2:17' (bold black). Y-axis 0% to 100% in 10% steps with gridlines; x-axis 18 quarters Q1:13 to Q2:17 labels rotated about 45 degrees. Series bottom to top: UC Browser (#00689D), Opera (#31AF78), Chrome (#02B5CC), Android (#7030A0), Nokia (#EA543B), Others (#FEBF3A). No values are printed on the bars; estimates for the UC Browser segment (bottom, cumulative from 0%): Q1:13 about 26%, Q2:13 about 28%, Q3:13 about 31%, Q4:13 about 32%, Q1:14 about 33%, Q2:14 about 35%, Q3:14 about 36%, Q4:14 about 39%, Q1:15 about 43%, Q2:15 about 47%, Q3:15 about 50%, Q4:15 about 55%, Q1:16 about 58%, Q2:16 about 56%, Q3:16 about 52%, Q4:16 about 56%, Q1:17 about 53%, Q2:17 about 50%. Chrome is a thin band in early quarters and grows to a large share: about 1% Q1:14, about 2% in Q4:13, and about 33% of the bar in Q2:17 (from about 59% to about 91%). Legend: UC Browser, Opera, Chrome, Android, Nokia, Others as square swatches in the series colours. No highlighted points. Logo: Kleiner Perkins wordmark (see elements). No photographs or illustrations.

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF across the whole slide, with the dark teal #00517A header band at the top. Clean flat corporate chart slide. Header band solid dark teal #00517A with a thin cyan rule #02B5CC along its bottom edge. Title text white #FFFFFF in Arial regular (Helvetica-like sans-serif), about 4.1% of slide height per line, not bold. Footer in Arial regular grey #A6AAA9 about 1.5%. Accent colours: logo green #31B77A; chart colours as listed. **Layout**

Two equal side-by-side chart panels separated by a thin vertical light-grey divider at about 50.6% of slide width. A full-width dark teal header band holds a two-line left-aligned white title starting at x 1.9%, with a thin cyan rule under it. Each panel has a bold centred two-line heading above its chart, with the y-axis title rotated on the left of each chart and the legend centred below each x-axis. The Kleiner Perkins logo sits bottom-left at x 1.8%, with the source and note lines to its right at x 10.5%. The footer 'KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 252' is bottom-right, right-aligned to about 97.7%. No slide number other than the printed footer page number.

**Visuals**

Two line charts with red series and dashed cyan trend arrows. LEFT CHART: title 'Gaana Streams, 6/16 – 3/17' with subtitle '(Music Streaming App)'. Y-axis titled 'Streams per Month (MM)', range 0 to 1,000, gridlines at 200, 400, 600, 800, 1,000 (light grey). X-axis categories 6/16, 9/16, 12/16, 3/17. Single series 'Gaana Streams' in red (#FF0000), values about 315 (6/16), about 445 (9/16), about 705 (12/16), about 925 (3/17); no printed data values. Legend below x-axis: red line swatch with label 'Gaana Streams'. Annotation '+3x Growth' printed in black at upper left of plot. A dashed cyan (#02B5CC) arrow runs from about 6/16 at 350 up to about 3/17 at 960 with arrowhead at top right, parallel above the red line. RIGHT CHART: title 'Hotstar DAUs, 6/16 – 4/17*' with subtitle '(Video Streaming App)'. Y-axis titled 'Daily Active Users as % of Total Users', range 0% to 6%, gridlines at each 1%. X-axis categories 6/16, 9/16, 12/16, 4/17. Single series 'Hotstar DAUs' in red (#FF0000), values about 1.3% (6/16), about 1.5% (9/16), about 3.0% (12/16), about 5.5% (4/17); no printed data values. Legend below x-axis: red swatch with label 'Hotstar DAUs'. Annotation '4x+ Growth' in black at upper left. Dashed cyan (#02B5CC) arrow from about 6/16 at 1.45% up to about 4/17 at 5.9% with arrowhead at top right. No highlighted points. Logo: Kleiner Perkins wordmark in bold green capitals.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. Clean corporate report style. Background white #FFFFFF. Header band dark teal-blue #00517A with a thin cyan #02B5CC rule beneath it. Title text white #FFFFFF in a regular-weight Arial-style sans-serif, about 4.07% of slide height, two lines. Chart headings and axis labels in bold Arial-style sans-serif, black #000000, about 2.2% to 3.0% of slide height. Annotations '+3x Growth' and '4x+ Growth' in regular Arial-style sans-serif, black #000000, about 2.6% of slide height. Accents: red #FF0000 data lines, cyan #02B5CC dashed trend arrows. Divider and gridlines light grey #D9D9D9, about 0.2% stroke. Footer text grey #A6AAA9 regular, about 1.5% of height; source and note text black #000000 regular, about 1.3% of height. Lines are solid 3 pt-style red strokes with no markers; arrows are dashed with open arrowheads. No corner radii, shadows or gradients.

### Slide 261

**Text**

...India Identity =
Aadhaar IDs + eKYC Improving Foundational Access to Broad Services
Sim Card
Activation
Bank Account &
Digital Wallet Opening
Pensions &
Social Services
Before Digital ID = 1-3 Days
Proof of Address / original photo IDs / attested
photocopies + potential fraud…
Before Digital ID =
Physical visit to bank, paper-based KYC, lack of
ability to scale, improper documentation
Before Digital ID =
Cash-based / leakage of payments to
government officials / corruption / fraud
After-Digital ID = 15 Minutes
Aadhaar number + fingerprint / biometric eSign
After-Digital ID =
Open account on mobile phone…
in secure / scalable way
After-Digital ID =
12-15% increase in final payouts to workers
owing to reduced leakage
KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 260
Source: UIDAI (Indian Government), iSpirit / IndiaStack, Skoch Group
Note: Image credits – Hindu Business Line, NDTV, Reliance Jio, DBS India, Livemint (2017)

**Layout**

Three equal columns separated by two thin vertical light-grey rules at about x 36.7 and x 68.3, running from about y 17 to y 91. Each column has a bold centred heading, a 'Before' block with a photo above the 'After' block with a photo or phone image below. A full-width navy header band holds the white two-line title, left-aligned at about 2% margin. Source and notes sit bottom-left beside the green logo; the footer text sits bottom-right with no slide number matching the slide index (it reads PAGE 260).

**Visuals**

Six photographs and one logo. (1) Sim card column, top: close-up of an older person's hands counting an Indian 100-rupee note over a blue paper form, with a bank card (partly visible, bearing an orange-red logo) and a pink pen at the lower right; warm yellow-ochre table, boxed rectangular crop, warm lighting. (2) Bank column, top: wide view of a crowded bank hall with a glass counter, a seated man in a white shirt at the counter front, and several people waiting in white and blue clothing; muted grey and beige tones, boxed, no overlay. (3) Pensions column, top: stacks and bundles of Indian rupee notes held by two hands in close-up, shallow focus, dominant green, brown and grey tones, boxed. (4) Sim card column, bottom: two-panel collage, left a hand holding a phone showing 'eKYC', right hands holding a white device with Jio logos and a fingerprint icon with 'eKYC' badge, soft grey and muted tones, boxed with no border. (5) Bank column, bottom: phone mockup outline in white with rounded corners, showing a purple top bar reading 'Ask your Virtual Assistant', and an orange panel reading 'Just a few steps away' with a money-bag icon and 'OPEN DIGISAVINGS' button, cropped at the slide bottom edge. (6) Pensions column, bottom: a hand holding a smartphone with a finger tapping its screen, cool grey-blue background, boxed. (7) Logo: green KLEINER PERKINS wordmark stacked on two lines, bottom-left.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. White background with a navy-teal header band #00517A across the top 12.5% of the slide and a thin teal rule #00A7B5 along its bottom edge. Title text is white #FFFFFF regular sans-serif (Arial-like) at about 3.9% of slide height. Column headings are bold black #000000 Arial-style sans-serif at about 3.3% of slide height. Sub-headings 'Before Digital ID' and 'After-Digital ID' are bold black at about 2.6%. Body text is regular black #000000 Arial-style at about 1.8%. Footer text is grey #A6AAA9 at about 1.5%. Source and note lines are black at about 1.3%. Dividers are light grey #D0D0D0 lines about 0.3% wide. Photos are sharp rectangles with no corner radius or shadow. Logo green #3DB370.

**Layout**

Full-width dark blue title band across the top with a two-line left-aligned title, then a centred four-column table (Phase, Project, Functionality, Results) with a blue header row and three phase groups below it, separated by black horizontal rules. The Kleiner Perkins logo sits bottom left, the source line sits to its right at the bottom, and the footer 'KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 262' sits bottom right; there is no slide number outside that footer.

**Visuals**

A table with four columns, Phase, Project, Functionality and Results, and one header row. Row 1 is 1) Identity: Project 'Aadhaar (1/09) + eKYC (5/13)'; Functionality 'Single digital ID + authentication database'; Results as two bullets, '1B+ Aadhaar cards issued since 2010' and '~16MM authentications/day (4/17)'. Row 2 is 2) Banking: Project 'Jan Dhan Yojana (8/14) ‘Banking for All’'; Functionality 'Bank accounts tied to Aadhaar for previously non-banked citizens'; Results as two bullets, '280MM+ accounts opened in 3 years... 50% of existing bank accounts' and 'Direct subsidies to citizen bank accounts have saved $775M owing largely to reduced corruption leakage (12/16)'. Row 3 is 3) Mobile Services, which spans two sub-rows. Sub-row 3a: Project 'Universal Payments Interface (UPI) (7/16)'; Functionality 'Instant money transfer between bank accounts via phone numbers'; Results as two bullets, '~$380MM monthly transaction volume (4/16)' and 'Use accelerated after demonetization (11/16)'. Sub-row 3b: Project 'Bharat Interface for Money (BHIM) (12/16)'; Functionality 'Government App for UPI based payments'; Results as one bullet, '17MM+ downloads within 2 months of launch (2/17)'. No chart, photograph or diagram. The only logo is the green Kleiner Perkins wordmark at bottom left, stacked as KLEINER over PERKINS.

Body rows use a very pale blue fill #F3FAFF, with phase labels in black bold Arial (about 2.60%) and cell text in black regular Arial (about 2.22%). **Layout**

Full-width dark teal header band across the top 12.5% of the slide carries a two-line white title flush left with a left margin of about 2.8%. Below it, a centred bold chart title sits above a single line chart that fills the central area, with the x-axis category labels and a centred legend beneath it. The Kleiner Perkins logo sits bottom-left at the margin with a small source line to its right, and a grey footer with the document name and page number sits bottom-right; no slide number is shown beyond the footer text.

**Visuals**

One line chart. Title: 'Paytm Registered Users (MM), 11/14 - 3/17', bold black. Y-axis: title 'Registered Users (MM)' rotated vertically; range 0 to 250, major ticks and labels every 50 (0, 50, 100, 150, 200, 250); light grey horizontal gridlines at each tick. X-axis: categories 11/14, 4/15, 8/15, 4/16, 12/16, 3/17 (unevenly spaced in time but equally spaced on the axis), axis line at 0 in light grey. Series 'Paytm', a single red (#FF0000) line about 3 pt thick with no markers, with labelled values: 11/14 = 22; 4/15 = 50; 8/15 = 100; 4/16 = 122; 12/16 = 180; 3/17 = 215, each value printed in bold black above its point. Legend: centred below the x-axis, a short red line sample followed by the bold black label 'Paytm'. No highlighted points. Also present: the Kleiner Perkins logo, a wordmark of two stacked lines 'KLEINER' over 'PERKINS' in bold sans-serif capitals in medium green (#3DB27A approx.), placed bottom-left.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF covering the whole slide. Clean white content slide with a solid dark teal header band (#00517A) over the top 12.5% of the height, with a thin bright cyan rule (about #14A9C2) along its bottom edge. Title text is white (#FFFFFF) regular-weight Arial, about 4.1% of slide height, set in two lines. Chart title and all chart labels are bold Arial in black (#000000), about 2.2% to 3.0% of slide height. Source line is regular Arial, black, about 1.3%. Footer is regular Arial in light grey (#A6AAA9), about 1.5%. Series line red (#FF0000). Gridlines light grey (#D9D9D9 approx.). No shadows, gradients, rounded corners or boxes.

**Layout**

Two equal-weight columns below a full-width title band: a stacked column chart on the left (plot about x 7.5 to 40.5 percent) and a pie chart on the right (about x 56 to 86 percent), both with bold chart titles centred above them. The title sits left-aligned in the top band with a 3.1 percent left margin; the Kleiner Perkins logo sits bottom-left at about 1.8 percent margin with the source line beside it, and the footer text 'KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 266' is right-aligned at bottom-right, ending at about 97.7 percent.

**Visuals**

Left: stacked column chart titled 'Time Spent with Media per Week (Hours), 2016'. Y axis labelled in hours per week (unit: hours), range 0 to 40 in steps of 5, light grey horizontal gridlines. One column, centred at about x 29 percent, about 14 percent of slide width wide. Stack from bottom: Print (dark blue, 2 hours, labelled '2' in white bold), Television (green, 4 hours, labelled '4' in white bold), Mobile (cyan, 28 hours, labelled '28' in white bold); total about 34 hours. Legend below the chart in bold black: Print (dark blue swatch), Television (green swatch), Mobile (cyan swatch). No highlighted points. Right: pie chart titled 'Percent of Time Spent on Mobile by Category, 2016', starting at 12 o'clock and running clockwise. Slices with labelled values: Search, Social and Messaging 34% (green), Entertainment 45% (dark blue), Shopping 4% (cyan), Finance 2% (crimson), News & Media 2% (orange), Others 13% (amber). Labels sit outside the slices for small wedges and inside for Entertainment (white text) and Others (dark grey text). Thin white separators between slices. No legend on the pie. Kleiner Perkins logo: green wordmark stacked in two lines, 'KLEINER' over 'PERKINS'.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF covering the whole slide. White background #FFFFFF. Title band across the top 12.5 percent of the height in dark teal-blue #00517A, with a thin cyan rule #02B5CC along its bottom edge. Title text white #FFFFFF in Arial regular (Helvetica-style sans-serif), about 3.7 percent of slide height, two lines. Chart titles and axis labels in Arial bold black #000000, about 2.2 to 2.6 percent of slide height. Pie labels in bold dark grey #404040. Source line in regular black #000000 about 1.3 percent. Footer text in regular grey #A6AAA9 about 1.5 percent. Logo in green #31AF78. Shapes are flat with no shadows, gradients, or rounded corners; chart bars and slices have no outlines apart from thin white separators.
