**Text**

…India Entertainment Re-Imagined = Internet-First Shows Optimized for Mobile… / Replacing Longer / Linear Programming Optimized for TV
THEN
NOW
TV Soap Operas + Reality Shows
On-Demand Web-Video Shows
ex. AIB Roasts, Hotstar
▪ Scripted, family-focused dramas targeted / @ older viewers + families with ‘rinse & / repeat’ plots
▪ Produced for linear programming without / user data / feedback
▪ Little to no user data, often based on small / TV rating sample sizes / surveys
▪ Millennial focused / short-form content / such as ‘Hinglish’ standup comedy
▪ Made for mobile / shared via / messaging channels (Whatsapp, FB, etc)
▪ Instant user data + feedback / (Views, Geos, Replays etc.)
▪ Dramatic growth assisted by 4G / rollout of Jio…AIB Channel @ 100MM+ views
KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 267
Source: Google Play, Reliance Jio Annual Report / Image: Wikipedia, Hotstar, JioTV

**Layout**

Two-column comparison split by a thin vertical grey divider at about x 51, with a full-width navy title band across the top (0 to 12.5% height). THEN column sits left and NOW column right, each with a centred italic header, bold heading and bulleted list above its visuals. Source block and KLEINER PERKINS logo sit bottom-left; footer text sits bottom-right, with page number 'PAGE 267' printed in the footer.

**Visuals**

Photograph of a grey CRT television set (boxed, front view, centred under the left column) whose screen shows a large group portrait of about 30 people in Indian dress seated and standing on steps before an ornate white-columned building; lighting is soft daylight, dominant colours are cream, grey and warm yellows. Left of right column: a vertical phone screenshot (dark black phone frame with Hotstar app, green header bar, red banner with AIB thumbnails, 'Continue Watching' row of thumbnails) with the caption 'Your favourite TV Shows, Movies and more' at the top, boxed, not cropped. Right: a photograph of a white tablet held by two hands in front of a train window showing a blue sky and green landscape; the tablet screen shows a man in a checked shirt speaking in a dark brown-gold blurred background; boxed, rectangular, no overlay. No logos other than the KLEINER PERKINS wordmark in green.

**Design**

Background white #FFFFFF. Title band fill #00517A (dark teal-blue) with a thin cyan-teal rule #1AAFC4 beneath it. Title text white #FFFFFF in Arial regular, about 3.5% of slide height. Column headers THEN and NOW in Arial Italic black #000000, about 3.0% height. Column headings in Arial Bold black #000000, about 3.7% height. Subheading and bullets in Arial regular black #000000, about 2.6% height. Bullets are Wingdings square glyphs in black. Divider line grey #BFBFBF, about 0.3% width. Footer and page label in Arial regular grey #A6AAA9, about 1.5% height. Source lines in Arial regular black, about 1.3% height. KLEINER PERKINS logo in bold green #3DB54A condensed sans-serif. Photos have sharp rectangular edges with no shadows or rounded corners.

### Slide 269

**Text**

India Education = Largest K-12 School System (250MM+ Students) in World With… / High Demand for After-School Education… / Total K-12 Student Enrollments by / Country (MM), 2015 / Indian Private Coaching Industry, / 2014 / 50% / 40% / 30% / 20% / 10% / 0% / 300 / 250 / 200 / 150 / 100 / 50 / 0 / Students (MM) / % of Students / India / China / US / UK / 37% / 26% / 22% / Primary / Upper Primary / Secondary / % of Students Enrolled in Private Coaching / Reasons for Private Coaching / Others / 2% / Entrance Exam Prep / 2% / Prep for Job Exams / 8% / Augmenting Basic / Education / 89% / 0% / 20% / 40% / 60% / 80% 100% / % of Respondents / KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 268 / Source: Nielsel K-12 India Book Publishing Report,2016. UNESCO Education & Literacy China Statistics, 2015. U.S / Department of Education, 2016. UK Department for Education National Statistics, 1/15.

**Layout**

A full-width navy title band occupies the top 12.5% of the slide, with the two-line title left-aligned at a margin of about 2.2% and vertically set in the band. Below it, three charts sit in two columns: a large bar chart on the left (about x 9% to 50%) and two stacked charts on the right (about x 53% to 97%), with the upper-right chart titled above its plot and the lower-right chart titled at its top. The Kleiner Perkins logo sits bottom-left at x 1.8%, with the source note beside it at x 10.5%; the page label is bottom-right, right-aligned to about x 97.7%. No slide number other than the 'PAGE 268' label appears.

**Visuals**

Three bar charts. (1) Vertical bar chart, title 'Total K-12 Student Enrollments by Country (MM), 2015'. Y-axis titled 'Students (MM)', range 0 to 300 with gridlines every 50 (0, 50, 100, 150, 200, 250, 300). X-axis categories India, China, US, UK. Single series with bars: India about 252 MM (yellow bar, highlighted with a black rectangular outline box around the India column and its label); China about 182 MM; US about 50 MM; UK about 8 MM. All values are estimates since no values are printed. Bars are #00689D except India #FFC000. No legend. (2) Vertical bar chart, title 'Indian Private Coaching Industry, 2014'. Y-axis titled '% of Students', range 0% to 50% with gridlines every 10%. X-axis categories Primary, Upper Primary, Secondary. Series '% of Students Enrolled in Private Coaching' (teal #02B5CC bars) with printed values: Primary 22%, Upper Primary 26%, Secondary 37%. Legend below the axis: teal square followed by '% of Students Enrolled in Private Coaching'. No bar highlighted. (3) Horizontal bar chart, title 'Reasons for Private Coaching'. Category axis labels from top: Others, Entrance Exam Prep, Prep for Job Exams, Augmenting Basic Education. X-axis 0% to 100% in steps of 20%, vertical light grey gridlines. Series '% of Respondents' (green #31AF78 bars) with printed values: Others 2%, Entrance Exam Prep 2%, Prep for Job Exams 8%, Augmenting Basic Education 89%. Legend below: green square followed by '% of Respondents'. Also one logo: KLEINER PERKINS wordmark in green, stacked two lines, bottom-left, placed image 164 by 96 pixels.

**Design**

Background white #FFFFFF. Title band navy #00517A with a thin cyan rule below it (about #02B5CC, roughly 0.7% of slide height). Title text white #FFFFFF, Arial regular (sans-serif), about 3.2% of slide height per line, not bold. Chart titles and axis labels are Arial Bold, black #000000, chart titles about 2.6% to 3.0% of slide height, tick and category labels about 1.8% to 2.0%. Source and page label are Arial regular at about 1.3% and 1.5% of slide height; page label grey #A6AAA9, source black #000000. Accent colours: gold #FFC000 (India bar), dark blue #00689D (China, US, UK bars), cyan #02B5CC (coaching bars), green #31AF78 (reasons bars and logo). Gridlines light grey (approx #D9D9D9), 0.75 pt. Bars are flat with no shadows, no rounded corners. The India highlight is a black outline rectangle about 2 pt wide with no fill.

### Slide 272

**Text**

…India Healthcare Re-Imagined = Increasingly Accessible (via DIY / Mobile) + / Affordable (via Online Aggregation + Pricing Transparency) / THEN / NOW / Offline Labs & Pharmacies / Online Health Hubs / ex. 1Mg, Portea / Long wait times for standard lab tests / Limited drug inventory / Geography dependent / Up to 60-80% price variance for / identical drugs owing to lack of price / transparency / In-home tests ordered online / Access to aggregated inventories of / multiple pharmacies in metro / 40-50% lower prices for lab tests / Instant drug price comparisons offer / transparency, saving users 20 - 30% per / prescription / One app for all health needs / Medicines / Lab Tests / Doctors / Online Consultation / FLAT 20% OFF / Source: 1Mg, Portea, CDSCO Report 2016 / KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 271

**Layout**

Two equal columns split by a thin vertical grey divider at about 52 percent of the slide width, under a full-width dark teal title band across the top. Each column has an italic THEN or NOW label, a bold centred heading, and a bulleted list, with photographs or an app image beneath; the source line sits bottom left beside the Kleiner Perkins logo and the footer with page reference sits bottom right, with generous white margins.

**Visuals**

Three photographs and one logo. (1) Left, crowded interior: about 20 seated and standing people in a bright, high-ceilinged hall with an orange-brown tiled roof and white columns, viewed from the front at eye level; full-colour, boxed rectangle with square corners and no overlay, slightly soft focus. (2) Centre-bottom, pharmacy storefront: a small shop front with pink-orange walls and fascia reading PHARMACY, with two red-and-white MEDICINE / दवाईयां banners flanking a green cross logo, shelves of stock visible inside, a red cross sign at left, and a watermark reading www.shutterstock.com · 319340133 at the bottom; boxed, no overlay. (3) Right, app promotion image: a flat bright cyan #00C2D6 background with a white heading One app for all health needs, four dark navy-teal #1F3A4D circular icons with white glyphs labelled Medicines, Lab Tests, Doctors and Online Consultation, and a black smartphone mockup at right showing a grid of app icons and a white card reading FLAT 20% OFF; a small dark teal square with a white 1 logo sits bottom right corner; boxed, no shadow. (4) Bottom-left Kleiner Perkins logo: bold green #3DBA6B uppercase wordmark KLEINER over PERKINS in a sans-serif, stacked.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. White #FFFFFF background with a dark teal header band #00517A across the top about 12.5 percent of the slide height, with a thin lighter teal #1BA3B8 rule along its lower edge. Title text is white #FFFFFF regular Arial sans-serif at about 3.7 percent of slide height, left-aligned. Column labels THEN and NOW are black #000000 Arial italic at about 3.0 percent. Column headings are black #000000 Arial bold at about 3.7 percent. Subtitle ex. 1Mg, Portea is black Arial regular at about 3.0 percent. Bullet text is black #000000 Arial regular at about 2.6 percent with square Wingdings bullets in black. Footer is grey #A6AAA9 Arial regular at about 1.5 percent, source line black Arial at about 1.3 percent. Divider is a light grey #C8C8C8 vertical line about 0.2 percent wide with no shadow. Photographs have square corners, no borders, and no shadows.

ComScore data based on panel and census and only includes Android.

**Layout**

Full-width dark blue header band across the top with the two-line title left-aligned in white, below which two side-by-side bar charts fill the content area (left chart wider, with a dual-axis, right chart narrower). Chart titles are centred above each chart, legends sit below the left chart and right chart, the Kleiner Perkins logo and source lines sit at bottom left, and the footer text 'KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 278' sits at bottom right; there is no separate slide-number element beyond that footer.

**Visuals**

Two bar charts. LEFT: clustered combo chart titled 'India Population by Age Group, 2015' with a primary left y-axis 'Population (MM)' from 0 to 500 in steps of 50 and a secondary right y-axis '% of Total Population' from 0% to 40% in steps of 8%. X-axis 'Age Group' with categories 0-14, 15-34, 35-49, 50-64, 65+. Series 1 is cyan columns (population in MM, approx. values: 0-14 about 377, 15-34 about 458, 35-49 about 243, 50-64 about 158, 65+ about 73; no values printed). Series 2 is red square markers on the secondary axis (% of population, approx. values: 0-14 about 28.8%, 15-34 about 35.0%, 35-49 about 18.6%, 50-64 about 12.1%, 65+ about 5.7%; no values printed). A black dashed vertical line sits between the 15-34 and 35-49 categories. Legend below: cyan square 'Population by Age Group (MM)' and red square '% of Population'. RIGHT: column chart titled 'Distribution of India Internet Users by Age Group, 2017', y-axis 'Distribution of Internet Users by Age Group (%)' from 0% to 40% in steps of 5%, x-axis 'Age Group' with categories 6-14, 15-24, 25-34, 35-44, 45+. Single cyan column series (approx. values, no values printed: 6-14 about 4.5%, 15-24 about 36.6%, 25-34 about 30.5%, 35-44 about 15.8%, 45+ about 12.6%). Legend below: cyan square 'Internet Users by Age Group'. Logo: KLEINER PERKINS wordmark in green, stacked on two lines, bottom left.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. Clean white content area with a dark teal-blue header band (#00517A) containing white sans-serif title text, with a thin cyan (#02B5CC) rule under the band. Chart columns are cyan #02B5CC, markers are red #FF0000, axis and chart text are black #000000 in bold Arial, gridlines light grey #D9D9D9 thin horizontal lines, no shadows or gradients. Title text is Arial regular, about 4.4% of slide height for the header lines; chart titles are Arial Bold about 3.0%; axis labels and legends are Arial Bold about 2.2%; source lines about 1.3%; footer about 1.5% in grey #A6AAA9.

**Layout**

Two side-by-side line charts fill the body below a full-width dark blue title band, the left chart occupying roughly the left half (x 10 to 49%) and the right chart the right half (x 58 to 96%). The title sits left-aligned in two lines inside the top band with a left margin of about 1.4%; chart titles are centred above each chart, and the legends sit centred below each chart. The Kleiner Perkins logo sits bottom-left with the source lines to its right, and the running footer 'KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 279' sits bottom-right; no slide number is printed beyond that footer.

**Visuals**

Two line charts. Left chart: line chart titled 'Percent (%) of Population 15 – 64 Years Old, India vs. China vs. More Developed Regions, 1950 – 2050E'. Y axis 'Percent of Population Between Ages 15 - 64', range 50% to 75% in 5% steps, gridlines at each step. X axis years 1955 to 2050E at 5-year steps (labels rotated vertical). Series: India (green), China (red), More Developed Regions (cyan). Values are not printed; about values read from the chart: India about 58.1 (1955), 55.4 (1965), 59.3 (1995), 65.7 (2015), 67.4 (2025E), 68.0 (2040E), 67.2 (2050E). China about 58.1 (1955), 55.4 (1965), 66.4 (1995), 74.3 (2010 peak), 70.8 (2020E), 68.0 (2030E), 62.1 (2040E), 58.9 (2050E). More Developed Regions about 64.4 (1955), 63.3 (1960), 67.0 (1985), 67.5 (2000), 66.0 (2015), 64.1 (2020E), 61.1 (2030E), 57.8 (2050E). A black bracket with down-ticks spans 2020E to 2050E above the India line, labelled 'Peak Working Age Population'. Legend centred below the chart: India (green line), China (red line), More Developed Regions (cyan line). Right chart: line chart titled 'Per Capita Income Distribution, India / USA / China by Age, 2015' with subtitle '(Index to the Highest Income Age Category for Corresponding Country)'. Y axis 'Index to Highest Income Age Group in Country (100)', range 0 to 120 in steps of 20, gridlines at each step. X axis age groups 15-19 to 65+ (vertical labels). Series: India (green), USA (blue), China (red). Values not printed; about values: India 37 (15-19), 76 (20-24), 91 (25-29), 98 (30-34), 100 (35-39), 98 (40-44), 93 (45-49), 88 (50-54), 81 (55-59), 74 (60-64), 59 (65+). USA 16 (15-19), 42 (20-24), 66 (25-29), 82 (30-34), 92 (35-39), 97 (40-44), 99 (45-49), 100 (50-54), 99 (55-59), 90 (60-64), 58 (65+). China 33 (15-19), 80 (20-24), 95 (25-29), 100 (30-34), 98 (35-39), 93 (40-44), 89 (45-49), 87 (50-54), 84 (55-59), 78 (60-64), 63 (65+). No series is highlighted with markers. Legend centred below: India, USA, China. Logo: Kleiner Perkins wordmark in green, bottom-left, boxed as an image.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF, with a full-width dark teal-blue #00517A title band across the top 12.5% of the slide. Clean corporate report style. Title band is solid dark teal-blue #00517A with a thin cyan rule beneath it. Title text is white regular sans-serif (Arial), about 3.9% of slide height, sentence case. Chart titles and axis labels are black Arial Bold about 2.2% of slide height; the subtitle and the note are Arial Italic about 1.5%. Tick labels are Arial Bold about 2.0%. Source lines are Arial regular about 1.3% in black; footer text is Arial regular about 1.5% in grey #A6AAA9. Lines are 3 px-equivalent solid strokes: India green #3AAA74, China red #FF0000, More Developed Regions and USA cyan-blue #00B0F0. Gridlines thin light grey #D9D9D9. No shadows, gradients, or rounded corners.

**Layout**

Full-width header band across the top of the slide holding a two-line left-aligned white title; below it a single centred bold chart title over a full-width line chart occupying the middle of the slide, with a legend centred under the x-axis. Footer row at the bottom with the Kleiner Perkins logo at far left, a three-line source note left-aligned beside it, and a right-aligned grey running footer 'KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 282' at bottom right. No slide number element separate from the footer text; left margin about 2 percent of slide width.

**Visuals**

Line chart. Title: 'India Working Age (15-64 Years Old) Population vs. Employment, 1995 – 2050E'. Y-axis: 'Population Between Ages 15 – 64 and Employment Level (MM)', linear scale 0 to 1,400,000 in steps of 200,000, gridlines light grey (#D9D9D9). X-axis: years 1995, 2000, 2005, 2010, 2015 (actual), then 2020E to 2050E in 5-year steps (estimates), labels bold black. Series 1 'India Working Age Population', solid green line (#00B050-like) from 1995 to 2015, then dashed green from 2015 to 2050E; values about 1995 570,000; 2000 about 640,000; 2005 about 710,000; 2010 about 790,000; 2015 about 865,000; 2050E about 1,145,000 (no values printed). Series 2 'Employment', solid red line (#FF0000) 1995 to 2015; values about 1995 345,000; 2000 about 395,000; 2005 about 457,000; 2010 about 460,000; 2015 about 473,000 (no values printed). Legend at bottom centre: green line 'India Working Age Population', red line 'Employment'. Annotation: horizontal black double-headed arrow from about 2017 at the 830,000 level to 2050E, labelled above it '+280MM' and 'Working-Age Population' in black regular text; vertical black double-headed arrow at the right edge spanning about 830,000 to 1,145,000 marking the gap. No highlighted points.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. White background (#FFFFFF). Header band filled deep teal-blue #00517A with a thin cyan rule (about #00A3C4) along its bottom edge. Title text white (#FFFFFF) in Arial regular, about 3.7% of slide height, two lines. Chart title and axis labels black (#000000) in Arial Bold, about 3.0% (chart title) and 2.0% (tick labels) of slide height. Annotation text black Arial regular 2.6%. Source text black Arial regular 1.3%. Running footer grey #A6AAA9 Arial regular 1.5%. Sharp rectangles, no corner radii, no shadows, no gradients. Logo in green #2DB36F.

### Slide 287

**Text**

India Gender Disparity = / Female Labor Participation Rate @ 27%...Below World Average / Female Labor Force Participation Rate, 2008 - 2016 / 70% / 60% / 50% / 40% / Labor Participation Rate (%) / 30% / 20% / 10% / 0% / 2008 / 2009 / 2010 / 2011 / 2012 / 2013 / 2014 / 2015 / 2016 / India / USA / China / Brazil / Russia / World Average / Source: International Labor Organization, 2016 / Note: ILO defines female labor force participation rate as the proportion of the female population of age 15 and older that is economically active: / all people who supply labor for the production of goods and services during a specified period. / KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 286

**Layout**

A full-width dark blue title band across the top about 12.5% of the slide height holds a two-line left-aligned white title starting at about 2.1% from the left edge, with a thin cyan rule under the band. Below it, a centred bold chart title sits above a single line chart whose plot area spans roughly x 13% to 95% and y 24% to 78%, with the y-axis title rotated on the left, year labels under the plot, and a horizontal legend row at about 83.5% height. The footer has the Kleiner Perkins logo bottom-left, a three-line source and note block beside it at about 92% to 96% height, and a right-aligned grey footer tag 'KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 286' at the bottom right; there is no slide number other than the printed page 286 in the footer.

**Visuals**

Line chart with markers titled 'Female Labor Force Participation Rate, 2008 - 2016'. X-axis: years 2008 to 2016, categorical, one tick per year, no axis title. Y-axis: 'Labor Participation Rate (%)', linear, 0% to 70% in 10% steps, light grey horizontal gridlines at each 10%. Six series with round circular markers and about 3 pt lines. Values are not printed on the slide, so the following are estimates marked about. India (green #3CB371-like): about 31.7, 30.1, 28.5, 27.7, 26.8, 26.8, 26.6, 26.7, 26.9 for 2008 to 2016. USA (dark blue #0B5EA8-like): about 58.3, 58.1, 57.6, 56.9, 56.5, 56.2, 56.0, 55.9, 55.7. China (cyan #00BCD4-like): about 65.0, 64.3, 63.8, 63.8, 63.8, 63.8, 63.7, 63.5, 63.3. Brazil (crimson #C8175A-like): about 58.6, 59.0, 57.6, 56.1, 56.1, 55.8, 56.3, 56.2, 56.0. Russia (orange #E07B17-like): about 57.0, 57.0, 56.5, 57.0, 57.0, 56.7, 56.6, 56.6, 56.4. World Average (yellow #FBB829-like): about 50.8, 50.4, 50.0, 49.8, 49.7, 49.7, 49.7, 49.6, 49.5. Legend: horizontal row below the x-axis with line-and-marker keys in series order India, USA, China, Brazil, Russia, World Average. Highlighted points: none; India is the lowest series and is the title's focus. No other chart elements.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. Flat design with no gradients or shadows. Title band is solid dark teal-blue #00517A with a thin bright cyan #00B0CC-like rule along its bottom edge. Title text is white #FFFFFF in Arial regular, sentence case, about 4.3% of slide height, line-height about 1.2. Chart title and all chart labels are Arial bold, black #000000, chart title about 3.4% of height and tick and legend labels about 2.2% of height. Footer text is Arial regular, black #000000 at about 1.3% of height, and the page tag is Arial regular grey #A6AAA9 at about 1.5%. Series colours as listed above, with the green India line the most distinct. Gridlines are thin light grey #D9D9D9. Rectangular, square-cornered band, no rounded corners, no borders on the plot.

**Layout**

Four-quadrant comparison grid split by a vertical divider at the slide centre. Left half holds X-Ray (top row) and ECG (bottom row); right half holds Blood Pressure (top row) and Hospital Monitoring (bottom row), each with a 2000’s/2017 or Analog/Digital column pair. The title sits left-aligned in a full-width dark header band at the top; the source line sits bottom-left beside the Kleiner Perkins logo and the footer with page number sits bottom-right.

**Visuals**

Eight photographs in a 2 by 2 grid of comparison pairs, all boxed with no border, no overlay and no tint. Top-left pair (X-Ray): a grayscale 2D panoramic dental X-ray of upper and lower teeth on a light grey-black background, cropped to a rectangle; beside it a full-colour 3D CT rendering of a skull and teeth in tan and bone-white tones with green-outlined brackets on a black background, cropped to a rectangle. Top-right pair (Blood Pressure): a blue cuff manual sphygmomanometer with a black tube, grey gauge and black rubber bulb on a white background; beside it a light blue and white handheld automatic blood pressure monitor showing 120, 80 and 70 on a small colour screen, on a white background. Bottom-left pair (ECG): a paper-based ECG recorder with printed chart paper and a bundle of multicoloured lead wires on a blue background; beside it a hand pressing a white adhesive wearable ECG patch on a white background. Bottom-right pair (Hospital Monitoring): a grey and white bedside patient monitor with a colour screen showing an ECG trace and the number 54, on a white background; beside it a wall of four flat-screen monitors displaying multiple green, red and white waveforms on dark screens. Plus a vertical divider line and a Kleiner Perkins logo as described under elements.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. White background with a dark teal header band across the top 12.5 percent of the slide, a thin teal rule beneath it, and black bold labels on white. Title text is white regular sans-serif (Arial). Column and row labels are black bold Arial, with the 2000’s and 2017 year headers bold and underlined. Body labels are black bold Arial. Title size about 4.3 percent of slide height, labels about 3.0 percent, sub-labels about 2.6 percent, footer about 1.5 percent. Divider is a thin light grey vertical rule. No corner radii, shadows or gradients.

### Slide 296

**Text**

…Consumers = / Willing to Share Health Data / Leading Tech Brands Positioned Well for Digital Health, 2016 / With which tech company would you share your data? / 100% / 90% / 80% / 70% / 60% / 60% / 56% / 54% / 50% / % of Consumers Willing to Share Health Data / 50% / 39% / 39% / 40% / 37% / 30% / 20% / 10% / 0% / Google / Microsoft / Samsung / Apple / Amazon / Facebook / IBM / KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 295 / Source: Rock Health 2016 Consumer Survey / Note: Based on consumer survey with 4,015 participants; as % of respondents willing to share their health data with tech company at all.

**Layout**

Full-width dark blue header band across the top 12.5% of the slide holds a two-line left-aligned title at a left margin of about 2% of the width. Below it, a centred bold chart title and an italic question sit above a single-series vertical bar chart whose plot area spans roughly x 19.6% to 92% with the y-axis title rotated on the far left. The Kleiner Perkins logo sits bottom-left with the source and note lines to its right, and the grey footer 'KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 295' sits bottom-right.

**Visuals**

Chart: vertical bar chart, single series, bars in solid #00689D. Chart title (bold, above chart): Leading Tech Brands Positioned Well for Digital Health, 2016. Question (italic, above plot): With which tech company would you share your data? Y-axis title: % of Consumers Willing to Share Health Data, units percent, range 0% to 100% with gridlines every 10%. X-axis categories: Google, Microsoft, Samsung, Apple, Amazon, Facebook, IBM. Labelled values: Google 60%, Microsoft 56%, Samsung 54%, Apple 50%, Amazon 39%, Facebook 39%, IBM 37%. Bar heights are printed values, no estimates needed. Gridlines are thin light grey horizontal lines at each 10% step, spanning the plot width. No legend. No highlighted points; all bars are the same colour. Logo: KLEINER PERKINS, two-line bold uppercase wordmark in green, at bottom-left.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF covering the whole slide. Clean corporate report style. Header band solid #00517A with a thin cyan rule beneath it in about #00A9C4. Title text white #FFFFFF in regular Arial-style sans-serif, approximately 4.4% of slide height per line (cap height about 3.1%). Chart title and axis labels in bold Arial-style sans-serif, black #000000, about 3.3% (chart title) and 2.2% (axis and category labels) of slide height. Question in italic Arial, black, about 2.6%. Source and note in regular Arial, black, 1.3%. Footer in regular Arial, grey #A6AAA9, 1.5%. Bars #00689D with no outline, square corners, no shadows. Gridlines #D9D9D9 at about 1 px. Accent colours: header #00517A, bars #00689D, logo green about #3DB86F.

**Layout**

Two equal chart columns sit side by side beneath a full-width dark blue title band across the top 12.5% of the slide. The title is left-aligned in white, starting at about x 2.1%, on two lines. A thin vertical grey divider at about x 51.4% separates the left line chart from the right stacked column chart, and both chart headings are centred over their columns in bold black. The Kleiner Perkins logo sits bottom-left at about x 1.8%, with the source lines beside it from x 10.5%, and the page footer right-aligned near x 97% at the bottom.

**Visuals**

Chart 1 is a line chart titled EHR Adoption Among Office-Based Physicians, USA 2004-2015. The y-axis is labelled EHR Adoption (%) with ticks 0% to 100% in 10% steps; gridlines are light grey. The x-axis runs 2004 to 2015 with year labels rotated about 45 degrees. A single red (#FF0000) line of about 3 pt width has labelled values 21% at 2004 and 87% at 2015. Intermediate values are not printed; about 24% in 2005, about 29% in 2006, about 35% in 2007, about 42% in 2008, about 48% in 2009, about 51% in 2010, about 57% in 2011, about 72% in 2012, about 78% in 2013 and about 83% in 2014. No legend. No points are highlighted.

Chart 2 is a single stacked column titled Average Amount of Clinical Data Elements per Patient per Year*, 8/16. The y-axis is labelled Unique Data Elements Per Patient, with ticks 0 to 30 in steps of 5 and light grey gridlines. The column total is labelled 26.3 above it. Segments from bottom to top: Other (e.g. medications, allergens, etc.) 5.5 in green #31AF78; Problems (historical, current) 2.9 in dark blue about #00669B; Vital Signs 3.2 in cyan #02B5CC; Scanned Images 4.1 in red-orange #EA543B; Clinical Results 10.5 in yellow #FCD03F. Segment values are printed in the segments: 5.5 and 2.9 and 3.2 and 4.1 in white, 10.5 in black. A legend sits to the right of the column with square swatches matching each segment, listed top to bottom Clinical Results, Scanned Images, Vital Signs, Problems (historical, current), Other (e.g. medications, allergens, etc.). No points are highlighted.

Logo: the Kleiner Perkins wordmark KLEINER over PERKINS in bold green #31AF78 sans-serif capitals, bottom-left, about 7.5% wide.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. Clean corporate look on a white slide. Title is white (#FFFFFF) regular sans-serif (Arial/Helvetica-like) on a dark blue band #00517A, with a thin cyan (#02B5CC) rule under the band. Chart headings and all axis and data labels are bold black (#000000) Arial Bold, with the heading at about 2.96% of slide height and tick and data labels at about 2.22%. Title text is about 4.44% of slide height. Source text is regular Arial about 1.29% in black. Footer text is regular Arial about 1.49% in grey #A6AAA9. Lines are flat with no shadows, corners, gradients or rounded shapes. Gridlines are thin light grey (#D9D9D9); the divider is light grey #D9D9D9.

**Text**

…Increasing Digitization of Inputs = / Healthcare Data Growing at 48% Y/Y / Growth in Healthcare Data / Data Drivers / Typical 500 Bed / Hospital / 200 / 180 / 160 / 140 / 120 / 100 / 80 / 60 / 40 / 20 / 0 / Exabytes of Healthcare Data / 153 / Exabytes / 48% Annual  Growth / Worldwide Healthcare Data (2013) / • 500 Beds / • 8,000 Employees / • 400 Applications / • 500 Databases / • 1,000 Interfaces / • 10,000 Desktops / • 500 Owned/Controlled / Tablets / • 2,000 / Owned/Controlled / Mobile Devices / 50 / Petabytes / of Data per / Hospital / Source: IDC & EMC (12/13) / Note: 1 Exabyte = 1B Gigabytes, 1 Petabyte = 1M Gigabytes / KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 300

**Layout**

Two-column layout below a full-width title band: a bar chart occupies the left column (about x 6 to 47%) and a bordered 'Data Drivers' panel with a chevron and a result box occupies the right column (about x 53 to 96%), separated by a vertical grey divider at about x 50.4%. The title is left-aligned in the top band at about x 2.1%, with two lines starting at y 1.7% and 6.8%. Column headings are centred above each column at about y 18.5%. The Kleiner Perkins logo sits bottom-left at x 1.8%, y 92.2%, with the source and note lines to its right; the footer 'KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 300' is bottom-right, right-aligned to about x 97.7%, with a page number printed on the slide (it reads 300 although the slide is numbered 301 in the sequence). Outer margins are about 2 percent on the left and right.

**Visuals**

Bar chart titled 'Growth in Healthcare Data'. Type: single vertical column chart with a red arrow annotation. Y axis: title 'Exabytes of Healthcare Data' (unit: exabytes), linear scale from 0 to 200 with labelled ticks every 20 (0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100, 120, 140, 160, 180, 200), light grey horizontal gridlines at each tick. X axis: category label 'Worldwide Healthcare Data (2013)', one category, no tick labels. Series: one series with one bar, value printed as 153 Exabytes above the bar; bar height about 153 on the axis (about 153 exabytes). Bar fill #00689D, spanning x 24.6 to 35.4%, y 44.4 to 84.4%. Legend: none. Highlighted points: none. Annotation: a straight crimson arrow #C81B51 rising from about (16.9%, 41%) to an arrowhead at about (41.7%, 29.2%), labelled '48% Annual  Growth' in bold black text rotated about 20 degrees along the arrow, sitting above the bar. Right panel: a rounded rectangle outline with a cyan stroke containing a bulleted list of 'Typical 500 Bed Hospital' items: 500 Beds; 8,000 Employees; 400 Applications; 500 Databases; 1,000 Interfaces; 10,000 Desktops; 500 Owned/Controlled Tablets; 2,000 Owned/Controlled Mobile Devices. A solid cyan chevron (right-pointing triangular arrow, no tail) sits between the panel and the result box, pointing right. A second rounded rectangle with a cyan outline holds '50 Petabytes of Data per Hospital'. Logo: Kleiner Perkins wordmark in bold green capitals, two stacked lines 'KLEINER' over 'PERKINS', green about #3BB97A, bottom-left.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. White background. Title band in dark teal-blue #00517A across the top 12.5% of the slide, with a thin bright cyan rule #00B5CC along its bottom edge. Title text is white (#FFFFFF) in Arial regular (sans-serif), about 4.4% of slide height for the cap-height-scaled line. Chart headings and panel headings are black (#000000) Arial Bold, about 3.3% of slide height. Body and bullet text is black Arial regular about 2.2% of slide height. Chart bar is #00689D, arrow and its label accent is crimson #C81B51, panel borders and chevron are cyan #02B5CC. Footer text is light grey #A6AAA9 Arial regular about 1.5%. Source and note text is black Arial regular about 1.3%. Divider is a thin light grey vertical line about #D9D9D9. Panel outlines have large rounded corners (about 5% of width) on the tall panel and small rounded corners on the result box, with no shadows and no gradients.

**Layout**

A full-width dark teal title band fills the top 12.5% of the slide, with a two-line white title left-aligned at about 2% from the left edge. Below it, a centred bold chart title sits above a single bar chart spanning roughly the centre of the slide, with the legend centred beneath the category labels. The Kleiner Perkins logo sits bottom-left at about 2% margin, with the source and note block to its right, and the footer 'KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 304' bottom-right, right-aligned to about 97%.

**Visuals**

Chart: clustered vertical bar chart. Chart title (bold, black): 'Selection Biomarkers (Enabled by DNA Sequencing) for Enrolling Patients in Clinical Trials Improves Probability of Success'. Y-axis: titled 'Probability of Success' (bold, rotated), unit percent, range 0% to 100% in 10% steps, light grey horizontal gridlines at each 10% step. X-axis: five categories, labels bold black: 'Phase I to Phase II', 'Phase II to Phase III', 'Phase III to NDA/BLA', 'NDA/BLA to Approval', 'Phase I to Approval'. Series 1 'Without Biomarkers', green #31AF78 bars, labelled values: 63%, 28%, 55%, 83%, 8%. Series 2 'With Selection Biomarkers', blue #00689D bars, labelled values: 76%, 46%, 76%, 94%, 26%. Bars are flat, no outline, no shadow; value labels bold black sit above each bar. Legend: centred below the x-axis labels, green square swatch followed by 'Without Biomarkers', then blue square swatch followed by 'With Selection Biomarkers'. No highlighted points. Logo: 'KLEINER PERKINS' wordmark in bold green stacked on two lines, one colour #31AF78, boxed in no frame.

**Design**

Background white #FFFFFF. Header band fill dark teal-blue #00517A, full width, 12.5% of height, with a thin bright cyan accent line #1BB0C8 along its bottom edge. Title text white #FFFFFF, Arial regular (ArialMT), about 4.4% of slide height, line spacing about 1.15. Chart title and axis, category and legend text: Arial Bold, black #000000, about 2.2% of slide height for tick labels and categories, about 3.3% for chart title. Footnotes Arial regular black #000000 at about 1.3%. Footer text Arial regular grey #A6AAA9 at about 1.5%. Bars: green #31AF78 and blue #00689D, square corners, no shadows, no gradients. Gridlines light grey, thin, about 1px. Logo green #31AF78.

### Slide 307

**Text**

…As Data Accumulates & Silos Breakdown… / Research Insights Could Accelerate… / Growing Evidence That Data = / Cheaper + Faster Clinical Trials / Traditional Trial vs. Simulation / Traditional UK / Department / of Health Study / Archimedes Data / Simulation / Number of / Patients / 2,838 / 50,000 / Years of Data / 7 Years / 30 Years / Length of / Study / 7 Years / 2 Months / Conclusion / Out of 4 principal findings Archimedes predicted / 2 exactly right, 1 within the margin of error, and 1 / slightly below. / Archimedes Simulation = a mathematical model to simulate (1) human / physiology and disease, (2) care process models, and (3) healthcare system / resources. Ran virtual trials of large, simulated populations in a fraction of the / time and cost of a traditional study. / Source: Wired (11/09), National Academy of Engineering (David Eddy, 2015) / Note: The UK Department of Health launched a trial study, Collaborative Atorvastatin Diabetes Study (Cards), and the American Diabetes / Association asked David Eddy to conduct a simulation addressing the same issues before the UK results were released. / KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 306

**Layout**

A single centred column on a white slide: a full-width dark blue title band across the top with a two-line left-aligned title starting about 2% from the left edge, a centred bold two-line heading above a centred three-column table (label column left, two data columns right), a centred italic-free definition paragraph below the table, and a footer row with the Kleiner Perkins logo at bottom left, source and note lines beside it, and the running footer and page number at bottom right. The page number reads PAGE 306 although the slide is 307 of 356.

**Visuals**

One table with a blue merged header row spanning all three columns reading Traditional Trial vs. Simulation. Below it a column header row with an empty first cell, then Traditional UK Department of Health Study, then Archimedes Data Simulation. Rows: Number of Patients | 2,838 | 50,000; Years of Data | 7 Years | 30 Years; Length of Study | 7 Years | 2 Months; Conclusion | Out of 4 principal findings Archimedes predicted 2 exactly right, 1 within the margin of error, and 1 slightly below. Data rows alternate white and very pale blue #F3FAFF, separated by black horizontal rules under rows 1 to 3. The Kleiner Perkins logo is a green wordmark stacked as KLEINER over PERKINS at bottom left, about #3CB371 green. No photographs, charts or icons.

Title text white #FFFFFF in Arial regular, sans-serif, about 4.1% of slide height, two lines. Heading and table header text white bold Arial. Heading text black bold Arial about 3.3% of slide height. ### Slide 314

**Text**

Genomics Digitizes = Gets Faster / Better / Cheaper… / Introduction of Digital Technology Accelerates Cost / Reduction Faster Than Moore’s Law / $100M / $10M / $1M / Cost to Sequence (per Genome) / $100K / $10K / 2007: Digital Technology Leads To Cost / Reduction / Illumina (Solexa) Launches the Genome Analyzer / Time to sequence a genome: 10 Months / Moore’s Law / 2015: Step Function Reduction In Cost / Illumina Launches the X10 / Time to sequence a genome: 27 hours / $1K / 2001 / 2002 / 2003 / 2004 / 2005 / 2006 / 2007 / 2008 / 2009 / 2010 / 2011 / 2012 / 2013 / 2014 / 2015 / Source: National Institute of Health, National Human Genome Research Institute (7/17), Biology Reference, Illumina / KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 313

**Layout**

A full-width dark-blue title band runs across the top 12.5% of the slide with a left-aligned white title at x 2.1%, with a thin teal rule under it. Below, a centred two-line bold chart headline sits above a full-width log-scale line chart whose plot runs from about x 14.5% to 87%, with a source line and the Kleiner Perkins logo at bottom left and the footer text at bottom right; two annotation blocks and two machine photographs sit in the upper and lower right of the plot area. Margins are about 2% left and right.

**Visuals**

Line chart titled 'Introduction of Digital Technology Accelerates Cost Reduction Faster Than Moore’s Law' (headline above chart, not a plot title). Y axis: 'Cost to Sequence (per Genome)', logarithmic scale from $1K at bottom to $100M at top, with labelled ticks $1K, $10K, $100K, $1M, $10M, $100M and light grey horizontal gridlines at each tick. X axis: years 2001 to 2015 in bold, rotated about 45 degrees, one tick per year. Series 1: solid red line (about 2001 $100M, about 2002 $70M, about 2003 $40M, about 2004 $18M, about 2005 $15M, about 2006 $10M, about 2007 $6M, about 2008 $300K, about 2009 $100K, about 2010 $30K, about 2011 $8K, about 2012 $6K, about 2013 $5K, about 2014 $5K, about 2015 $1.2K); no values are printed on the slide, so all are estimates. Series 2: dashed dark-teal straight Moore’s Law trend line from $100M at 2001 to about $750K at 2015, labelled 'Moore’s Law' in bold black at its right end. No legend. Annotations: '2007: Digital Technology Leads To Cost Reduction, Illumina (Solexa) Launches the Genome Analyzer, Time to sequence a genome: 10 Months' placed near the 2007 point; '2015: Step Function Reduction In Cost, Illumina Launches the X10, Time to sequence a genome: 27 hours' placed near the 2015 end of the red line. No points are highlighted with markers. Photographs: an Illumina Genome Analyzer (Solexa) instrument, a boxy blue-grey and white benchtop sequencer with a dark front panel, shown in a three-quarter view with a light background, boxed and not cropped, at upper right; an Illumina X10 sequencer, a white and black instrument with a small touchscreen on top and a drawer at lower front, shown in front three-quarter view on white, boxed and not cropped, at right below the Moore’s Law label. No overlays or tints. Logo: Kleiner Perkins wordmark in green at bottom left.

### Slide 319

**Text**

…Digitization = Democratization / Digitization = Enabling New Business Models in Genomics / DNA Sequenced Once / Query Often: Ecosystem of / Products from Partner / Organizations / More Empowered + / Informed Consumers / Source: Helix (5/17) / KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 318

**Layout**

Full-width dark blue title band across the top with the title left-aligned at about 2% from the left edge, and a centred bold subtitle beneath it. The content is a three-column flow: a sequencing illustration on the left, a DNA helix with partner logos in the centre, and a grid of person icons on the right, each column with a bold centred caption below. The Kleiner Perkins logo sits bottom-left beside a small source line, and the footer with page number sits bottom-right.

**Visuals**

Left column: a grey block arrow (#F2F2F2) pointing right, with blue TAGTACTAG text on it; a circular magnifier (light grey outline, white fill) enclosing a sample tube with a pink, yellow and blue graphic. Below it, a line drawing of a Helix sequencing machine (white box with grey outline, Helix logo at top right) on a platform with a small tube and TAGTACTAG text. Centre column: a faint grey double-helix (#F2F2F2 strands) with dotted grey lines running from the arrow to the helix; seven partner logos placed on the helix: a colourful circular logo (orange, magenta and grey shapes), GoodStart Genetics (grey text), Mount Sinai (blue and magenta stripes with black serif text), Mayo Clinic (black serif text with blue shield emblem), Duke University (blue serif text), INVITAE (black spaced capitals), and a green-blue swirl logo. Right column: a light green gradient wedge (fading from #6CC19A-tinted to white) fanning from the helix to a grid of 17 groups of four green person icons (#6CC19A), arranged in seven rows: 2, 3, 2, 3, 2, 3, 2 groups.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. White background (#FFFFFF). Header band full width in dark teal-blue #00517A with a thin cyan rule (about #00A3C4) along its lower edge. Title in white regular sans-serif (Arial), about 4.4% of slide height. Subtitle and captions in bold black Arial (#000000), subtitle about 3.3% and captions about 2.2% of slide height. Accent colours: person icons and Kleiner Perkins logo in green (#6CC19A and #3DB27C). Footer and page reference in light grey #A6AAA9, Arial regular about 1.5%. Source line in black Arial about 1.3%. Shapes are flat with no shadows; the arrow is a flat light grey block shape; the green wedge is a soft gradient fade.

**Layout**

A full-width dark blue header band across the top holds a left-aligned white title. Below it, three equal rounded-outline columns sit side by side with even gutters and wide white margins. Each column has a bold centred heading, a regular centred subtitle, a photograph and a product or instrument photograph stacked below. The Kleiner Perkins logo sits bottom-left, a source line sits to its right, and the footer with page number sits bottom-right.

**Visuals**

Six photographs and two object photographs, in three columns. Column 1 (100 Years Ago, Human Touch): top, a sepia-toned photograph of a doctor in a suit and headband with a mirror lamp examining a seated patient's ear beside an old wall-mounted telephone-style apparatus and a metal stand, warm brown tones, interior lighting; below, a photograph of a vintage brown leather doctor's bag with its clasp open and about twenty antique instruments spread around it (purple velvet-lined cases, a nasal or ear speculum, a brass stethoscope-type horn, a glass tube, gold-coloured stamp-like objects, a dark leather instrument roll), shot on a plain light grey background, full frame, not cropped. Column 2 (25 Years Ago, Machine Assisted / Analog): top, a photograph of a white-haired woman doctor in a white coat and glasses using a handheld otoscope on the ear of a seated woman with braided hair wearing a patterned hospital gown, against a beige wall with a turquoise chair, soft daylight; below, a photograph of a silver-and-black pen-style otoscope (left) and a black two-tube stethoscope with a silver chestpiece (right) on white backgrounds. Column 3 (Today, Technology Enabled / Digital): top, a photograph of a woman holding a smartphone with a cable to a small boy who has a blue cable-connected thermometer probe in his mouth, on a brown leather sofa, warm natural light, dominant colours brown, blue and white; below, a product photograph of a blue Kinsa ear thermometer with a small display reading 98.6, a white smartphone showing a blue app screen reading '98.6° No Fever' with a symptom checklist (No symptoms, Chills, Fatigue, Cough) and a green Add To Profile button, and a blue Kinsa probe with a 3.5 mm plug at the right, all on a white background with soft shadows. None of the photographs has a tint or overlay; each is boxed as a rectangle with square corners.

**Layout**

A full-width dark teal header band across the top 12.5% of the slide carries the two-line title left-aligned in white. Below it a single full-width table with six columns (Rank, Company, Region, Industry Segment, 5/31/2012 Value ($B), 2011 Revenue ($B)) runs from about 14.5% to 91.5% of the height, with a header row, 20 ranked rows and a Total row; the Rank column is centred, Company and Industry columns are left and centred respectively, and numeric value columns are right-aligned. The Kleiner Perkins logo sits bottom-left at the margin, the source and note lines sit beside it bottom-left at the table's left edge, and the footer 'KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 325' sits bottom-right; there is no separate slide number beyond that printed page reference.

**Visuals**

Line chart titled USA Net Debt / GDP Ratio, 1790 – 2047E. Y-axis titled USA Net Debt / GDP (%), range 0% to 160% in 20% steps with light grey horizontal gridlines. X-axis labelled every 25 years from 1790 to 2040 (1790, 1815, 1840, 1865, 1890, 1915, 1940, 1965, 1990, 2015, 2040), with the 2040 label at the right end of the plot. Series 1, Historical Net Debt / GDP (%): solid green line about 4 pt thick, about 30% in 1790 falling to about 0% around 1835-1845, rising to about 31% around 1865-1870, about 24% in 1875, about 0-5% from 1900 to 1915, jumping to about 33% by 1917, about 15-20% in the 1920s, about 44% in 1935, peaking at about 105% in 1946, falling to about 57% by 1958, about 27% near 1970, about 48% around 1990-1993, about 31% near 2000, about 35% near 2008, rising to about 77% by 2016. Series 2, Projected Net Debt / GDP (%): red dashed line about 3 pt thick from about 77% in 2016 rising to about 105% at 2034E and about 147% at the right edge near 2047E. Highlighted points: a black dashed horizontal reference line at about 107% from the y-axis to the 2034E point, a black dashed vertical drop line at 1946 from the 1946 peak to the x-axis, and a black dashed vertical drop line at 2034E from the reference line to the x-axis. Callout label '1946 = / ~105%' above the 1946 peak and '2034E = / ~105%' above the 2034E point. Legend centred below the x-axis: green solid line sample with label Historical Net Debt / GDP (%), and red dashed line sample with label Projected Net Debt / GDP (%).

### Slide 342

**Text**

USA Entitlements = 63% of Spending vs. 45% 25 Years Ago… / Interest Expense Down as % Owing to Interest Rate Declines… · USA Expenses by Category, 1991-2016 · $1.3T · $3.9T · 100% · 80% · 60% · 40% · 20% · 0% · 10% · 8% · 6% · 4% · 2% · 0% · US Mandatory Entitlements (%) · USA 10Y Treasury Yield (%) · 15% · 16% · 24% · 45% · 6% · 16% · 15% · 63% · 1991 · 2016 · Entitlements / Mandatory · Defense · 10Y Treasury · Non-Defense Discretionary · Net Interest Cost · Change by / Category, / 1991-2016 · Debt: / +$11T / +427% · Entitlements: / +$1.8T / +307% · Non-Defense / Discretionary: / +$387B / +181% · Defense: / +$264B / +83% · Net Interest Cost: / +$46B / +24% · Source: Congressional Budget Office, White House Office of Management and Budget, US Treasury · Note: Yellow line represents yield on 10-year US Treasury bill from 12/31/91 to 12/31/16. · KLEINER PERKINS · KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 341

**Layout**

Full-bleed white slide with a dark teal header band across the top (about 12.5% of slide height, with a thin cyan rule under it) holding a two-line white title flush left at about 2% margin. Below the header, a bold centred chart title sits above a two-axis stacked column chart (two columns, 1991 and 2016) in the left and centre, with a rounded outlined key box at the right edge (about 80.6% to 96.3% of width); the chart legend sits in two rows beneath the columns, the Kleiner Perkins logo is bottom-left with source and note lines to its right, and the grey footer 'KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 341' sits bottom-right.

**Visuals**

Chart: stacked column chart combined with a line, titled 'USA Expenses by Category, 1991-2016' (bold black). Left y-axis titled 'US Mandatory Entitlements (%)' running 0% to 100% in 20% steps (labels 0%, 20%, 40%, 60%, 80%, 100%). Right y-axis titled 'USA 10Y Treasury Yield (%)' running 0% to 10% in 2% steps (labels 0%, 2%, 4%, 6%, 8%, 10%). X-axis categories 1991 and 2016. Column totals printed above each column: $1.3T (1991) and $3.9T (2016). Light grey horizontal gridlines at each left-axis step. 1991 column, bottom to top: Entitlements / Mandatory 45% (green), Defense 24% (dark blue), Non-Defense Discretionary 16% (cyan), Net Interest Cost 15% (red); the 1991 segments sum to 100%. 2016 column, bottom to top: Entitlements / Mandatory 63% (green), Defense 15% (dark blue), Non-Defense Discretionary 16% (cyan), Net Interest Cost 6% (red). Segment percentages are printed in white bold centred inside each segment. Series: 10Y Treasury is a continuous yellow line (about 1 to 2 px wide, approximately #FBBF35) with no printed value points; it starts near 6.6% in late 1991 at about 7.5% peak, falls to about 4.5% and rises to about 6.7% in the mid-1990s, drifts down to about 3.5% by 2010 and ends near 2.8% at 12/31/16 (values are estimates, none printed). Two thin black leader lines connect the top-right corner of the 1991 Entitlements segment (about 45% level) to the top-left corner of the 2016 Entitlements segment (about 63% level), and a horizontal black line runs along the 0% baseline between the two columns. Legend: five entries in bold black, each with a small square key: green Entitlements / Mandatory, dark blue Defense, yellow 10Y Treasury, cyan Non-Defense Discretionary, red Net Interest Cost. Key box: rounded rectangle outline in cyan with bold black heading 'Change by / Category, / 1991-2016' underlined, followed by five category lines: Debt in black bold, Entitlements in green, Non-Defense Discretionary in dark blue, Defense in cyan, Net Interest Cost in red bold. Logo: KLEINER PERKINS stacked bold green wordmark (image 164 by 96 pixels). No photographs or illustrations.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF with a dark teal #00517A header band across the top 12.5% of the slide. White #FFFFFF background; dark teal header band #00517A with a thin cyan #02B5CC rule beneath it. Title text white regular Arial/Helvetica-style sans-serif, about 4.3% of slide height, two lines. Chart title and axis labels bold black Arial-style sans-serif (#000000), about 2.2% to 3.3% of slide height. Segment labels white bold sans-serif. Legend and key box text bold or regular sans-serif in the series colours: green #31AF78, dark blue #00689D, cyan #02B5CC, red #C82055, yellow line #FBBF35, black #000000. Source and note text regular sans-serif about 1.3% of height in black; footer regular sans-serif about 1.5% in grey #A6AAA9. Shapes are flat with no shadows or gradients; column segments have hairline white separators; key box has rounded corners (radius about 2% of width) and a stroke about 0.3% of height in cyan #02B5CC.

**Layout**

Full-width dark blue title band across the top with a two-line left-aligned title, a centred bold chart heading beneath it, and a stacked column chart filling the middle with a legend row below the plot. The bottom strip holds the green KLEINER PERKINS logo at bottom left beside the source and note lines, and the grey running footer with page number sits at bottom right; margins are about 2% on the left and right.

**Visuals**

Stacked column chart titled 'USA Mandatory Outlays by Category ($B), 1991-2016'. Y-axis titled 'USA Mandatory Entitlements ($B)', linear from $0 to $3,000 with gridlines every $500 (labels $0, $500, $1,000, $1,500, $2,000, $2,500, $3,000). X-axis categories 1991 and 2016. Series (bottom to top): Social Security, Medicare, Medicaid, Income Security. 1991 column total $597B, 45% of Expenses; segments Social Security $267 (45%), Medicare $114 (19%), Medicaid $53 (9%), Income Security $163 (27%). 2016 column total $2.4T, 63% of Expenses; segments Social Security $910 (37%), Medicare $692 (28%), Medicaid $368 (15%), Income Security $459 (19%). Percentages printed to the right of each column segment. Legend below the plot in bold black with square markers: green Social Security, dark blue Medicare, cyan Medicaid, magenta Income Security. No highlighted points. Logo: KLEINER PERKINS wordmark in green at bottom left.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF. White background with a dark teal-blue header band #00517A and a thin cyan rule #02B5CC under it. Title text white #FFFFFF in regular Arial-style sans-serif, about 4.3% of slide height. Chart heading and axis labels bold black #000000 Arial-style sans-serif, about 2.2 to 3.3% of height. Data labels bold white #FFFFFF on the segments and bold black #000000 for percentages. Total labels bold black with italic sub-lines. Segment colours: Social Security #31AF78, Medicare #00689D, Medicaid #02B5CC, Income Security #C82055. Gridlines light grey #D9D9D9 thin lines. Source and note lines in small black regular sans-serif about 1.3% of height. Footer in light grey #A6AAA9 regular sans-serif about 1.5% of height. No shadows or gradients; square-cornered shapes.

**Layout**

Full-bleed white slide with a dark teal header band across the top 12.5% holding a left-aligned two-line white title at a 2.1% left margin, a centred bold chart title beneath it, a single full-width stacked area and line chart with left and right axes in the middle, a centred legend row below the plot, and a footer with the Kleiner Perkins logo at bottom left, a small source and footnote block beside it, and the 'KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 344' footer at bottom right; there is no separate slide-number box beyond that footer text.

**Visuals**

One combined chart: stacked area chart with a line overlay, titled 'Household Debt By Category ($T) & U6* Unemployment (%), USA, 2003-2017'. Left y-axis 'Total Household Debt ($T)' runs $0 to $15 in $3 steps (labels $0, $3, $6, $9, $12, $15). Right y-axis 'U6 Unemployment Rate* (%)' runs 0% to 20% in 5% steps (labels 0%, 5%, 10%, 15%, 20%). X-axis runs 2003 to 2017, one label per year, with the data plotted quarterly. Stacked series from bottom: Mortgage (#31AF78 green, about $5.0T in 2003 rising to about $9.3T in 2008, dipping to about $8.6T by 2017), Home Equity Revolving (#00689D blue, a thin band), Auto (#02B5CC cyan), Credit Card (#7030A0 purple), Student Loan (#E27C12 orange), Other (#FEBF3A yellow, top band). Total stack peaks near $12.7T about 2008 and reaches about $12.5T at 2017. Values are read from the chart; no data labels are printed except the two '$13T' callouts. Line series: U6 Unemployment* in dark red #C00000, about 7.5% in 2003, about 9.6% in 2004, about 8.5% in 2006, about 7.8% in 2007, about 11% in 2008, peak about 17% around 2009 to 2010, about 14.5% in 2012, about 13.5% in 2013, about 10.5% in 2015, about 9.5% in 2016, about 8.4% in 2017. Two vertical black dashed reference lines, each labelled '$13T' above the plot: one at about 2008.6 (where the stack reaches about $13T) and one at 2017 (the final point). Legend below the plot, in order: Mortgage, Home Equity Revolving, Auto, Credit Card, Student Loan, Other, U6 Unemployment*, each with a coloured swatch matching its series. Gridlines: light grey horizontal lines at $15, $12, $9, $6, $3, $0 positions. No highlighted points beyond the two $13T markers.

**Design**

Background: Solid white #FFFFFF across the whole slide. White #FFFFFF background; header band in dark teal-navy #00517A with a thin cyan #02B5CC rule along its bottom edge. Header text is white ArialMT regular, about 3.3% of slide height, two lines. Chart title and axis labels are Arial Bold black #000000, about 3.3% of slide height for the chart title and about 2.2% for axis labels. Legend labels Arial Bold black #000000 at about 2.2%. Footer text is ArialMT regular, about 1.3% for the source and footnote lines and about 1.5% for the footer gray #A6AAA9. Series fills are flat with no gradients or shadows; line series is a 2 to 3 pt solid red line. Dashed reference lines are black with about 0.3% stroke width and a short dash pattern. Gridlines are thin light grey. No rounded corners, no shadows.

KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 350

**Layout**

Full-width dark blue header band across the top holding a two-line white title flush left, with a thin cyan rule beneath it. Below, a 2x2 grid of four area charts, each with a bold centred title above, a y-axis of 0% to 100% at the left, an x-axis of years beneath, and a legend underneath; the top row is the poverty and child mortality charts and the bottom row is democracy and literacy. The footer runs along the bottom with the Kleiner Perkins logo at lower left, the source and note block beside it, and the running footer 'KP INTERNET TRENDS 2017 | PAGE 350' at lower right. The page number is printed in the running footer; no separate slide number is shown.

**Visuals**

Four stacked 100% area charts, all with light peach and green fills and no gridlines.
Chart 1: title '% of People in Extreme Poverty, Global, 1820-2015'. Type: 100% stacked area. Y-axis 0% to 100% in 20% steps; x-axis 1820 to about 2015 in 20-year labels. Series 'Extreme Poverty' (peach #F7CB9C, lower band) and 'Not in Extreme Poverty' (green #33B780, upper band). About 94% extreme poverty in 1820; about 72% in 1950; about 60% in 1970; about 30% in 2000; about 10% in 2015. No values are printed on the chart. Legend below: 'Extreme Poverty' and 'Not in Extreme Poverty' with square swatches.
Chart 2: title 'Child Mortality Rates, Global, 1800-2015'. Type: 100% stacked area. Y-axis 0% to 100% in 20% steps; x-axis 1800 to about 2015 in 20-year labels. Series 'Mortality Rate by Age 5' (peach #F7CB9C, lower band) and 'Survival Rate by Age 5' (green #33B780, upper band). About 43% mortality in 1800; about 41% in 1840; about 33% in 1920; about 17% in 1970; about 5% in 2015. No values printed. Legend below with square swatches.
Chart 3: title '% of People Living in Democracy, Global, 1816-2015'. Type: 100% stacked area. Y-axis 0% to 100% in 20% steps; x-axis 1816 to about 2015 in 20-year labels. Series 'No Democracy' (peach, lower band) and 'Democracy' (green, upper band). About 99% No Democracy in 1816; about 90% around 1940-1945; a sharp drop to about 69% around 1946; about 65% around 1956; about 50% around 1992; about 45% at the end of the series. No values printed. Legend below with square swatches.
Chart 4: title 'Literacy Rate, Global, 1800-2014'. Type: 100% stacked area. Y-axis 0% to 100% in 20% steps; x-axis 1800 to about 2014 in 20-year labels. Series 'Illiterate Population' (peach, lower band) and 'Literate Population' (green, upper band). About 88% illiterate in 1800; about 79% in 1900; about 68% in 1920; about 58% in 1940; about 64% in 1950; about 45% in 1970; about 31% in 1990; about 19% in 2000; about 15% in 2014. No values printed. Legend below with square swatches.
No highlighted points or annotations. Logo: Kleiner Perkins wordmark in green, stacked as 'KLEINER' over 'PERKINS' in bold condensed capitals.

**Design**

Background white (#FFFFFF). Header band dark blue #00517A with a thin cyan (#14A9C9, approximate) rule along its lower edge. Title text white #FFFFFF in a regular-weight Arial/Helvetica-style sans-serif, about 4.3% of slide height for the cap height region of both lines, left aligned. Chart titles and axis labels in bold Arial/Helvetica sans-serif, black #000000, about 1.8 to 2.2% of slide height. Chart fills: peach #F7CB9C and green #33B780. Footer text in regular Arial, about 1.3% of slide height, black #000000; running footer in light grey #A6AAA9 at about 1.5%. Logo green #33B780. Shapes are flat with no corner radii, shadows or gradients.
